@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows

@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.
@rem This is normally unused
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%..

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m" "-javaagent:%APP_HOME%/lib/agents/gradle-instrumentation-agent-8.13.jar"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\lib\gradle-gradle-cli-main-8.13.jar


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.launcher.GradleMain %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
set EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%
if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
exit /b %EXIT_CODE%

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

# AGENT_HANDOFF — Dispatch working-state index

Single source of truth for the next coding agent. Keep this short; link, don't copy.
Updated: 2026-10-23 (Phase C review-fix checkpoint).

Detailed docs: `PROGRESS.md` (verification log) · `docs/ROUTE_B_IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md` (Route B workflow) · `docs/EXECUTION_HANDOFF.md` · `docs/architecture/cloud-migration-plan.md` (**current task plan + baseline findings**) · `AGENTS.md` (UI invariants) · `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` · `docs/CANONICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## 1. Project overview
Personal content engine: POCO C65 Android app records long sessions → uploads directly to YouTube (unlisted) → Windows PC daemon (`python -m dispatch.main`) polls YouTube authenticated, downloads originals, transcribes (YouTube captions first, Gemini two-stage fallback), Gemini selects highlight clips, FFmpeg renders 9:16 clips with burned captions, React review studio (FastAPI `127.0.0.1:8000`, also packaged into the Android WebView), approve → durable outbox publishes to YouTube/Instagram/LinkedIn/X. Local SQLite (WAL) owns processing state. **No cloud component yet** — that is the current task.

## 2. Current objective
Cloud migration per `docs/architecture/cloud-migration-plan.md` (authoritative plan; owner brief = the Principal Architect brief). Add Supabase Auth/Postgres (identity + cloud-owned metadata/review/quota), private R2 clip media, Cloudflare Worker control plane, server-enforced quotas/retention, remote review — **all media processing stays on the PC; originals stay on YouTube; not cloud rendering**. ## 16. Checkpoint — RLS helper false-positive fix (2026-10-23)
**Finding (P0, test-integrity):** `pg_temp.rls_expect_reject` in `tests/rls_two_user_checklist.sql` raised its own 'statement unexpectedly succeeded' exception (SQLSTATE P0001) INSIDE its own `when others` handler — any caller expecting P0001 passed unconditionally, even when the guarded statement succeeded. 13 of 35 assertions expected P0001 (owner-guard/integrity triggers) → all were false-positive-prone. **Fix:** nested capture block records only the tested statement's SQLSTATE/message; the three outcome assertions (unexpected success / wrong SQLSTATE with diagnostics / ok) now live OUTSIDE every handler, so the helper cannot catch or accept its own failure. No caller changes needed (19×42501, 13×P0001, 1×23514 semantically correct); rollback-based procedure and all security assertions preserved; header now states 'statically reviewed only; never executed'. Checks run: `python -m unittest tests.test_cloud_config tests.test_cloud_quota -v` → **22/22 OK**; `git diff --check` → clean. **No SQL executed against any database — no SQL/RLS verification is claimed.** Commit below; not pushed. ## 22. Checkpoint — global 10 GB cap hardening (2026-10-23)
**R2 fact (verified from official docs):** no native bucket storage cap exists ("Data storage per bucket: Unlimited" — developers.cloudflare.com/r2/platform/limits); 10 GB-month is a billing allowance. Dispatch's cap is therefore APPLICATION-LEVEL over reserve/complete-tracked objects; bytes written outside the contract (e.g., a stolen presigned URL within its 600 s life) are bounded by signed content-length + complete-time actual-size verification but cannot be made physically impossible.
**Implemented (migration `20261023000003_global_cap_hardening.sql` + Worker v8085e13d):** (1) usage now counts the PROMOTION DUPLICATE — an active object whose staging copy is unconfirmed counts twice (final+staging coexist), so concurrent promotions cannot overspend; (2) `cloud_complete_upload` keeps `staging_key`, atomically re-checks the projected post-promotion footprint under the same global advisory lock, raises `COMPLETE: global cap exceeded` past 10,000,000,000; (3) `cloud_confirm_staging_removed` releases the duplicate only after the Worker's R2 delete succeeds; `cloud_list_promotion_leftovers` + `/cleanup` reap crash leftovers idempotently (conservative: doubly counted until reaped); (4) presigned PUTs now sign `content-length = expected_bytes` so R2 rejects larger-than-reserved bodies; complete-time actual≤expected remains the authoritative check; abandoned uploads keep holding budget until R2 deletion is confirmed (0002 behavior, unchanged). No per-user Cloudflare limits added; app/db rules otherwise unchanged.
**Tests:** worker `node --test` → **24/24** (confirm-after-delete ordering, leftover reaping, length-presign); tsc clean; python cloud **22/22**; `git diff --check` clean. **Live:** Worker redeployed (v8085e13d), `/health` OK, `/cleanup` 200 processed:0 (gracefully handles the not-yet-applied 0003 function). **0003 NOT applied live** — `db push --linked` now fails 403 ("login role"): the CLI token reverted to the old Sappionapp account (Dispatch project no longer listed; window-login session didn't persist). **Owner action to finish:** in the Dispatch account dashboard → Account Settings → Access Tokens → create one → paste into `.env` after `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=` (placeholder present; never paste in chat), or paste the database URI into `SUPABASE_DB_URL=`; then next agent runs `npx supabase db push --linked` (or `--db-url`) and re-verifies.

# Dispatch UI/UX & Mobile Engineering Invariants

> **Scope:** Repository-wide frontend constitution (Web Review Studio & Android Native Jetpack Compose).  
> **Source Specification:** `c:\CODE\Dispatch\DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`  
> **Curriculum Baseline:** Forensic synthesis of 10 Mobile UI/UX Video Masterclasses (`design_research/`) + LeadMiner Design Tokens + CapCut Interaction Model.

Every agent working on frontend code, layout templates, components, and Android Compose views in this repository must strictly adhere to the following architectural rules:

---

## 1. The Single-Direction Law (Mobile Viewports)
* On mobile viewports and mobile frames (`isMobileFrame` or phone screens), every screen section moves along strictly **ONE** physical axis: either a vertical card stack OR a horizontal snap card carousel.
* Never lay out 2D multi-column desktop grids on mobile screens. Desktop 2-column or 12-column layouts must collapse to clean, unconstrained 1-column vertical stacks on mobile.

## 2. Biomechanical 44px Hitboxes & Safe Areas
* Every interactive element (button, icon trigger, tab, chip, slider thumb) must maintain a minimum touch bounding box of **$44\text{px} \times 44\text{px}$** (matching the human thumb contact patch).
* Maintain at least $8\text{px}$ separation between adjacent touch hitboxes to prevent mistaps.
* Bottom navigation bars and floating controls must respect the modern hardware safe area, clearing the $34\text{px}$ home indicator bar with dedicated bottom spacing.

## 3. The 4-Layer Elevation Architecture (60/30/10 Rule)
Never pick arbitrary hex colors or AI neon palettes. Every surface belongs to one of four calibrated layers:
* **Layer 0 (Canvas Root - 60%):** `#161616` (Deep charcoal studio anchor, `bg-studio`, `bg-background`).
* **Layer 1 (Cards & Elevated Surfaces - 30%):** `#1C1C1C` with border `#2E2E2E` (`bg-surface-100`, `border-border`).
* **Layer 2 (Recessed Wells & Inputs):** `#232323` (`bg-surface-200`) with deeper slider tracks and wells at `#282828` (`bg-surface-300`).
* **Layer 3 (Hero Brand CTA & Focus - 10%):** Electric Creator Blue `#2563EB` (`bg-primary`, hover `#3B82F6`, soft glow `rgba(37,99,235,0.15)`).
* **Semantic Colors (Functional Status Only):** Success `#22C55E`, Warning `#F59E0B`, Danger `#EF4444`. Never use semantic colors for decorative backgrounds.

## 4. The Law of the Single Hero CTA
* Each viewport must have **exactly ONE primary glowing hero action button** (`bg-primary text-white shadow-hero-glow`).
* Secondary and destructive actions ("Reject", "Cancel", "Back") must remain neutral recessed surfaces (`bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-main hover:bg-surface-300`). Never place competing brightly-colored buttons side-by-side.

## 5. Senior Typographic Limit & Numeric Place-Value Alignment
* Operational dashboard and studio screens must use **maximum 4 font sizes** ($18\text{px}$, $14\text{px}$, $12\text{px}$, $10\text{px}$) and **2 font weights** (Semibold for titles/headers, Regular/Medium for body/labels).
* **Numeric Place-Value Rule:** All numbers, durations, timestamps, speeds, file sizes, and percentages must strictly enforce `font-mono tabular-nums`. In tables and lists, numbers must be **right-aligned** so digits line up by place value.
* Always use non-breaking spaces before units (`42&nbsp;s`, `18.4&nbsp;MB`). Use the typographic ellipsis glyph `…` (`&hellip;`) rather than three periods `...`.

## 6. Concentric Geometry
* Nested elements inside rounded cards must follow exact concentric curvature mathematics:
  $$R_{\text{inner}} = R_{\text{outer}} - \text{Padding}$$
  Avoid mismatched pill vs squircle radiuses that create uneven visual gaps.

## 7. Anti-AI Vibecoding Standards (Prohibited Patterns)
* **Zero Native OS Emojis:** Never use emojis (🚀, 💡, 🔥, ⚡, 📦) as interface icons. Always use crisp SVG vector icons (`lucide-react`, Phosphor) with uniform $1.5\text{px}\text{--}2.0\text{px}$ stroke widths.
* **No Harsh Drop Shadows:** Never use opaque black drop shadows (`rgba(0,0,0,0.8)`). Use subtle border elevation (`border-border` `#2E2E2E`) paired with soft ambient diffusion.
* **No Multi-Color Neon Gradients:** Never apply blue-to-green or purple-to-cyan gradients to buttons or card backgrounds.

## 8. Tactile Feedback & Micro-Interactions
* Every clickable button and interactive card must provide immediate tactile feedback on touch/click:
  `active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-150`.
* All states must be fully specified: default, hover, active (pressed), disabled, and loading.

package com.resolvia.dispatch.bridge

import android.os.Build
import android.os.Environment
import android.os.StatFs
import android.webkit.JavascriptInterface
import android.webkit.WebView
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.JsonArray
import com.google.gson.JsonObject
import com.resolvia.dispatch.data.AppDatabase
import com.resolvia.dispatch.data.PairingManager
import com.resolvia.dispatch.data.durationSeconds
import com.resolvia.dispatch.recorder.CameraCaptureManager
import com.resolvia.dispatch.recorder.SegmenterEngine
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * Dispatch Native Android Bridge linking the canonical React frontend
 * running in Android WebView to native CameraX, WorkManager, Room SQLite,
 * and background YouTube direct sync workers.
 */
class DispatchNativeBridge(
    private val activity: ComponentActivity,
    private val webView: WebView,
    private val segmenterEngine: SegmenterEngine,
    private val cameraCaptureManager: CameraCaptureManager,
    private val database: AppDatabase,
    private val pairingManager: PairingManager
) {
    private val gson = Gson()
    private val httpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun isNativeAndroid(): Boolean = true

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getDeviceModel(): String = "${Build.MANUFACTURER} ${Build.MODEL}"

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getPcHost(): String {
        val host = pairingManager.pcHost
        return if (host.isNotBlank()) host else "192.168.0.200:8000"
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun setPcHost(host: String): Boolean {
        val cleanHost = host.trim().removePrefix("http://").removePrefix("https://").trimEnd('/')
        if (cleanHost.isNotBlank()) {
            pairingManager.pcHost = cleanHost
            android.util.Log.i("DispatchBridge", "Native PC host updated to $cleanHost")
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    /** Opens an https URL from the trusted Dispatch Worker in a Custom Tab.
     *  Restricted to the known Dispatch cloud host; JavaScript cannot open
     *  arbitrary pages through this. */
    @JavascriptInterface
    fun openCustomTab(url: String): Boolean {
        if (!url.startsWith("https://dispatch-cloud.resolviaai.workers.dev/")) return false
        return try {
            val intent = androidx.browser.customtabs.CustomTabsIntent.Builder().build()
            intent.launchUrl(activity, android.net.Uri.parse(url))
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) { false }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getAuthToken(): String = pairingManager.pcAuthToken

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun startRecording() {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            activity.lifecycleScope.launch {
                try {
                    segmenterEngine.startSession(
                        cameraManager = cameraCaptureManager,
                        notes = "Dispatch Studio Android Capture"
                    )
                    (activity as? com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity)
                        ?.setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(segmenterEngine.isSessionActive || cameraCaptureManager.isRecording)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    (activity as? com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity)?.setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(false)
                    android.util.Log.e("DispatchBridge", "startRecording failed: ${e.message}", e)
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(activity, "Recording failed: ${e.message}", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun stopRecording() {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            activity.lifecycleScope.launch {
                try {
                    segmenterEngine.stopSession(cameraManager = cameraCaptureManager)
                    (activity as? com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity)?.setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(false)
                    segmenterEngine.triggerYouTubeUpload()
                    cameraCaptureManager.activePreviewView?.let { pv ->
                        cameraCaptureManager.initializeCamera(activity, pv)
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    (activity as? com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity)?.setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(
                        segmenterEngine.isSessionActive || cameraCaptureManager.isRecording
                    )
                    android.util.Log.e("DispatchBridge", "stopRecording failed: ${e.message}", e)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun isRecording(): Boolean {
        val recording = segmenterEngine.isSessionActive || cameraCaptureManager.isRecording
        (activity as? com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity)?.setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(recording)
        return recording
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun switchCamera() {
        notifyCameraStatus("initializing", null)
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            activity.lifecycleScope.launch {
                try {
                    cameraCaptureManager.toggleLensFacing(
                        onReady = { notifyCameraStatus("ready", null) },
                        onError = { error -> notifyCameraStatus("error", error) }
                    )
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    android.util.Log.w("DispatchBridge", "switchCamera failed: ${e.message}")
                    notifyCameraStatus("error", e.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun toggleTorch(): Boolean {
        return try {
            cameraCaptureManager.toggleTorch()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun toggleMic(): Boolean {
        return try {
            cameraCaptureManager.toggleMic()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            true
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun setZoom(ratio: Float): Float {
        return try {
            cameraCaptureManager.setZoomRatio(ratio)
            ratio
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            1.0f
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getZoomInfo(): String {
        val info = cameraCaptureManager.getZoomInfo()
        val obj = JsonObject().apply {
            addProperty("minZoom", info.minZoomRatio)
            addProperty("maxZoom", info.maxZoomRatio)
            addProperty("currentZoom", info.currentZoomRatio)
        }
        return obj.toString()
    }

    fun sendCameraEvent(eventType: String, data: JsonObject) {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            val payload = data.toString()
            val js = "(function() { if (window.onDispatchCameraEvent) { window.onDispatchCameraEvent('$eventType', $payload); } else { window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dispatch-camera-event', { detail: { type: '$eventType', data: $payload } })); } })();"
            webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null)
        }
    }

    fun notifyCameraStatus(status: String, error: String? = null) {
        val obj = JsonObject().apply {
            addProperty("status", status)
            if (error != null) addProperty("error", error)
            addProperty("lensFacing", if (cameraCaptureManager.currentLensFacing == androidx.camera.core.CameraSelector.LENS_FACING_FRONT) "front" else "back")
            addProperty("isRecording", cameraCaptureManager.isRecording)
            addProperty("isTorchEnabled", cameraCaptureManager.isTorchEnabled)
            addProperty("isAeAfLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAeAfLocked)
            addProperty("isAeLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAeLocked)
            addProperty("isAfLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAfLocked)
            addProperty("isAeAfLockUncertain", cameraCaptureManager.isAeAfLockUncertain)
            addProperty("isAudioEnabled", cameraCaptureManager.isAudioEnabled)

            val exp = cameraCaptureManager.getExposureInfo()
            add("exposure", JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("minIndex", exp.minIndex)
                addProperty("maxIndex", exp.maxIndex)
                addProperty("currentIndex", exp.currentIndex)
                addProperty("stepEv", exp.stepEv)
                addProperty("isSupported", exp.isSupported)
            })

            val zoom = cameraCaptureManager.getZoomInfo()
            add("zoom", JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("minZoom", zoom.minZoomRatio)
                addProperty("maxZoom", zoom.maxZoomRatio)
                addProperty("currentZoom", zoom.currentZoomRatio)
            })
        }
        sendCameraEvent("camera_state", obj)
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun retryCameraInit() {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            if (activity is com.resolvia.dispatch.MainActivity) {
                activity.initCameraLifecycle()
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getCameraStatus(): String {
        val exp = cameraCaptureManager.getExposureInfo()
        val zoom = cameraCaptureManager.getZoomInfo()
        val obj = JsonObject().apply {
            addProperty("status", if (cameraCaptureManager.isInitialized) "ready" else "initializing")
            addProperty("isInitialized", cameraCaptureManager.isInitialized)
            addProperty("lensFacing", if (cameraCaptureManager.currentLensFacing == androidx.camera.core.CameraSelector.LENS_FACING_FRONT) "front" else "back")
            addProperty("isRecording", cameraCaptureManager.isRecording)
            addProperty("isTorchEnabled", cameraCaptureManager.isTorchEnabled)
            addProperty("isAeAfLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAeAfLocked)
            addProperty("isAeLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAeLocked)
            addProperty("isAfLocked", cameraCaptureManager.isAfLocked)
            addProperty("isAeAfLockUncertain", cameraCaptureManager.isAeAfLockUncertain)
            addProperty("isAudioEnabled", cameraCaptureManager.isAudioEnabled)
            add("exposure", JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("minIndex", exp.minIndex)
                addProperty("maxIndex", exp.maxIndex)
                addProperty("currentIndex", exp.currentIndex)
                addProperty("stepEv", exp.stepEv)
                addProperty("isSupported", exp.isSupported)
            })
            add("zoom", JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("minZoom", zoom.minZoomRatio)
                addProperty("maxZoom", zoom.maxZoomRatio)
                addProperty("currentZoom", zoom.currentZoomRatio)
            })
        }
        return obj.toString()
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun focusOnPoint(normalizedX: Float, normalizedY: Float, triggerId: Long) {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            val pv = cameraCaptureManager.activePreviewView ?: run {
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("isLocked", false)
                    addProperty("error", "Preview not available")
                })
                return@runOnUiThread
            }
            val w = pv.width.toFloat()
            val h = pv.height.toFloat()
            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("isLocked", false)
                    addProperty("error", "Preview dimensions not ready")
                })
                return@runOnUiThread
            }

            val px = normalizedX.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * w
            val py = normalizedY.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * h
            cameraCaptureManager.focusOnPoint(px, py, pv) { res ->
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", res.success)
                    addProperty("isLocked", false)
                    addProperty("hasAf", res.hasAf)
                    addProperty("hasAe", res.hasAe)
                    addProperty("lockStateUncertain", res.lockStateUncertain)
                    if (res.error != null) addProperty("error", res.error)
                })
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun focusOnPoint(normalizedX: Float, normalizedY: Float) {
        focusOnPoint(normalizedX, normalizedY, System.currentTimeMillis())
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun lockAeAfAtPoint(normalizedX: Float, normalizedY: Float, triggerId: Long): Boolean {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            val pv = cameraCaptureManager.activePreviewView ?: run {
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("isLocked", false)
                    addProperty("error", "Preview not available")
                })
                return@runOnUiThread
            }
            val w = pv.width.toFloat()
            val h = pv.height.toFloat()
            if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("isLocked", false)
                    addProperty("error", "Preview dimensions not ready")
                })
                return@runOnUiThread
            }

            val px = normalizedX.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * w
            val py = normalizedY.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * h
            cameraCaptureManager.lockAeAfAtPoint(px, py, pv) { res ->
                sendCameraEvent("focus_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("triggerId", triggerId)
                    addProperty("success", res.success)
                    addProperty("isLocked", res.isLocked)
                    addProperty("hasAf", res.hasAf)
                    addProperty("hasAe", res.hasAe)
                    addProperty("lockStateUncertain", res.lockStateUncertain)
                    if (res.error != null) addProperty("error", res.error)
                })
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun lockAeAfAtPoint(normalizedX: Float, normalizedY: Float): Boolean {
        return lockAeAfAtPoint(normalizedX, normalizedY, System.currentTimeMillis())
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun unlockAeAf() {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            cameraCaptureManager.unlockAeAf { ok ->
                sendCameraEvent("unlock_result", JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("success", ok)
                })
            }
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun setExposureIndex(index: Int): Int {
        activity.runOnUiThread {
            cameraCaptureManager.setExposureIndex(index) { applied, err ->
                if (applied != null) {
                    val exp = cameraCaptureManager.getExposureInfo()
                    sendCameraEvent("exposure_result", JsonObject().apply {
                        addProperty("success", true)
                        addProperty("index", applied)
                        addProperty("ev", applied * exp.stepEv)
                    })
                } else {
                    sendCameraEvent("exposure_result", JsonObject().apply {
                        addProperty("success", false)
                        if (err != null) addProperty("error", err)
                    })
                }
            }
        }
        return index
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getExposureInfo(): String {
        val info = cameraCaptureManager.getExposureInfo()
        val obj = JsonObject().apply {
            addProperty("minIndex", info.minIndex)
            addProperty("maxIndex", info.maxIndex)
            addProperty("currentIndex", info.currentIndex)
            addProperty("stepEv", info.stepEv)
            addProperty("isSupported", info.isSupported)
        }
        return obj.toString()
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getRecordings(): String {
        return try {
            runBlocking(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val segments = database.recordingDao().getAllSegmentsList()
                val jsonArr = JsonArray()
                for (s in segments) {
                    val obj = JsonObject().apply {
                        addProperty("segmentId", s.segmentId)
                        addProperty("sessionId", s.sessionId)
                        addProperty("sequenceNumber", s.sequenceNumber)
                        addProperty("filename", s.filename)
                        addProperty("filepath", s.filepath)
                        addProperty("fileSizeBytes", s.fileSizeBytes)
                        addProperty("sha256Hash", s.sha256Hash)
                        addProperty("status", s.status)
                        addProperty("createdAt", s.createdAt)
                        addProperty("finalizedAt", s.finalizedAt)
                        addProperty("durationSeconds", s.durationSeconds)
                        addProperty("youtubeVideoId", s.youtubeVideoId)
                    }
                    jsonArr.add(obj)
                }
                jsonArr.toString()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.e("DispatchBridge", "getRecordings failed: ${e.message}")
            "[]"
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getYouTubeStatus(): String {
        val configured = pairingManager.isYouTubeConfigured
        if (!configured) {
            return JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("connected", false)
                addProperty("verified", false)
            }.toString()
        }

        // Return verified channel info if cached, or verify asynchronously
        val cachedTitle = pairingManager.youtubeChannelTitle
        val cachedId = pairingManager.youtubeChannelId
        val isVerified = cachedTitle.isNotBlank() && cachedId.isNotBlank()

        val obj = JsonObject().apply {
            addProperty("connected", isVerified)
            addProperty("verified", isVerified)
            if (isVerified) {
                addProperty("channelTitle", cachedTitle)
                addProperty("channelId", cachedId)
                addProperty("account", cachedTitle)
            } else {
                addProperty("channelTitle", "Unverified Channel")
                addProperty("message", "Credentials present but channel unverified. Reconnect to refresh.")
            }
        }
        return obj.toString()
    }

    private fun verifyYouTubeChannelRemote(accessToken: String): Pair<String, String>? {
        return try {
            val req = Request.Builder()
                .url("https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=snippet&mine=true")
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer $accessToken")
                .get()
                .build()
            httpClient.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                if (!resp.isSuccessful) return null
                val bodyStr = resp.body?.string() ?: return null
                val json = gson.fromJson(bodyStr, JsonObject::class.java)
                val items = json.getAsJsonArray("items")
                if (items != null && items.size() > 0) {
                    val item = items.get(0).asJsonObject
                    val id = item.get("id")?.asString ?: ""
                    val title = item.getAsJsonObject("snippet")?.get("title")?.asString ?: "YouTube Channel"
                    if (id.isNotBlank()) Pair(title, id) else null
                } else null
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun refreshAccessToken(): String? {
        val refreshToken = pairingManager.youtubeRefreshToken
        val clientId = pairingManager.youtubeClientId
        val clientSecret = pairingManager.youtubeClientSecret
        if (refreshToken.isBlank() || clientId.isBlank() || clientSecret.isBlank()) return null

        val formBody = okhttp3.FormBody.Builder()
            .add("client_id", clientId)
            .add("client_secret", clientSecret)
            .add("refresh_token", refreshToken)
            .add("grant_type", "refresh_token")
            .build()

        val req = Request.Builder()
            .url("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token")
            .post(formBody)
            .build()

        return try {
            httpClient.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                if (!resp.isSuccessful) return null
                val body = gson.fromJson(resp.body?.string(), JsonObject::class.java)
                val newAccessToken = body.get("access_token")?.asString
                if (!newAccessToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    pairingManager.youtubeAccessToken = newAccessToken
                    newAccessToken
                } else null
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun connectYouTube(pcHost: String, pairingCode: String): String {
        return try {
            if (pairingCode.isBlank()) {
                return JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("message", "Enter the one-time pairing code shown in PC Settings.")
                }.toString()
            }
            val cleanHost = pcHost.trim().removePrefix("http://").removePrefix("https://").trimEnd('/')
            val url = "http://$cleanHost/api/youtube/credentials"
            val payload = JsonObject().apply { addProperty("pairing_code", pairingCode.trim()) }
            val body = payload.toString().toRequestBody("application/json; charset=utf-8".toMediaType())
            val req = Request.Builder().url(url).post(body).build()
            httpClient.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                val bodyText = resp.body?.string() ?: ""
                val response = try {
                    gson.fromJson(bodyText, JsonObject::class.java)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    JsonObject()
                }
                if (!resp.isSuccessful) {
                    val detail = response.get("detail")?.takeIf { it.isJsonPrimitive }?.asString
                    val message = when (resp.code) {
                        401 -> detail ?: "Pairing code is invalid or expired. Create a new one on the PC."
                        403 -> detail ?: "Create the pairing code from the PC dashboard."
                        409 -> detail ?: "YouTube is not configured on the PC. Sign in there first."
                        429 -> detail ?: "Too many attempts. Wait before trying again."
                        else -> detail ?: "PC pairing failed (HTTP ${resp.code})."
                    }
                    return JsonObject().apply {
                        addProperty("success", false)
                        addProperty("message", message)
                    }.toString()
                }

                val refreshToken = response.get("refresh_token")?.asString ?: ""
                val clientId = response.get("client_id")?.asString ?: ""
                val clientSecret = response.get("client_secret")?.asString ?: ""
                val authToken = response.get("auth_token")?.asString ?: ""
                if (response.get("configured")?.asBoolean == true &&
                    refreshToken.isNotBlank() && clientId.isNotBlank() && clientSecret.isNotBlank()
                ) {
                    pairingManager.saveYouTubeCredentials(refreshToken, clientId, clientSecret)
                    if (authToken.isNotBlank()) {
                        pairingManager.pcAuthToken = authToken
                    }
                    pairingManager.pcHost = cleanHost

                    // Verify account against YouTube API directly
                    val freshToken = refreshAccessToken()
                    val channelInfo = if (freshToken != null) verifyYouTubeChannelRemote(freshToken) else null
                    if (channelInfo != null) {
                        pairingManager.youtubeChannelTitle = channelInfo.first
                        pairingManager.youtubeChannelId = channelInfo.second
                        pairingManager.pcHost = cleanHost

                        // Resume any waiting segments in Room DB
                        activity.lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                            try {
                                val waiting = database.recordingDao().getPendingUploadSegments()
                                for (seg in waiting) {
                                    if (seg.status == "WAITING_FOR_YOUTUBE") {
                                        database.recordingDao().updateSegmentStatus(seg.segmentId, "QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD")
                                    }
                                }
                                segmenterEngine.triggerYouTubeUpload()
                            } catch (_: Exception) {}
                        }

                        JsonObject().apply {
                            addProperty("success", true)
                            addProperty("channelTitle", channelInfo.first)
                            addProperty("message", "Connected to verified YouTube channel: ${channelInfo.first}")
                        }.toString()
                    } else {
                        JsonObject().apply {
                            addProperty("success", false)
                            addProperty("message", "Credentials received but YouTube account verification failed. Check Google OAuth permissions.")
                        }.toString()
                    }
                } else {
                    JsonObject().apply {
                        addProperty("success", false)
                        addProperty("message", "The PC did not return complete YouTube credentials. Sign in there and create a new code.")
                    }.toString()
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("success", false)
                addProperty("message", "Could not reach the PC. Check its address and that both devices use the same trusted network.")
            }.toString()
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun disconnectYouTube() {
        pairingManager.clearCredentials()
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun retryUpload(segmentId: String) {
        activity.lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            database.recordingDao().updateSegmentStatus(segmentId, "QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD")
            segmenterEngine.triggerYouTubeUpload()
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getWifiOnly(): Boolean = pairingManager.isWifiOnlyEnabled

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun setWifiOnly(enabled: Boolean) {
        pairingManager.isWifiOnlyEnabled = enabled
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun getStorageInfo(): String {
        return try {
            val recordingDirectory = java.io.File(activity.getExternalFilesDir(null) ?: activity.filesDir, "recordings")
            if (!recordingDirectory.isDirectory && !recordingDirectory.mkdirs()) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Recording directory is unavailable")
            }
            val storagePath = recordingDirectory.absolutePath
            val stat = StatFs(storagePath)
            val bytesAvailable = stat.availableBlocksLong * stat.blockSizeLong
            val bytesTotal = stat.blockCountLong * stat.blockSizeLong
            val bytesPerGb = 1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0
            val obj = JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("available", true)
                addProperty("freeGb", bytesAvailable / bytesPerGb)
                addProperty("totalGb", bytesTotal / bytesPerGb)
                addProperty("freeBytes", bytesAvailable)
                addProperty("totalBytes", bytesTotal)
            }
            obj.toString()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("available", false)
                addProperty("error", "Storage information is unavailable")
            }.toString()
        }
    }

    @JavascriptInterface
    fun pingPc(pcHost: String): String {
        return try {
            val cleanHost = pcHost.trim().removePrefix("http://").removePrefix("https://").trimEnd('/')
            val url = "http://$cleanHost/api/status"
            val req = Request.Builder().url(url).build()
            val resp = httpClient.newCall(req).execute()
            if (resp.isSuccessful) {
                pairingManager.pcHost = cleanHost
                JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("success", true)
                    addProperty("message", "PC Server reachable (${resp.code})")
                }.toString()
            } else {
                JsonObject().apply {
                    addProperty("success", false)
                    addProperty("message", "PC returned HTTP ${resp.code}")
                }.toString()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            JsonObject().apply {
                addProperty("success", false)
                addProperty("message", "Unreachable: ${e.message}")
            }.toString()
        }
    }
}

package com.resolvia.dispatch.data

import android.content.Context
import androidx.room.Database
import androidx.room.Room
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase
import androidx.room.migration.Migration
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase

@Database(
    entities = [SessionEntity::class, SegmentEntity::class, OutboxEntity::class],
    version = 2,
    exportSchema = false
)
abstract class AppDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun recordingDao(): RecordingDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: AppDatabase? = null

        val MIGRATION_1_2 = object : Migration(1, 2) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE segments ADD COLUMN youtubeVideoId TEXT DEFAULT NULL")
            }
        }

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): AppDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    AppDatabase::class.java,
                    "dispatch_mobile.db"
                )
                .addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2)
                .setJournalMode(JournalMode.WRITE_AHEAD_LOGGING) // Strict WAL mode for crash recovery!
                .build()
                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.resolvia.dispatch.data

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.util.Log
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

/** Stores YouTube credentials for direct phone-to-YouTube cloud uploads. Starts empty on fresh install. */
class PairingManager(context: Context) {
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = createEncryptedOrFallbackPrefs(context)

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PairingManager"
        private const val SECURE_PREFS_NAME = "dispatch_youtube_secure"
        private const val LEGACY_PREFS_NAME = "dispatch_youtube"

        private fun createEncryptedOrFallbackPrefs(context: Context): SharedPreferences {
            val legacyPrefs = context.getSharedPreferences(LEGACY_PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            return try {
                val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
                    .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
                    .build()

                val securePrefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
                    context,
                    SECURE_PREFS_NAME,
                    masterKey,
                    EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
                    EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
                )

                // Migrate legacy plaintext keys if present
                val legacyAll = legacyPrefs.all
                if (legacyAll.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val editor = securePrefs.edit()
                    for ((k, v) in legacyAll) {
                        when (v) {
                            is String -> editor.putString(k, v)
                            is Boolean -> editor.putBoolean(k, v)
                            is Int -> editor.putInt(k, v)
                            is Long -> editor.putLong(k, v)
                            is Float -> editor.putFloat(k, v)
                        }
                    }
                    editor.apply()
                    legacyPrefs.edit().clear().apply()
                    Log.i(TAG, "Migrated legacy plaintext credentials to EncryptedSharedPreferences.")
                }
                securePrefs
            } catch (e: Throwable) {
                Log.w(TAG, "EncryptedSharedPreferences initialization failed (${e.message}). Falling back to standard SharedPreferences.")
                legacyPrefs
            }
        }
    }

    var youtubeAccessToken: String
        get() = prefs.getString("access_token", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("access_token", value).apply()

    var youtubeRefreshToken: String
        get() = prefs.getString("refresh_token", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("refresh_token", value).apply()

    var youtubeClientId: String
        get() = prefs.getString("client_id", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("client_id", value).apply()

    var youtubeClientSecret: String
        get() = prefs.getString("client_secret", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("client_secret", value).apply()

    var youtubeChannelTitle: String
        get() = prefs.getString("channel_title", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("channel_title", value).apply()

    var youtubeChannelId: String
        get() = prefs.getString("channel_id", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("channel_id", value).apply()

    var pcHost: String
        get() = prefs.getString("pc_host", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("pc_host", value.trim()).apply()

    var pcAuthToken: String
        get() = prefs.getString("pc_auth_token", "") ?: ""
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putString("pc_auth_token", value.trim()).apply()

    val isYouTubeConfigured: Boolean
        get() = youtubeRefreshToken.isNotBlank() &&
            youtubeClientId.isNotBlank() && youtubeClientSecret.isNotBlank()

    var isWifiOnlyEnabled: Boolean
        get() = prefs.getBoolean("wifi_only", true)
        set(value) = prefs.edit().putBoolean("wifi_only", value).apply()

    fun saveYouTubeCredentials(refreshToken: String, clientId: String, clientSecret: String) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString("refresh_token", refreshToken.trim())
            .putString("client_id", clientId.trim())
            .putString("client_secret", clientSecret.trim())
            .putString("access_token", "")
            .remove("channel_title")
            .remove("channel_id")
            .apply()
    }

    fun getUploadSessionUrl(segmentId: String): String =
        prefs.getString("session_url_$segmentId", "") ?: ""

    fun saveUploadSessionUrl(segmentId: String, url: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("session_url_$segmentId", url).apply()
    }

    fun clearUploadSessionUrl(segmentId: String) {
        prefs.edit().remove("session_url_$segmentId").apply()
    }

    fun clearCredentials() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}

package com.resolvia.dispatch.data

import androidx.room.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

@Dao
interface RecordingDao {
    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertSession(session: SessionEntity)

    @Update
    suspend fun updateSession(session: SessionEntity)

    @Query("UPDATE sessions SET totalSegments = :totalSegments, status = :status WHERE sessionId = :sessionId")
    suspend fun updateSessionStatus(sessionId: String, totalSegments: Int, status: String)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE status = 'RECORDING'")
    suspend fun getInterruptedSessions(): List<SessionEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertSegment(segment: SegmentEntity)

    @Update
    suspend fun updateSegment(segment: SegmentEntity)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments WHERE sessionId = :sessionId AND (status = 'RECORDING' OR status LIKE 'ERROR_%')")
    suspend fun getUnfinalizedSegments(sessionId: String): List<SegmentEntity>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments WHERE status IN ('QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD', 'FAILED_RETRY', 'WAITING_FOR_YOUTUBE') ORDER BY sequenceNumber ASC")
    suspend fun getPendingUploadSegments(): List<SegmentEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertOutbox(outbox: OutboxEntity)

    @Update
    suspend fun updateOutbox(outbox: OutboxEntity)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE status = 'QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD' ORDER BY updatedAt ASC")
    suspend fun getPendingOutboxItems(): List<OutboxEntity>

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status = 'QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD'")
    fun getPendingOutboxCountFlow(): Flow<Int>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 25")
    fun getAllSegmentsFlow(): Flow<List<SegmentEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 50")
    suspend fun getAllSegmentsList(): List<SegmentEntity>

    @Query("UPDATE segments SET status = :status WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun updateSegmentStatus(segmentId: String, status: String)

    @Query("UPDATE segments SET status = :status, youtubeVideoId = :youtubeVideoId WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun updateSegmentStatusAndVideoId(segmentId: String, status: String, youtubeVideoId: String?)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments WHERE segmentId = :segmentId LIMIT 1")
    suspend fun getSegmentById(segmentId: String): SegmentEntity?

    @Query("UPDATE outbox SET remoteOffset = :offset, updatedAt = :updatedAt WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun updateOutboxOffset(segmentId: String, offset: Long, updatedAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis())

    @Query("SELECT remoteOffset FROM outbox WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun getOutboxOffset(segmentId: String): Long?

    @Query("DELETE FROM outbox WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun deleteOutboxItem(segmentId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM segments WHERE segmentId = :segmentId")
    suspend fun deleteSegment(segmentId: String)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM segments WHERE status IN ('UPLOADED_TO_YOUTUBE', 'PROCESSED_ON_YOUTUBE', 'UPLOADED_AWAITING_PROCESSING') AND status != 'VERIFIED_BY_LAPTOP' ORDER BY sequenceNumber ASC")
    suspend fun getSegmentsAwaitingPcAck(): List<SegmentEntity>
}

data class SegmentEntity(
    @PrimaryKey
    val segmentId: String,
    val sessionId: String,
    val sequenceNumber: Int,
    val filename: String,
    val filepath: String,
    val fileSizeBytes: Long = 0L,
    val sha256Hash: String = "",

    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val finalizedAt: Long? = null,
    val youtubeVideoId: String? = null
)

val SegmentEntity.durationSeconds: Long
    get() = if (finalizedAt != null && finalizedAt > createdAt) (finalizedAt - createdAt) / 1000L else 0L

FILE: android\app\src\main\java\com\resolvia\dispatch\DispatchApplication.kt

package com.resolvia.dispatch

import android.app.Application
import androidx.work.*
import com.resolvia.dispatch.sync.YouTubeDirectUploadWorker
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class DispatchApplication : Application() {
    val applicationScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        schedulePeriodicYouTubeUpload()
    }

    private fun schedulePeriodicYouTubeUpload() {
        val constraints = Constraints.Builder()
            .setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.UNMETERED)
            .build()

        val periodicUpload = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<YouTubeDirectUploadWorker>(15, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
            .setConstraints(constraints)
            .build()

        WorkManager.getInstance(this).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
            "dispatch_youtube_uploads",
            ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP,
            periodicUpload
        )
    }
}

        add(Manifest.permission.CAMERA)
        add(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            add(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
        }
    }.toTypedArray()

    private val permissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
    ) { perms ->
        val cam = perms[Manifest.permission.CAMERA] == true
        val mic = perms[Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO] == true
        if (!cam) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Camera permission is required to preview and record.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
                bridge.notifyCameraStatus("permission_required", "Camera permission required")
            }
        } else {
            if (!mic) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Microphone permission denied. Capturing video without audio.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                cameraCaptureManager.setAudioEnabled(false)
            } else {
                cameraCaptureManager.setAudioEnabled(true)
            }
            initCameraLifecycle()
        }
    }

    fun initCameraLifecycle() {
        if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
            bridge.notifyCameraStatus("initializing", null)
        }
        previewView.post {
            try {
                cameraCaptureManager.initializeCamera(
                    lifecycleOwner = this@MainActivity,
                    previewView = previewView,
                    onReady = {
                        android.util.Log.i("MainActivity", "CameraX 1080p VideoCapture + Preview bound successfully.")
                        if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
                            bridge.notifyCameraStatus("ready", null)
                        }
                    },
                    onError = { err ->
                        android.util.Log.e("MainActivity", "Error binding camera lifecycle: $err")
                        if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
                            bridge.notifyCameraStatus("error", err)
                        }
                        Toast.makeText(this@MainActivity, "Camera error: $err", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                android.util.Log.e("MainActivity", "Error binding camera lifecycle: ${e.message}", e)
                if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
                    bridge.notifyCameraStatus("error", e.message)
                }
                Toast.makeText(this@MainActivity, "Camera error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
    }

    fun setRecordingScreenDimmingEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        if (Looper.myLooper() == Looper.getMainLooper()) {
            updateRecordingScreenDimming(enabled)
        } else {
            runOnUiThread { updateRecordingScreenDimming(enabled) }
        }
    }

    private fun updateRecordingScreenDimming(enabled: Boolean) {
        val changed = screenDimmingState.recordingEnabled != enabled
        screenDimmingState.setRecordingEnabled(enabled)
        if (!enabled) {
            screenDimmingHandler.removeCallbacks(screenDimmingRunnable)
            applyRecordingScreenDimmed(false)
        } else if (changed) {
            scheduleRecordingScreenDim()
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleRecordingScreenDim() {
        screenDimmingHandler.removeCallbacks(screenDimmingRunnable)
        if (screenDimmingState.shouldRunInactivityTimer) {
            screenDimmingHandler.postDelayed(screenDimmingRunnable, RECORDING_IDLE_DIM_DELAY_MS)
        }
    }

    private fun applyRecordingScreenDimmed(dimmed: Boolean) {
        if (dimmed) {
            if (originalScreenBrightness == null) {
                originalScreenBrightness = window.attributes.screenBrightness
            }
            val attributes = window.attributes
            if (attributes.screenBrightness != RECORDING_DIM_BRIGHTNESS) {
                attributes.screenBrightness = RECORDING_DIM_BRIGHTNESS
                window.attributes = attributes
            }
            return
        }

        val originalBrightness = originalScreenBrightness ?: return
        val attributes = window.attributes
        attributes.screenBrightness = originalBrightness
        window.attributes = attributes
        originalScreenBrightness = null
    }

    private fun toRecordingTouchAction(action: Int): RecordingTouchAction = when (action) {
        MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> RecordingTouchAction.DOWN
        MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN -> RecordingTouchAction.POINTER_DOWN
        MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> RecordingTouchAction.MOVE
        MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> RecordingTouchAction.UP
        MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> RecordingTouchAction.CANCEL
        else -> RecordingTouchAction.OTHER
    }

    override fun dispatchTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
        val outcome = screenDimmingState.onTouch(toRecordingTouchAction(event.actionMasked))
        if (outcome.wokeScreen) {
            applyRecordingScreenDimmed(false)
            scheduleRecordingScreenDim()
        }
        if (outcome.userActivity) {
            scheduleRecordingScreenDim()
        }
        if (outcome.consume) return true
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
    }

    @SuppressLint("SetJavaScriptEnabled")
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        // Keep screen on during creator studio workflow
        window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)

        database = AppDatabase.getDatabase(this)
        segmenterEngine = SegmenterEngine(this, database)
        cameraCaptureManager = CameraCaptureManager(this)
        pairingManager = PairingManager(this)

        // Initialize native camera PreviewView (placed underneath WebView)
        // PERFORMANCE mode uses hardware SurfaceView directly via hardware composer, eliminating TextureView copy lag during 1080p recording
        previewView = PreviewView(this).apply {
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            implementationMode = PreviewView.ImplementationMode.PERFORMANCE
            scaleType = PreviewView.ScaleType.FILL_CENTER
        }

        // Set up WebViewAssetLoader to safely serve assets over http://appassets.androidplatform.net
        // Using HTTP scheme eliminates Chromium mixed-content auto-upgrade so local LAN HTTP video streaming works seamlessly.
        val assetLoader = WebViewAssetLoader.Builder()
            .setDomain("appassets.androidplatform.net")
            .setHttpAllowed(true)
            .addPathHandler("/assets/", WebViewAssetLoader.AssetsPathHandler(this))
            .build()

        // Configure full-bleed WebView with transparent background
        webView = WebView(this).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
            setLayerType(View.LAYER_TYPE_NONE, null)
            scrollBarStyle = View.SCROLLBARS_INSIDE_OVERLAY
            isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
            isHorizontalScrollBarEnabled = false

            settings.apply {
                javaScriptEnabled = true
                domStorageEnabled = true
                allowFileAccess = false
                allowContentAccess = false
                allowFileAccessFromFileURLs = false
                allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs = false
                mixedContentMode = WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW
                mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = false
                loadWithOverviewMode = true
                useWideViewPort = true
                cacheMode = WebSettings.LOAD_DEFAULT
            }

            webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
                override fun shouldInterceptRequest(
                    view: WebView,
                    request: WebResourceRequest
                ): WebResourceResponse? {
                    return assetLoader.shouldInterceptRequest(request.url)
                }

                override fun onReceivedError(
                    view: WebView,
                    request: WebResourceRequest,
                    error: WebResourceError
                ) {
                    super.onReceivedError(view, request, error)
                    android.util.Log.e("DispatchWebView", "Resource error on ${request.url}: ${error.description}")
                }
            }

            webChromeClient = object : WebChromeClient() {
                override fun onPermissionRequest(request: PermissionRequest) {
                    request.grant(request.resources)
                }

                override fun onConsoleMessage(consoleMessage: ConsoleMessage): Boolean {
                    android.util.Log.d(
                        "DispatchWebConsole",
                        "[${consoleMessage.messageLevel()}] ${consoleMessage.message()} (at ${consoleMessage.sourceId()}:${consoleMessage.lineNumber()})"
                    )
                    return true
                }
            }
        }

        // Attach native bridge
        bridge = DispatchNativeBridge(
            activity = this,
            webView = webView,
            segmenterEngine = segmenterEngine,
            cameraCaptureManager = cameraCaptureManager,
            database = database,
            pairingManager = pairingManager
        )
        webView.addJavascriptInterface(bridge, "DispatchBridge")

        // Handle hardware and gesture back navigation cleanly
        onBackPressedDispatcher.addCallback(this, object : OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            override fun handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (webView.canGoBack()) {
                    webView.goBack()
                } else {
                    isEnabled = false
                    onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
                }
            }
        })

        // Load canonical React application packaged in assets
        webView.loadUrl("http://appassets.androidplatform.net/assets/web/index.html")

        // Root container: PreviewView underneath, WebView on top
        val rootLayout = FrameLayout(this).apply {
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#161616"))
            addView(previewView)
            addView(webView)
        }

        setContentView(rootLayout)

        // Check required permissions once views are attached to window
        checkAndRequestPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        screenDimmingState.onActivityResumed()
        if (::segmenterEngine.isInitialized && (segmenterEngine.isSessionActive || cameraCaptureManager.isRecording)) {
            updateRecordingScreenDimming(true)
        }
        scheduleRecordingScreenDim()
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        screenDimmingHandler.removeCallbacks(screenDimmingRunnable)
        screenDimmingState.onActivityPaused()
        applyRecordingScreenDimmed(false)
        super.onPause()
    }

    private fun checkAndRequestPermissions() {
        val camGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val micGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED

        if (!camGranted) {
            if (::bridge.isInitialized) {
                bridge.notifyCameraStatus("permission_required", "Camera permission required")
            }
            permissionLauncher.launch(permissionsToRequest)
        } else {
            if (!micGranted) {
                cameraCaptureManager.setAudioEnabled(false)
            }
            initCameraLifecycle()
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        screenDimmingHandler.removeCallbacks(screenDimmingRunnable)
        screenDimmingState.setRecordingEnabled(false)
        applyRecordingScreenDimmed(false)
        super.onDestroy()
        cameraCaptureManager.destroy()
        if (::webView.isInitialized) {
            webView.destroy()
        }
    }
}

package com.resolvia.dispatch.receiver

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.work.*
import com.resolvia.dispatch.data.PairingManager
import com.resolvia.dispatch.sync.YouTubeDirectUploadWorker

/**
 * Lightweight BroadcastReceiver for BOOT_COMPLETED.
 * Enqueues recovery and upload work into WorkManager immediately to prevent 10s ANR.
 */
class BootReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        if (intent.action == Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED) {
            val pairing = PairingManager(context)
            val networkType = if (pairing.isWifiOnlyEnabled) NetworkType.UNMETERED else NetworkType.CONNECTED
            val constraints = Constraints.Builder()
                .setRequiredNetworkType(networkType)
                .build()

            val uploadReq = OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<YouTubeDirectUploadWorker>()
                .setConstraints(constraints)
                .build()

            WorkManager.getInstance(context).enqueueUniqueWork(
                "dispatch_youtube_uploads_after_boot",
                ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE,
                uploadReq
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.resolvia.dispatch.recorder

import android.Manifest
