    <!-- Pro Camera & Resumable Sync Engine Script -->
    <script>
        let AUTH_TOKEN = "";
        let sliceDurationMinutes = 10;
        let sliceDurationMs = 10 * 60 * 1000;
        let mediaStream = null;
        let mediaRecorder = null;
        let isRecording = false;
        
        // Pro Camera State
        let currentFacingMode = "environment"; // "environment" (Back) or "user" (Front)
        let selectedVideoDeviceId = localStorage.getItem("dispatch_pref_video_id") || "";
        let selectedAudioDeviceId = localStorage.getItem("dispatch_pref_audio_id") || "";
        let isTorchOn = false;
        let isAeAfLocked = false;
        let isGridActive = false;
        let currentZoom = 1.0;
        let currentEv = 0.0;
        let focusTimeout = null;

        let sessionStartTime = null;
        let timerInterval = null;
        let currentSessionId = null;
        let currentSegmentIndex = 1;
        let db = null;
        let wakeLock = null;
        let isSyncing = false; // Mutex for upload queue
        
        // Audio Analyser for VU Meter
        let audioContext = null;
        let analyser = null;
        let vuAnimationFrame = null;

        const nativeInput = document.getElementById("native-camera-input");
        const viewfinderEl = document.getElementById("viewfinder");
        const viewfinderContainer = document.getElementById("viewfinder-container");

        // Safe Clipboard Copy Helper
        function safeCopyText(text) {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
            }
            fallbackCopy(text);
        }

        function fallbackCopy(text) {
            const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.position = "fixed";
            ta.style.opacity = "0";
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.focus();
            ta.select();
            try { document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) {}
            document.body.removeChild(ta);
        }

        // 1. Fetch dynamic pairing token from server
        async function fetchPairingConfig() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch("/api/sync/pairing/config");
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    AUTH_TOKEN = data.auth_token;
                    document.getElementById("conn-dot").className = "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400";
                    document.getElementById("conn-label").innerText = "Connected to Laptop";
                }
            } catch (err) {
                document.getElementById("conn-dot").className = "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400";
                document.getElementById("conn-label").innerText = "Offline / Waiting for PC";
            }
        }
        fetchPairingConfig();

        // 2. Check browser support for getUserMedia
        const supportsGetUserMedia = !!(navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia);
        if (!supportsGetUserMedia) {
            document.getElementById("insecure-notice").classList.remove("hidden");
        } else {
            enumerateHardwareDevices();
            navigator.mediaDevices.ondevicechange = () => {
                enumerateHardwareDevices();
            };
        }

        // 3. Enumerate Hardware Audio and Video Devices
        async function enumerateHardwareDevices() {
            if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices) return;
            try {
                const devices = await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices();
                const videoSelect = document.getElementById("video-device-select");
                const audioSelect = document.getElementById("audio-device-select");
                
                const videoInputs = devices.filter(d => d.kind === "videoinput");
                const audioInputs = devices.filter(d => d.kind === "audioinput");

                // Populate Video Devices
                videoSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="">Default ${currentFacingMode === 'user' ? 'Front' : 'Back'} Camera</option>`;
                videoInputs.forEach((d, idx) => {
                    const opt = document.createElement("option");
                    opt.value = d.deviceId;
                    opt.innerText = d.label || `Camera Sensor ${idx + 1}`;
                    if (d.deviceId === selectedVideoDeviceId) opt.selected = true;
                    videoSelect.appendChild(opt);
                });

                // Populate Audio Devices (Detect internal phone vs external mic)
                audioSelect.innerHTML = "";
                document.getElementById("detected-mics-count").innerText = `${audioInputs.length} detected`;
                
                audioInputs.forEach((d, idx) => {
                    const opt = document.createElement("option");
                    opt.value = d.deviceId;
                    let label = d.label || `Microphone ${idx + 1}`;
                    const lower = label.toLowerCase();
                    const isExternal = lower.includes("headset") || lower.includes("usb") || 
                                       lower.includes("external") || lower.includes("bluetooth") || 
                                       lower.includes("wireless") || lower.includes("wired") ||
                                       lower.includes("rode") || lower.includes("dji") || lower.includes("boya");
                    
                    if (isExternal) {
                        opt.innerText = `[External] ${label}`;
                    } else {
                        opt.innerText = label.includes("Built-in") ? label : `Phone Mic (${label || 'Default'})`;
                    }
                    if (d.deviceId === selectedAudioDeviceId) opt.selected = true;
                    audioSelect.appendChild(opt);
                });

                updateHudLabels();
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn("Error enumerating devices:", err);
            }
        }

        function updateHudLabels() {
            const audioSelect = document.getElementById("audio-device-select");
            const micLabel = document.getElementById("hud-mic-label");
            if (audioSelect && audioSelect.selectedOptions.length > 0) {
                const text = audioSelect.selectedOptions[0].innerText;
                micLabel.innerText = text.replace("[External] ", "Ext: ").substring(0, 14);
            }
        }

        // 4. Initialize IndexedDB
        const dbReq = indexedDB.open("DispatchOutboxDB", 1);
        dbReq.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
            db = e.target.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("segments")) {
                db.createObjectStore("segments", { keyPath: "segment_id" });
            }
        };
        dbReq.onsuccess = (e) => {
            db = e.target.result;
            updateOutboxUI();
            startBackgroundSyncWorker();
        };

        function setChunkDuration(mins) {
            if (isRecording) return;
            sliceDurationMinutes = mins;
            sliceDurationMs = mins * 60 * 1000;
            [10, 15, 30].forEach(m => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(`chunk-${m}m`);
                if (btn) {
                    if (m === mins) {
                        btn.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded bg-indigo-600 text-white font-medium shadow";
                    } else {
                        btn.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded surface text-slate-400 hover:text-white";
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Master Record Button Click Handler
        async function handleRecordClick() {
            if (isRecording) {
                stopRecording();
                return;
            }

            if (supportsGetUserMedia) {
                const ok = await initCamera();
                if (ok) startWebRecording();
            } else {
                nativeInput.click();
            }
        }

        // Camera Switching Logic
        function selectCameraMode(mode) {
            currentFacingMode = mode;
            selectedVideoDeviceId = "";
            localStorage.setItem("dispatch_pref_video_id", "");
            
            const backBtn = document.getElementById("cam-back-btn");
            const frontBtn = document.getElementById("cam-front-btn");
            if (mode === "environment") {
                backBtn.className = "p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition bg-indigo-600/30 border-indigo-500 text-white font-medium";
                frontBtn.className = "p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition surface text-slate-400 hover:text-white";
            } else {
                frontBtn.className = "p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition bg-indigo-600/30 border-indigo-500 text-white font-medium";
                backBtn.className = "p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition surface text-slate-400 hover:text-white";
            }
            if (mediaStream) restartMediaStream();
        }

        async function flipCamera() {
            currentFacingMode = (currentFacingMode === "environment") ? "user" : "environment";
            selectCameraMode(currentFacingMode);
        }

        function onVideoDeviceChanged() {
            const select = document.getElementById("video-device-select");
            selectedVideoDeviceId = select.value;
            localStorage.setItem("dispatch_pref_video_id", selectedVideoDeviceId);
            if (mediaStream) restartMediaStream();
        }

        function onAudioDeviceChanged() {
            const select = document.getElementById("audio-device-select");
            selectedAudioDeviceId = select.value;
            localStorage.setItem("dispatch_pref_audio_id", selectedAudioDeviceId);
            updateHudLabels();
            if (mediaStream) restartMediaStream();
        }

        async function restartMediaStream() {
            const wasRecording = isRecording;
            if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === "recording") {
                mediaRecorder.stop();
            }
            if (mediaStream) {
                mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
                mediaStream = null;
            }
            const ok = await initCamera();
            if (ok && wasRecording) {
                startSegmentRecorder();
            }
        }

        // Tap-to-Focus with Reticle Animation
        viewfinderContainer.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            if (!mediaStream) return;
            const rect = viewfinderContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

            // Show Animated Focus Reticle
            const reticle = document.getElementById("focus-reticle");
            reticle.style.left = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(rect.width - 70, x - 32))}px`;
            reticle.style.top = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(rect.height - 70, y - 32))}px`;
            reticle.classList.remove("hidden");
            reticle.classList.remove("focus-box-animate");
            void reticle.offsetWidth; // Trigger reflow
            reticle.classList.add("focus-box-animate");

            if (focusTimeout) clearTimeout(focusTimeout);
            focusTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                if (!isAeAfLocked) reticle.classList.add("hidden");
            }, 3000);

            // Apply Camera Track Focus Constraint if hardware supports pointsOfInterest
            const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            if (track) {
                const normX = x / rect.width;
                const normY = y / rect.height;
                try {
                    track.applyConstraints({
                        advanced: [{
                            pointsOfInterest: [{ x: normX, y: normY }],
                            focusMode: isAeAfLocked ? "manual" : "continuous"
                        }]
                    }).catch(() => {});
                } catch (err) {}
            }
        });

        // AE/AF Lock Toggle
        function toggleAeAfLock() {
            if (!mediaStream) return;
            isAeAfLocked = !isAeAfLocked;
            const lockBtn = document.getElementById("btn-lock");
            const lockText = document.getElementById("btn-lock-text");
            const lockBadge = document.getElementById("ae-af-locked-badge");
            const reticle = document.getElementById("focus-reticle");

            if (isAeAfLocked) {
                lockBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-black border border-amber-300 font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono shadow-lg";
                lockText.innerText = "LOCKED";
                lockBadge.classList.remove("hidden");
                reticle.classList.remove("hidden");
                // Freeze track exposure & focus
                const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
                if (track) {
                    track.applyConstraints({
                        advanced: [{
                            exposureMode: "manual",
                            focusMode: "manual"
                        }]
                    }).catch(() => {});
                }
            } else {
                lockBtn.className = "px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur border border-white/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold";
                lockText.innerText = "LOCK";
                lockBadge.classList.add("hidden");
                reticle.classList.add("hidden");
                const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
                if (track) {
                    track.applyConstraints({
                        advanced: [{
                            exposureMode: "continuous",
                            focusMode: "continuous"
                        }]
                    }).catch(() => {});
                }
            }
        }

        // Torch / Flashlight Toggle (Back Camera Only)
        async function toggleTorch() {
            if (!mediaStream) return;
            const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            if (!track) return;

            const torchBtn = document.getElementById("btn-torch");
            const capabilities = track.getCapabilities ? track.getCapabilities() : {};

            isTorchOn = !isTorchOn;
            try {
                await track.applyConstraints({
                    advanced: [{ torch: isTorchOn }]
                });
                if (isTorchOn) {
                    torchBtn.className = "p-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-black border border-amber-300 shadow-lg transition";
                } else {
                    torchBtn.className = "p-2 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur border border-white/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition";
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn("Torch constraint not supported on this lens", err);
                isTorchOn = false;
                torchBtn.className = "p-2 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur border border-white/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition";
            }
        }

        // Rule of Thirds Grid Toggle
        function toggleGrid() {
            isGridActive = !isGridActive;
            const gridEl = document.getElementById("framing-grid");
            const gridBtn = document.getElementById("btn-grid");
            if (isGridActive) {
                gridEl.classList.remove("hidden");
                gridBtn.className = "p-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white border border-indigo-400 shadow-md transition";
            } else {
                gridEl.classList.add("hidden");
                gridBtn.className = "p-2 rounded-full bg-black/60 backdrop-blur border border-white/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition";
            }
        }

        // 1x / 2x Zoom Controls
        async function setZoomLevel(zoom) {
            currentZoom = zoom;
            const z1 = document.getElementById("zoom-1x");
            const z2 = document.getElementById("zoom-2x");

            if (zoom === 1.0) {
                z1.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white text-black transition shadow";
                z2.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
            } else {
                z2.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white text-black transition shadow";
                z1.className = "px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition";
            }

            if (!mediaStream) return;
            const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            if (!track) return;

            try {
                await track.applyConstraints({
                    advanced: [{ zoom: zoom }]
                });
            } catch (err) {
                // If hardware digital zoom is unsupported by browser, apply CSS transform punch-in
                viewfinderEl.style.transform = `scale(${zoom})`;
                viewfinderEl.style.transition = "transform 0.25s ease-out";
            }
        }

        // Exposure Bias (EV Slider) Changed
        async function onEvSliderChanged(val) {
            currentEv = parseFloat(val);
            document.getElementById("ev-val-display").innerText = (currentEv > 0 ? "+" : "") + currentEv.toFixed(1) + " EV";
            if (!mediaStream) return;
            const track = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
            if (!track) return;
            try {
                await track.applyConstraints({
                    advanced: [{ exposureCompensation: currentEv }]
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.log("Hardware EV compensation not supported", err);
            }
        }

        // Screen WakeLock API
        async function requestWakeLock() {
            try {
                if ('wakeLock' in navigator) {
                    wakeLock = await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen');
                }
            } catch (err) {}
        }

        function releaseWakeLock() {
            if (wakeLock) {
                wakeLock.release().catch(() => {});
                wakeLock = null;
            }
        }

        // Native Camera Input Change Handler (Insecure origin fallback)
        nativeInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const sessId = "sess_" + Date.now();
            const segId = `${sessId}_seg_0001`;

            document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = "Saving to durable outbox...";
            await storeSegmentToOutbox(segId, sessId, file);
            
            const badge = document.getElementById("last-capture-badge");
            document.getElementById("last-capture-title").innerText = `${(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB 1080p Video Saved`;
            document.getElementById("last-capture-sub").innerText = `Segment: ${segId}`;
            badge.classList.remove("hidden");
            setTimeout(() => { badge.classList.add("hidden"); }, 5000);

            nativeInput.value = "";
            triggerImmediateSync();
        });

        // Initialize Camera with Strict 1080p FHD Quality & Studio Audio Bitrate
        async function initCamera() {
            try {
                // Strict 1080p FHD configuration optimized for POCO C65 hardware sensor
                const videoConstraints = {
                    width: { ideal: 1920, min: 1280 },
                    height: { ideal: 1080, min: 720 },
                    frameRate: { ideal: 60, min: 30 }
                };

                if (selectedVideoDeviceId) {
                    videoConstraints.deviceId = { exact: selectedVideoDeviceId };
                } else {
                    videoConstraints.facingMode = currentFacingMode;
                }

                // Studio Audio constraints without voice muffling
                const audioConstraints = {
                    echoCancellation: false,
                    noiseSuppression: false,
                    autoGainControl: true
                };

                if (selectedAudioDeviceId) {
                    audioConstraints.deviceId = { exact: selectedAudioDeviceId };
                }

                mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                    video: videoConstraints,
                    audio: audioConstraints
                });

                viewfinderEl.srcObject = mediaStream;
                viewfinderEl.classList.remove("hidden");
                document.getElementById("camera-placeholder").classList.add("hidden");
                
                // Initialize VU Meter Audio Analyser
                initAudioAnalyser(mediaStream);
                updateHudLabels();
                return true;

            } catch (err) {
                console.warn("FHD 1080p constraints failed, attempting fallback:", err);
                try {
                    mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
                        video: { facingMode: currentFacingMode },
                        audio: true
                    });
                    viewfinderEl.srcObject = mediaStream;
                    viewfinderEl.classList.remove("hidden");
                    document.getElementById("camera-placeholder").classList.add("hidden");
                    initAudioAnalyser(mediaStream);
                    return true;
                } catch (fallbackErr) {
                    nativeInput.click();
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        // Live Audio VU Meter Visualizer
        function initAudioAnalyser(stream) {
            try {
                if (audioContext) audioContext.close();
                audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
                analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
                analyser.fftSize = 64;
                const source = audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
                source.connect(analyser);

                const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);

                function drawVU() {
                    if (!analyser) return;
                    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
                    let sum = 0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) sum += dataArray[i];
                    const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
                    const pct = Math.min(Math.round((avg / 128) * 100), 100);

                    // Update modal VU bar
                    const mBar = document.getElementById("modal-vu-bar");
                    if (mBar) mBar.style.width = Math.max(pct, 5) + "%";

                    // Update HUD mini VU bars
                    const bar1 = document.getElementById("vu-bar-1");
                    const bar2 = document.getElementById("vu-bar-2");
                    const bar3 = document.getElementById("vu-bar-3");
                    if (bar1 && bar2 && bar3) {
                        bar1.style.height = `${Math.min(12, Math.max(3, pct * 0.12))}px`;
                        bar2.style.height = `${Math.min(12, Math.max(4, pct * 0.16))}px`;
                        bar3.style.height = `${Math.min(12, Math.max(3, pct * 0.10))}px`;
                    }

                    vuAnimationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(drawVU);
                }
                drawVU();
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function startWebRecording() {
            isRecording = true;
            currentSessionId = "sess_" + Date.now();
            currentSegmentIndex = 1;
            sessionStartTime = Date.now();
            requestWakeLock();

            // UI Updates
            document.getElementById("btn-toggle").classList.add("record-pulse", "border-red-400");
            document.getElementById("btn-shape").classList.replace("rounded-full", "rounded-sm");
            document.getElementById("hud-overlay").classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById("seg-num").innerText = "#" + currentSegmentIndex;

            timerInterval = setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
            startSegmentRecorder();
        }

        function startSegmentRecorder() {
            if (!mediaStream) return;

            // Prioritize high-quality MP4 AVC1 encoding
            const mimeCandidates = [
                "video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640028,mp4a.40.2",
                "video/mp4;codecs=avc1",
                "video/mp4",
                "video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus",
                "video/webm"
            ];
            let chosenMime = "video/webm";
            for (const cand of mimeCandidates) {
                if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(cand)) {
                    chosenMime = cand;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 16 Mbps Studio FHD bitrate + 256 kbps audio bitrate
            try {
                mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(mediaStream, {
                    mimeType: chosenMime,
                    videoBitsPerSecond: 16_000_000,
                    audioBitsPerSecond: 256_000
                });
            } catch (e) {
                mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(mediaStream);
            }

            const chunks = [];
            const segId = `${currentSessionId}_seg_${String(currentSegmentIndex).padStart(4, "0")}`;

            mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
                if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data);
            };

            mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: chosenMime });
                if (blob.size > 0) {
                    await storeSegmentToOutbox(segId, currentSessionId, blob);
                    triggerImmediateSync();
                }
                if (isRecording) {
                    currentSegmentIndex++;
                    document.getElementById("seg-num").innerText = "#" + currentSegmentIndex;
                    startSegmentRecorder();
                }
            };

            mediaRecorder.start();
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (isRecording && mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === "recording") {
                    mediaRecorder.stop();
                }
            }, sliceDurationMs);
        }

        function stopRecording() {
            isRecording = false;
            clearInterval(timerInterval);
            releaseWakeLock();

            if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === "recording") {
                mediaRecorder.stop();
            }

            if (mediaStream) {
                mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
                mediaStream = null;
            }

            if (vuAnimationFrame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(vuAnimationFrame);
            }

            document.getElementById("btn-toggle").classList.remove("record-pulse", "border-red-400");
            document.getElementById("btn-shape").classList.replace("rounded-sm", "rounded-full");
            document.getElementById("hud-overlay").classList.add("hidden");
            viewfinderEl.classList.add("hidden");
            document.getElementById("camera-placeholder").classList.remove("hidden");
            document.getElementById("focus-reticle").classList.add("hidden");
            document.getElementById("ae-af-locked-badge").classList.add("hidden");
        }

        function updateTimer() {
            const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - sessionStartTime) / 1000);
            const hrs = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 3600)).padStart(2, "0");
            const mins = String(Math.floor((elapsed % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
            const secs = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, "0");
            document.getElementById("timer-display").innerText = `${hrs}:${mins}:${secs}`;
        }

        async function storeSegmentToOutbox(segmentId, sessionId, blob) {
            const buffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
            const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buffer);
            const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
            const sha256 = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = db.transaction("segments", "readwrite");
                const store = tx.objectStore("segments");
                store.put({
                    segment_id: segmentId,
                    session_id: sessionId,
                    blob: blob,
                    size_bytes: blob.size,
                    sha256: sha256,
                    created_at: Date.now()
                });
                tx.oncomplete = () => {
                    updateOutboxUI();
                    resolve();
                };
                tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
            });
        }

        function updateOutboxUI() {
            if (!db) return;
            const tx = db.transaction("segments", "readonly");
            const store = tx.objectStore("segments");
            const req = store.getAll();

            req.onsuccess = () => {
                const items = req.result || [];
                const count = items.length;
                const totalBytes = items.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (it.size_bytes || 0), 0);
                const totalMb = (totalBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1);

                const badge = document.getElementById("queue-badge");
                badge.innerText = `Outbox: ${count}`;
                if (count > 0) {
                    badge.className = "px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono rounded bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-semibold";
                } else {
                    badge.className = "px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono rounded surface text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/10";
                }

                const sizeInfo = document.getElementById("outbox-size-info");
                if (sizeInfo) sizeInfo.innerText = `${count} segments • ${totalMb} MB`;

                const listEl = document.getElementById("outbox-items-list");
                if (!listEl) return;

                if (count === 0) {
                    listEl.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center text-slate-500 py-2 text-[10px]">Outbox is empty. All segments verified on laptop.</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                listEl.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
                    const mb = (it.size_bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1);
                    return `
                        <div class="surface-nested rounded p-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="truncate pr-2">
                                <div class="text-white text-[10px] truncate">${it.segment_id}.mp4</div>
                                <div class="text-slate-400 text-[9px]">${mb} MB • SHA: ${it.sha256.substring(0, 8)}...</div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-600/40 text-amber-300">QUEUED</span>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join("");
            };
        }

        function toggleOutboxDrawer() {
            const drawer = document.getElementById("outbox-drawer");
            drawer.classList.toggle("hidden");
            updateOutboxUI();
        }

        function forceSyncOutbox() {
            if (!isSyncing) {
                triggerImmediateSync();
            }
        }

        function triggerImmediateSync() {
            if (!db || isSyncing) return;
            processNextOutboxItem();
        }

        async function startBackgroundSyncWorker() {
            setInterval(async () => {
                if (!db) return;

                try {
                    const ping = await fetch("/api/sync/ping");
                    if (ping.ok) {
                        document.getElementById("conn-dot").className = "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400";
                        document.getElementById("conn-label").innerText = "Connected to Laptop";
                        if (!AUTH_TOKEN) fetchPairingConfig();
                    } else {
                        throw new Error();
                    }
                } catch {
                    document.getElementById("conn-dot").className = "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400";
                    document.getElementById("conn-label").innerText = "Laptop Offline (Queued)";
                    return;
                }

                if (!isSyncing) {
                    processNextOutboxItem();
                }
            }, 3500);
        }

        async function processNextOutboxItem() {
            if (isSyncing || !db) return;

            const tx = db.transaction("segments", "readonly");
            const store = tx.objectStore("segments");
            const req = store.openCursor();

            req.onsuccess = async (e) => {
                const cursor = e.target.result;
                if (!cursor) {
                    document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = "Sync Outbox Idle";
                    document.getElementById("sync-progress").innerText = "0%";
                    document.getElementById("sync-bar").style.width = "0%";
                    return;
                }

                const item = cursor.value;
                isSyncing = true;
                try {
                    await syncSegmentToLaptop(item);
                } catch (err) {
                    console.error("Sync error for segment", item.segment_id, err);
                } finally {
                    isSyncing = false;
                    updateOutboxUI();
                }
            };
        }

        async function syncSegmentToLaptop(item) {
            const segId = item.segment_id;
            const totalSize = item.size_bytes;

            if (!AUTH_TOKEN) {
                await fetchPairingConfig();
            }

            try {
                const initRes = await fetch("/api/sync/upload/init", {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        session_id: item.session_id,
                        segment_id: segId,
                        filename: segId + ".mp4",
                        file_size_bytes: totalSize,
                        sha256_hash: item.sha256,
                        auth_token: AUTH_TOKEN
                    })
                });

                if (!initRes.ok) {
                    document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = `Sync paused: Auth/Server err`;
                    return;
                }

                const initData = await initRes.json();
                let remoteOffset = initData.remote_offset;

                if (initData.status === "already_completed") {
                    await verifyAndDeleteFromPhone(segId, item.sha256, totalSize);
                    return;
                }

                document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = `Syncing ${segId}`;
                const pct = Math.round((remoteOffset / totalSize) * 100);
                document.getElementById("sync-progress").innerText = `${pct}%`;
                document.getElementById("sync-bar").style.width = `${pct}%`;

                const CHUNK_SIZE = 256 * 1024;
                while (remoteOffset < totalSize) {
                    const nextOffset = Math.min(remoteOffset + CHUNK_SIZE, totalSize);
                    const chunkBlob = item.blob.slice(remoteOffset, nextOffset);

                    const uploadRes = await fetch("/api/sync/upload/chunk", {
                        method: "PATCH",
                        headers: {
                            "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream",
                            "x-segment-id": segId,
                            "x-upload-offset": String(remoteOffset),
                            "x-file-size": String(totalSize),
                            "x-sha256": item.sha256,
                            "x-session-id": item.session_id,
                            "x-auth-token": AUTH_TOKEN
                        },
                        body: chunkBlob
                    });

                    if (!uploadRes.ok) throw new Error("Chunk upload response error");
                    const patchData = await uploadRes.json();
                    remoteOffset = patchData.remote_offset;

                    const p = Math.round((remoteOffset / totalSize) * 100);
                    document.getElementById("sync-progress").innerText = `${p}%`;
                    document.getElementById("sync-bar").style.width = `${p}%`;

                    if (patchData.status === "completed" && patchData.verified) {
                        await verifyAndDeleteFromPhone(segId, item.sha256, totalSize);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = `Sync paused (Will resume)`;
            }
        }

        async function verifyAndDeleteFromPhone(segId, sha256, totalSize) {
            try {
                const verifyUrl = `/api/sync/verify-chunk?segment_id=${encodeURIComponent(segId)}&sha256=${encodeURIComponent(sha256)}&file_size=${totalSize}`;
                const res = await fetch(verifyUrl, {
                    headers: { "x-auth-token": AUTH_TOKEN }
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const check = await res.json();
                    if (check.verified) {
                        deleteSegmentFromOutbox(segId);
                        document.getElementById("sync-stage").innerText = `Verified & pruned: ${segId}`;
                        document.getElementById("sync-progress").innerText = "100%";
                        document.getElementById("sync-bar").style.width = "100%";
                        return;
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn("Could not verify chunk with proof endpoint", e);
            }
            deleteSegmentFromOutbox(segId);
        }

        function deleteSegmentFromOutbox(segId) {
            if (!db) return;
            const tx = db.transaction("segments", "readwrite");
            tx.objectStore("segments").delete(segId);
            tx.oncomplete = () => {
                updateOutboxUI();
            };
        }

            enumerateHardwareDevices();

        }

        function closeSettingsModal() {

        }

        function dismissNotice() {

        }

"""Per-user YouTube token vault (PC side) and remote job queue client.

The Android app performs on-device Google sign-in; the Cloudflare Worker exchanges
the code and stores the refresh token ENCRYPTED (AES-256-GCM, base64url(iv||ct))
in Supabase youtube_connections using TOKEN_VAULT_KEY. The PC decrypts with the
same key when processing that user's videos. The key never leaves the two
server-side components (Worker secret + PC env).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import logging
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

logger = logging.getLogger("dispatch.youtube_connections")


class VaultUnavailable(Exception):
    """Cloud/Supabase unreachable or misconfigured; caller must fail closed."""


def _env(name: str) -> str:
    return os.getenv(name, "").strip()


def vault_key() -> bytes:
    key = _env("DISPATCH_TOKEN_VAULT_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise VaultUnavailable("DISPATCH_TOKEN_VAULT_KEY not configured")
    return base64.b64decode(key)


def decrypt_refresh_token(encrypted_b64url: str) -> str:
    """Decrypt a Worker-encrypted refresh token (base64url(iv||ciphertext), AES-GCM)."""
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM

    data = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(encrypted_b64url + "=" * (-len(encrypted_b64url) % 4))
    iv, ct = data[:12], data[12:]
    return AESGCM(vault_key()).decrypt(iv, ct, None).decode("utf-8")


def _supabase_rpc(action: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    """Service-role RPC against the linked Supabase project. Never logs params."""
    import httpx

    url, key = _env("SUPABASE_URL"), _env("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")
    if not url or not key:
        raise VaultUnavailable("Supabase not configured on the PC")
    resp = httpx.post(f"{url}/rest/v1/rpc/{action}", json=params,
                      headers={"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
                               "Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=20.0)
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        raise VaultUnavailable(f"Supabase RPC {action} failed: {resp.status_code}")
    return resp.json()


def get_user_refresh_token(user_id: str) -> str:
    """Decrypt and return the given user's YouTube refresh token, or '' if none."""
    rows = _supabase_rpc("cloud_get_refresh_token", {"p_user_id": user_id})
    token = rows[0]["cloud_get_refresh_token"] if isinstance(rows, list) else rows
    if not token:
        return ""
    return decrypt_refresh_token(token)


def disconnect_user_token(user_id: str) -> None:
    """Remove a user's stored YouTube credential (reconnect re-runs on-device sign-in)."""
    _supabase_rpc("cloud_delete_refresh_token", {"p_user_id": user_id})


class RemoteJob:
    def __init__(self, job_id: str, user_id: str, youtube_url: str):
        self.job_id = job_id
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.youtube_url = youtube_url


def claim_remote_job(worker_id: str) -> Optional[RemoteJob]:
    """Atomically claim the oldest queued remote job (single-worker alpha)."""
    rows = _supabase_rpc("cloud_claim_job", {"p_worker_id": worker_id})
    arr = rows if isinstance(rows, list) else []
    if not arr:
        return None
    row = arr[0]
    return RemoteJob(row["job_id"], row["user_id"], row["youtube_url"])


def finish_remote_job(job_id: str, status: str, video_id: str = "", error: str = "") -> None:
    _supabase_rpc("cloud_finish_job", {
        "p_job_id": job_id, "p_status": status, "p_video_id": video_id, "p_error": error,
    })


class RemoteJobPoller:
    """Claims queued remote jobs and runs them through the normal ingestion
    pipeline (visibility gate included). Failures are recorded on the job,
    never silently dropped; a claimed job that crashes is marked failed."""

    def __init__(self, ingest_video, worker_id: str = "owner-pc-1", interval_seconds: int = 30):
        self.ingest_video = ingest_video
        self.worker_id = worker_id
        self.interval_seconds = interval_seconds
        self._stop = False

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop = True

    def run_forever(self) -> None:
        import time
        while not self._stop:
            try:
                job = claim_remote_job(self.worker_id)
                if job is None:
                    time.sleep(self.interval_seconds)
                    continue
                self._process(job)
            except VaultUnavailable as e:
                logger.warning("Remote jobs paused (cloud unavailable): %s", e)
                time.sleep(self.interval_seconds * 2)
            except Exception as e:  # keep the poller alive
                logger.error("Remote job poller error: %s", e)
                time.sleep(self.interval_seconds)

    def _process(self, job: RemoteJob) -> None:
        try:
            result = self.ingest_video(job.youtube_url)
            status = result.get("status", "FAILED")
            if status in ("DOWNLOADED", "WAITING_FOR_YOUTUBE_PROCESSING", "WAITING_FOR_VISIBILITY_CHECK"):
                # Ingestion accepted the source; downstream workers own the rest.
                finish_remote_job(job.job_id, "done", result.get("video_id", ""),
                                  str(result.get("error", "")))
                logger.info("Remote job %s accepted: %s", job.job_id, status)
            else:
                finish_remote_job(job.job_id, "failed", result.get("video_id", ""),
                                  str(result.get("error", "ingestion failed")))
        except Exception as e:
            finish_remote_job(job.job_id, "failed", "", str(e))
            logger.error("Remote job %s failed: %s", job.job_id, e)
