export type CameraEventListener = (event: { type: string; data: any }) => void;

declare global {
  interface Window {
    onDispatchCameraEvent?: (type: string, data: any) => void;
    DispatchBridge?: {
      startRecording: () => void;
      stopRecording: () => void;
      isRecording: () => boolean;
      switchCamera: () => void;
      toggleTorch: () => boolean;
      toggleMic: () => boolean;
      setZoom: (ratio: number) => number;
      getZoomInfo?: () => string;
      focusOnPoint?: (normX: number, normY: number, triggerId?: number) => void;
      lockAeAfAtPoint?: (normX: number, normY: number, triggerId?: number) => boolean;
      unlockAeAf?: () => void;
      setExposureIndex?: (index: number) => number;
      getExposureInfo?: () => string;
      getCameraStatus?: () => string;
      retryCameraInit?: () => void;
      getRecordings: () => string;
      getYouTubeStatus: () => string;
      connectYouTube: (pcHost: string, pairingCode: string) => string;
      disconnectYouTube: () => void;
      retryUpload: (segmentId: string) => void;
      getStorageInfo: () => string;
      pingPc: (pcHost: string) => string;
      getWifiOnly: () => boolean;
      setWifiOnly: (enabled: boolean) => void;
      getPcHost?: () => string;
      setPcHost?: (pcHost: string) => boolean;
      getAuthToken?: () => string;
    };
  }
}

const cameraListeners: Set<CameraEventListener> = new Set();

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.onDispatchCameraEvent = (type: string, data: any) => {
    cameraListeners.forEach(listener => {
      try {
        listener({ type, data });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Camera listener error:', e);
      }
    });
  };

  window.addEventListener('dispatch-camera-event', ((e: CustomEvent) => {
    if (e.detail) {
      cameraListeners.forEach(listener => {
        try {
          listener(e.detail);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Camera listener error:', err);
        }
      });
    }
  }) as EventListener);
}

export const Bridge = {
  isAvailable(): boolean {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' && (
      !!(window as any).DispatchBridge ||
      window.location.hostname === 'appassets.androidplatform.net'
    );
  },

  isRecording(): boolean {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.isRecording) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.isRecording();
    }
    return false;
  },

  startRecording(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.startRecording) {
      window.DispatchBridge.startRecording();
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] startRecording');
    }
  },

  stopRecording(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.stopRecording) {
      window.DispatchBridge.stopRecording();
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] stopRecording');
    }
  },

  switchCamera(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.switchCamera) {
      window.DispatchBridge.switchCamera();
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] switchCamera');
    }
  },

  toggleTorch(): boolean {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.toggleTorch) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.toggleTorch();
    }
    console.log('[Mock Bridge] toggleTorch');
    return false;
  },

  toggleMic(): boolean {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.toggleMic) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.toggleMic();
    }
    console.log('[Mock Bridge] toggleMic');
    return true;
  },

  setZoom(ratio: number): number {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.setZoom) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.setZoom(ratio);
    }
    console.log('[Mock Bridge] setZoom', ratio);
    return ratio;
  },

  getZoomInfo(): ZoomInfo {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getZoomInfo) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(window.DispatchBridge.getZoomInfo());
      } catch {}
    }
    return { minZoom: 1.0, maxZoom: 5.0, currentZoom: 1.0 };
  },

  onCameraEvent(listener: CameraEventListener): () => void {
    cameraListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      cameraListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  },

  focusOnPoint(normX: number, normY: number, triggerId = Date.now()): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.focusOnPoint) {
      window.DispatchBridge.focusOnPoint(normX, normY, triggerId);
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] focusOnPoint', normX, normY);
      setTimeout(() => {
        cameraListeners.forEach(l => l({
          type: 'focus_result',
          data: { triggerId, success: true, isLocked: false, hasAf: true, hasAe: true, normX, normY }
        }));
      }, 300);
    }
  },

  lockAeAfAtPoint(normX: number, normY: number, triggerId = Date.now()): boolean {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.lockAeAfAtPoint) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.lockAeAfAtPoint(normX, normY, triggerId) ?? true;
    }
    console.log('[Mock Bridge] lockAeAfAtPoint', normX, normY);
    setTimeout(() => {
      cameraListeners.forEach(l => l({
        type: 'focus_result',
        data: { triggerId, success: true, isLocked: true, hasAf: true, hasAe: true, normX, normY }
      }));
    }, 350);
    return true;
  },

  unlockAeAf(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.unlockAeAf) {
      window.DispatchBridge.unlockAeAf();
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] unlockAeAf');
      setTimeout(() => {
        cameraListeners.forEach(l => l({
          type: 'unlock_result',
          data: { success: true }
        }));
      }, 100);
    }
  },

  retryCameraInit(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.retryCameraInit) {
      window.DispatchBridge.retryCameraInit();
    } else {
      console.log('[Mock Bridge] retryCameraInit');
    }
  },

  getCameraStatus(): CameraStateEvent | null {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getCameraStatus) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(window.DispatchBridge.getCameraStatus());
      } catch {}
    }
    return null;
  },

  setExposureIndex(index: number): number {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.setExposureIndex) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.setExposureIndex(index);
    }
    return index;
  },

  getExposureInfo(): ExposureInfo {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getExposureInfo) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(window.DispatchBridge.getExposureInfo());
      } catch {
        // fallback
      }
    }
    return { minIndex: -4, maxIndex: 4, currentIndex: 0, stepEv: 0.5, isSupported: true };
  },

  getRecordings(): RecordingItem[] {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getRecordings) {
      try {
        const raw = window.DispatchBridge.getRecordings();
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to parse recordings from bridge:', e);
        return [];
      }
    }
    return [];
  },

  getYouTubeStatus(): YouTubeStatus {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getYouTubeStatus) {
      try {
        const raw = window.DispatchBridge.getYouTubeStatus();
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to parse YouTube status from bridge:', e);
        return { connected: false };
      }
    }
    return { connected: false };
  },

  connectYouTube(pcHost: string, pairingCode: string): { success: boolean; message: string } {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.connectYouTube) {
      try {
        const res = window.DispatchBridge.connectYouTube(pcHost, pairingCode);
        return JSON.parse(res);
      } catch (e: any) {
        return { success: false, message: e.message || 'Connection error' };
      }
    }
    return { success: false, message: 'Native bridge unavailable' };
  },

  disconnectYouTube(): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.disconnectYouTube) {
      window.DispatchBridge.disconnectYouTube();
    }
  },

  retryUpload(segmentId: string): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.retryUpload) {
      window.DispatchBridge.retryUpload(segmentId);
    }
  },

  getStorageInfo(): StorageInfo {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getStorageInfo) {
      try {
        const raw = window.DispatchBridge.getStorageInfo();
        const info = JSON.parse(raw) as StorageInfo;
        if (info.available && Number.isFinite(info.freeGb) && Number.isFinite(info.totalGb)) return info;
        return { available: false, error: info.error || 'Storage information is unavailable' };
      } catch {
        return { available: false, error: 'Storage information could not be read' };
      }
    }
    return { available: false, error: 'Storage information is available only in the Android app' };
  },

  async pingPc(pcHost: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const cleanHost = pcHost.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.pingPc) {
      try {
        const res = window.DispatchBridge.pingPc(cleanHost);
        return JSON.parse(res);
      } catch (e: any) {
        return { success: false, message: e.message || 'Error pinging PC' };
      }
    }
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const t = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);
      const res = await fetch(`http://${cleanHost}/api/status`, { mode: 'cors', signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(t);
      if (res.ok) {
        return { success: true, message: `PC reachable (HTTP ${res.status})` };
      }
      return { success: false, message: `PC returned HTTP ${res.status}` };
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { success: false, message: e.message || 'Host unreachable' };
    }
  },

  setPcHost(pcHost: string): void {
    const clean = pcHost.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    if (!clean) return;
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.setPcHost) {
      try {
        window.DispatchBridge.setPcHost(clean);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to call native setPcHost', e);
      }
    }
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('dispatch_pc_host', clean);
    }
  },

  getWifiOnly(): boolean {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.getWifiOnly) {
      return window.DispatchBridge.getWifiOnly();
    }
    const saved = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('dispatch_wifi_only') : null;
    return saved !== null ? saved === 'true' : true;
  },

  setWifiOnly(enabled: boolean): void {
    if (window.DispatchBridge?.setWifiOnly) {
      window.DispatchBridge.setWifiOnly(enabled);
    }
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('dispatch_wifi_only', String(enabled));
    }
  }
};

export function getApiBaseUrl(pcHost?: string): string {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (
    window.location.protocol === 'file:' ||
    window.location.hostname === 'appassets.androidplatform.net' ||
    !!(window as any).DispatchBridge
  )) {
    const nativeHost = window.DispatchBridge?.getPcHost?.()?.trim() || null;
    const host = pcHost || nativeHost || (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('dispatch_pc_host') : null) || '192.168.0.200:8000';
    const cleanHost = host.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    return `http://${cleanHost}`;
  }
  return '';
}

export function apiUrl(path: string, pcHost?: string): string {
  const base = getApiBaseUrl(pcHost);
  if (!base) return path;
  const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${base}${cleanPath}`;
}

export function getAuthHeaders(custom?: Record<string, string>): Record<string, string> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...(custom || {}),
  };
  const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window as any).DispatchBridge?.getAuthToken?.() : null;
  if (token && token.trim().length > 0) {
    headers['x-auth-token'] = token.trim();
  }
  return headers;
}

import type { ExposureInfo, ExposureResultEvent, FocusResultEvent, CameraStateEvent } from '../bridge';

export type FocusStatus = 'idle' | 'focusing' | 'locking' | 'unlocking' | 'success' | 'failed' | 'locked' | 'uncertain';

export interface FocusExposureState {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  screenNormX: number;
  screenNormY: number;
  status: FocusStatus;
  triggerId: number;
  isLocked: boolean;
  hasAf: boolean;
  hasAe: boolean;
  timestamp: number;
  error?: string;
}

export interface PointerSession {
  pointerId: number;
  originX: number;
  originY: number;
  startExposureIndex: number;
  isExposureSlider: boolean;
}

export function beginPointerSession(
  pointerId: number,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  startExposureIndex: number,
  isExposureSlider: boolean
): PointerSession {
  return { pointerId, originX: x, originY: y, startExposureIndex, isExposureSlider };
}

export function exposureIndexForPointerMove(
  session: PointerSession | null,
  pointerId: number,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  exposure: ExposureInfo,
  totalDragDistancePx = 160
): number | null {
  if (!session || session.pointerId !== pointerId || !session.isExposureSlider || !exposure.isSupported) {
    return null;
  }

  const range = Math.max(1, exposure.maxIndex - exposure.minIndex);
  const indexOffset = (-(y - session.originY) / totalDragDistancePx) * range;
  return Math.min(
    exposure.maxIndex,
    Math.max(exposure.minIndex, Math.round(session.startExposureIndex + indexOffset))
  );
}

export function endPointerSession(session: PointerSession | null, pointerId: number): PointerSession | null {
  return session?.pointerId === pointerId ? null : session;
}

export function applyExposureResult(
  currentIndex: number,
  result: ExposureResultEvent
): { index: number; error: string | null } {
  if (result.success && Number.isInteger(result.index)) {
    return { index: result.index, error: null };
  }
  return {
    index: currentIndex,
    error: result.error || 'Camera did not apply the exposure change',
  };
}

export function applyFocusResult(
  current: FocusExposureState | null,
  result: FocusResultEvent
): FocusExposureState | null {
  if (!current || !Number.isFinite(result.triggerId) || current.triggerId !== result.triggerId) {
    return current;
  }

  if (result.lockStateUncertain) {
    return {
      ...current,
      status: 'uncertain',
      isLocked: false,
      hasAf: result.hasAf ?? current.hasAf,
      hasAe: result.hasAe ?? current.hasAe,
      error: result.error || 'Camera lock state is uncertain; unlock to recover safely.',
    };
  }

  const canConfirmDelayedLock = (current.status === 'failed' || current.status === 'uncertain') && result.success && result.isLocked;
  const lockConfirmed = result.success && result.isLocked && (result.hasAf === true || result.hasAe === true);
  if (current.status === 'locking' || canConfirmDelayedLock) {
    return {
      ...current,
      status: result.lockStateUncertain ? 'uncertain' : lockConfirmed ? 'locked' : 'failed',
      isLocked: lockConfirmed,
      hasAf: result.hasAf ?? current.hasAf,
      hasAe: result.hasAe ?? current.hasAe,
      error: result.error || (lockConfirmed ? undefined : 'Camera did not confirm the AE/AF lock'),
    };
  }

  if (current.status === 'unlocking') return current;

  return {
    ...current,
    status: result.success && !result.isLocked ? 'success' : 'failed',
    isLocked: false,
    hasAf: result.hasAf ?? current.hasAf,
    hasAe: result.hasAe ?? current.hasAe,
    error: result.success ? undefined : (result.error || 'Camera focus failed'),
  };
}

export function markLockAttemptTimedOut(
  current: FocusExposureState | null,
  triggerId: number
): FocusExposureState | null {
  if (!current || current.triggerId !== triggerId || current.status !== 'locking') return current;
  return {
    ...current,
    status: 'failed',
    isLocked: false,
    error: 'Lock confirmation timed out; resetting camera focus state',
  };
}

export function applyUnlockResult(
  current: FocusExposureState | null,
  success: boolean
): FocusExposureState | null {
  if (!current) return null;
  if (success) {
    return { ...current, status: 'idle', isLocked: false, hasAf: false, hasAe: false, error: undefined };
  }
  return {
    ...current,
    status: current.isLocked ? 'locked' : current.status === 'unlocking' ? 'uncertain' : current.status === 'uncertain' ? 'uncertain' : 'failed',
    error: 'Camera did not confirm unlock. Try again.',
  };
}

export function applyNativeLockState(
  current: FocusExposureState | null,
  isAeAfLocked: boolean,
  nativeState?: Pick<CameraStateEvent, 'isAeLocked' | 'isAfLocked' | 'isAeAfLockUncertain'>
): FocusExposureState | null {
  if (!current) return current;
  const hasKnownChannel = current.hasAe || current.hasAf;
  const hasAe = nativeState?.isAeLocked ?? (isAeAfLocked ? (hasKnownChannel ? current.hasAe : true) : false);
  const hasAf = nativeState?.isAfLocked ?? (isAeAfLocked ? (hasKnownChannel ? current.hasAf : true) : false);
  if (nativeState?.isAeAfLockUncertain) {
    return { ...current, status: 'uncertain', isLocked: false, hasAe, hasAf, error: 'Camera lock state could not be confirmed; unlock to recover safely.' };
  }
  if (isAeAfLocked) {
    return { ...current, status: 'locked', isLocked: true, hasAe, hasAf, error: undefined };
  }
  if (current.status === 'locking') return current;
  if (current.isLocked || current.status === 'locking' || current.status === 'unlocking') {
    return { ...current, status: current.status === 'unlocking' ? 'idle' : current.status, isLocked: false, hasAe: false, hasAf: false };
  }
  return current;
}

export function isCameraLifecycleTransition(
  previous: CameraStateEvent,
  next: CameraStateEvent
): boolean {
  return previous.lensFacing !== next.lensFacing || next.status !== 'ready';
}

import { CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, StyleConfig, LayoutConfig, AnimationConfig } from './types';

export type StyleSection =
  | 'font'
  | 'color'
  | 'text'
  | 'stroke'
  | 'glow'
  | 'background'
  | 'shadow'
  | 'spacing'
  | 'bold_italic'
  | 'case'
  | 'alignment'
  | 'animation'
  | 'templates'
  | 'layout';

export interface ApplyToAllResult {
  nextTrack: CaptionTrack;
  affectedCount: number;
}

/**
 * Extracts only the properties belonging to the specified section from a source group.
 */
export function extractSectionProperties(
  sourceGroup: CaptionGroup,
  track: CaptionTrack,
  section: StyleSection
): {
  stylePatch?: Partial<StyleConfig>;
  layoutPatch?: Partial<LayoutConfig>;
  animationPatch?: Partial<AnimationConfig>;
} {
  const targetStyle = sourceGroup.style || track.default_style;
  const targetLayout = sourceGroup.layout || track.default_layout;
  const targetAnimation = sourceGroup.animation || track.default_animation;

  switch (section) {
    case 'font':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          font_family: targetStyle.font_family,
          font_size: targetStyle.font_size,
          font_weight: targetStyle.font_weight,
          letter_spacing: targetStyle.letter_spacing,
          line_height: targetStyle.line_height,
          text_transform: targetStyle.text_transform,
        },
      };

    case 'color':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          primary_color: targetStyle.primary_color,
          opacity: targetStyle.opacity,
          text_opacity: targetStyle.text_opacity,
          ...(sourceGroup.type !== 'text' ? {
            highlight_color: targetStyle.highlight_color,
            highlight_enabled: targetStyle.highlight_enabled,
          } : {}),
        },
      };

    case 'text':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          primary_color: targetStyle.primary_color,
          text_opacity: targetStyle.text_opacity,
          font_size: targetStyle.font_size,
          opacity: targetStyle.opacity,
          font_weight: targetStyle.font_weight,
          font_style: targetStyle.font_style,
          underline: targetStyle.underline,
          text_transform: targetStyle.text_transform,
          ...(sourceGroup.type !== 'text' ? {
            highlight_color: targetStyle.highlight_color,
            highlight_enabled: targetStyle.highlight_enabled,
          } : {}),
        },
      };

    case 'stroke':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          outline_enabled: targetStyle.outline_enabled,
          outline_color: targetStyle.outline_color,
          outline_width: targetStyle.outline_width,
          outline_opacity: targetStyle.outline_opacity,
        },
      };

    case 'glow':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          glow_enabled: targetStyle.glow_enabled,
          glow_color: targetStyle.glow_color,
          glow_blur: targetStyle.glow_blur,
          glow_opacity: targetStyle.glow_opacity,
        },
      };

    case 'background':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          background_enabled: targetStyle.background_enabled,
          background_mode: targetStyle.background_mode,
          background_color: targetStyle.background_color,
          background_opacity: targetStyle.background_opacity,
          background_padding_x: targetStyle.background_padding_x,
          background_padding_y: targetStyle.background_padding_y,
          background_corner_radius: targetStyle.background_corner_radius,
          background_offset_x: targetStyle.background_offset_x,
          background_offset_y: targetStyle.background_offset_y,
          background_width: targetStyle.background_width,
          background_height: targetStyle.background_height,
        },
      };

    case 'shadow':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          shadow_enabled: targetStyle.shadow_enabled,
          shadow_color: targetStyle.shadow_color,
          shadow_offset_x: targetStyle.shadow_offset_x,
          shadow_offset_y: targetStyle.shadow_offset_y,
          shadow_blur: targetStyle.shadow_blur,
          shadow_opacity: targetStyle.shadow_opacity,
          shadow_distance: targetStyle.shadow_distance,
          shadow_angle: targetStyle.shadow_angle,
        },
      };

    case 'spacing':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          letter_spacing: targetStyle.letter_spacing,
          line_height: targetStyle.line_height,
        },
        layoutPatch: {
          alignment: targetLayout.alignment,
          scale: targetLayout.scale,
        },
      };

    case 'bold_italic':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          font_weight: targetStyle.font_weight,
          font_style: targetStyle.font_style,
          underline: targetStyle.underline,
        },
      };

    case 'case':
      return {
        stylePatch: {
          text_transform: targetStyle.text_transform,
        },
      };

    case 'alignment':
      return {
        layoutPatch: {
          alignment: targetLayout.alignment,
          max_width: targetLayout.max_width,
          max_lines: targetLayout.max_lines,
        },
      };

    case 'layout':
      return {
        layoutPatch: {
          position_x: targetLayout.position_x,
          position_y: targetLayout.position_y,
          scale: targetLayout.scale,
          ...(targetLayout.rotation !== undefined ? { rotation: targetLayout.rotation } : {}),
          ...(targetLayout.alignment !== undefined ? { alignment: targetLayout.alignment } : {}),
          ...(targetLayout.max_width !== undefined ? { max_width: targetLayout.max_width } : {}),
          ...(targetLayout.max_lines !== undefined ? { max_lines: targetLayout.max_lines } : {}),
        },
      };

    case 'animation':
      return {
        animationPatch: {
          type: targetAnimation.type,
          duration_ms: targetAnimation.duration_ms,
          active_scale: targetAnimation.active_scale,
          easing: targetAnimation.easing,
          enter: targetAnimation.enter ? { ...targetAnimation.enter } : undefined,
          active_word: targetAnimation.active_word ? { ...targetAnimation.active_word } : undefined,
          exit: targetAnimation.exit ? { ...targetAnimation.exit } : undefined,
          loop: targetAnimation.loop ? { ...targetAnimation.loop } : undefined,
        },
      };

    case 'templates':
      return {
        stylePatch: { ...targetStyle },
        animationPatch: { ...targetAnimation },
      };

    default:
      return {};
  }
}

/**
 * One-time action to apply ONLY the properties of the given section
 * from the target group to every eligible text/caption element in the clip.
 * 
 * Invariants:
 * 1. Only changed properties of the current section propagate.
 * 2. Unrelated section properties (colors, strokes, shadows, animations, positions) remain intact.
 * 3. Never applies to audio, video overlays, or voiceovers.
 * 4. Word-level overrides and timestamps are 100% preserved.
 * 5. Not a persistent mode — future edits remain strictly local.
 */
export function applySectionStylesToTrack(
  track: CaptionTrack | null,
  targetGroupId: string | null,
  section: StyleSection
): ApplyToAllResult {
  if (!track || !track.groups || track.groups.length === 0) {
    return { nextTrack: track as CaptionTrack, affectedCount: 0 };
  }

  const targetGroup = (targetGroupId ? track.groups.find((g) => g.id === targetGroupId) : null) ||
    track.groups.find((g) => !g.type || g.type === 'caption') ||
    track.groups.find((g) => g.type === 'text') ||
    track.groups[0];

  if (!targetGroup) {
    return { nextTrack: track, affectedCount: 0 };
  }

  const { stylePatch, layoutPatch, animationPatch } = extractSectionProperties(
    targetGroup,
    track,
    section
  );

  let affectedCount = 0;

  const updatedGroups = track.groups.map((grp) => {
    // Restrict strictly based on target layer type:
    // Text layers apply ONLY to other text layers.
    // Captions apply ONLY to other captions.
    // Audio and overlay layers are NEVER affected.
    const isTargetText = targetGroup.type === 'text';
    const isEligible = isTargetText
      ? grp.type === 'text'
      : (!grp.type || grp.type === 'caption');

    if (!isEligible) {
      return grp;
    }

    affectedCount++;
    return {
      ...grp,
      style: stylePatch ? { ...(grp.style || track.default_style), ...stylePatch } : grp.style,
      layout: layoutPatch ? { ...(grp.layout || track.default_layout), ...layoutPatch } : grp.layout,
      animation: animationPatch ? { ...(grp.animation || track.default_animation), ...animationPatch } : grp.animation,
    };
  });

  const nextTrack: CaptionTrack = {
    ...track,
    groups: updatedGroups,
  };

  return { nextTrack, affectedCount };
}

FILE: frontend\src\captions\ApplyToAllButton.tsx
============================================================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { CheckCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { StyleSection } from './applyToAll';

export interface ApplyToAllButtonProps {
  section: StyleSection;
  sectionLabel: string;
  onApply: (section: StyleSection) => number;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
  successLabel?: string;
}

export const ApplyToAllButton: React.FC<ApplyToAllButtonProps> = ({
  section,
  sectionLabel,
  onApply,
  className = '',
  label,
  successLabel,
}) => {
  const [appliedCount, setAppliedCount] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const count = onApply(section);
    setAppliedCount(count);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAppliedCount(null);
    }, 1800);
  };

  const isApplied = appliedCount !== null;

  return (
    <div className={`pt-2.5 pb-1 ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleClick}
        className={`w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-all active:scale-[0.98] ${
          isApplied
            ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 shadow-sm'
            : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main hover:bg-surface-300'
        }`}
        title={`Apply ${sectionLabel} styling to all eligible captions in this clip`}
      >
        {isApplied ? (
          <>
            <CheckCheck size={15} className="text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">
              {successLabel || (label ? `Applied to all (${appliedCount})` : `Applied ${sectionLabel} to all (${appliedCount})`)}
            </span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <CheckCheck size={14} className="text-text-muted shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{label || `Apply ${sectionLabel} to All Text`}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

function applyColorOpacity(color: string, opacity: number = 1.0): string {
  if (opacity >= 1.0) return color;
  if (color.startsWith('#')) {
    const hex = color.slice(1);
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
    if (hex.length === 3) {
      r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
      g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
      b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
    } else if (hex.length >= 6) {
      r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
      g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
      b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
    }
    return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${opacity})`;
  }
  return color;
}

function getAaPreviewStyle(style: Partial<StyleConfig>) {
  const color = applyColorOpacity(style.primary_color || '#FFFFFF', style.text_opacity ?? 1.0);
  const strokeColor = applyColorOpacity(style.outline_color || '#000000', style.outline_opacity ?? 1.0);
  const stroke = style.outline_enabled
    ? `${Math.max(0.8, Math.min(1.5, (style.outline_width || 2) * 0.35))}px ${strokeColor}`
    : 'none';
  const shadows: string[] = [];
  if (style.glow_enabled && style.glow_color) {
    const glowColor = applyColorOpacity(style.glow_color, style.glow_opacity ?? 1.0);
    const blur = Math.min(14, style.glow_blur || 10);
    shadows.push(`0 0 ${Math.max(2, Math.round(blur * 0.35))}px ${glowColor}`);
    shadows.push(`0 0 ${blur}px ${glowColor}`);
  }
  if (style.shadow_enabled) {
    const dist = Math.min(3, style.shadow_distance || 2);
    const rad = ((style.shadow_angle || 45) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const x = Math.round(dist * Math.cos(rad));
    const y = Math.round(dist * Math.sin(rad));
    const shadowColor = applyColorOpacity(style.shadow_color || 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)', style.shadow_opacity ?? 0.85);
    shadows.push(`${x}px ${y}px ${Math.min(4, style.shadow_blur || 3)}px ${shadowColor}`);
  }
  const textShadow = shadows.length > 0 ? shadows.join(', ') : 'none';

  return {
    color,
    fontFamily: style.font_family || 'Impact, "Arial Black", Montserrat, sans-serif',
    fontWeight: (style.font_weight as any) || '900',
    WebkitTextStroke: stroke,
    paintOrder: 'stroke fill',
    textShadow,
  };
}

function formatTime(sec: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
  const ms = Math.floor((sec % 1) * 10);
  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}.${ms}`;
}

function ValueSlider({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  min,
  max,
  step = 1,
  unit = '',
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  onChange: (value: number) => void;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  unit?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1 py-1">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
        <span className="text-text-secondary font-medium">{label}</span>
        <span className="font-mono tabular-nums text-text-main font-semibold">
          {Number(value.toFixed(1))}{unit}
        </span>
      </div>
      <input
        type="range"
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
        className="w-full min-h-[32px] accent-primary cursor-pointer"
        aria-label={label}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// Flat, cardless CapCut tool button
function ToolButton({
  icon,
  label,
  onClick,
  active = false,
  disabled = false,
  title,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
  active?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  title?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-disabled={disabled}
      title={title || label}
      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[54px] h-12 px-1 text-center select-none transition-colors active:scale-95 shrink-0 ${
        disabled
          ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none'
          : active
          ? 'text-primary font-semibold'
          : 'text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main'
      }`}
    >
      <div className="h-5 flex items-center justify-center mb-0.5">
        {icon}
      </div>
      <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight font-medium truncate max-w-[52px]">
        {label}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

// CapCut-style dual-ring color row with independent selection indicator and custom color preview
function CapCutColorRow({
  label,
  value,
  defaultValue = '#FFFFFF',
  swatches = COLOR_SWATCHES,
  onChange,
  onOpenCustom,
  customTitle,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | undefined;
  defaultValue?: string;
  swatches?: string[];
  onChange: (color: string) => void;
  onOpenCustom: () => void;
  customTitle?: string;
}) {
  const effectiveVal = (value || defaultValue).trim();
  const normalizedVal = effectiveVal.toUpperCase();
  const matchedSwatch = swatches.find((s) => s.toUpperCase() === normalizedVal);
  const isCustom = !matchedSwatch;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-text-secondary">{label}</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums text-text-muted">{effectiveVal}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-1.5 px-0.5">
        {/* Custom color button with live preview indicator */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onOpenCustom}
          aria-pressed={isCustom}
          title={customTitle || `Custom ${label}`}
          className={`h-7 px-2.5 rounded-full border text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 active:scale-95 transition-all ${
            isCustom
              ? 'border-primary bg-primary/20 text-white ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#16191E] shadow-sm'
              : 'border-dashed border-border bg-surface-200 hover:bg-surface-300 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main'
          }`}
        >
          {isCustom ? (
            <span
              className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border border-white/50 shrink-0"
              style={{ backgroundColor: effectiveVal }}
            />
          ) : (
            <Plus size={11} className="text-primary shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span>Custom</span>
        </button>

        {/* Built-in swatches with CapCut dual-ring selection */}
        {swatches.map((c) => {
          const isSelected = !isCustom && matchedSwatch?.toUpperCase() === c.toUpperCase();
          return (
            <button
              key={c}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onChange(c)}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 transition-transform active:scale-90 ${
                isSelected
                  ? 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#16191E] scale-110 shadow-md'
                  : 'border border-white/10 hover:scale-105'
              }`}
              style={{ backgroundColor: c }}
              title={c}
              aria-label={`${label} ${c}`}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const CaptionStudioComponent: React.FC<CaptionStudioProps> = ({
  track,
  currentTime,
  duration = 40,
  selectedGroupId,
  isVideoSelected = false,
  layoutMode = 'crop_916',
  availableLayoutModes = [],
  mainVideoVolume = 100,
  isMainVideoMuted = false,
  activePanel: propActivePanel,
  onActivePanelChange,
  onUpdateMainVideoAudio,
  onSelectGroup,
  onSelectVideo,
  onUpdateTrack,
  onLayoutChange,
  onSeek,
  onPreviewAnimation,
  canUndo: _canUndo = false,
  canRedo: _canRedo = false,
  onUndo: _onUndo,
  onRedo: _onRedo,
}) => {
  const currentTimeRef = useRef(currentTime);
  currentTimeRef.current = currentTime;

  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<ToolbarCategory>('none');
  const [internalActivePanel, setInternalActivePanel] = useState<ActivePanel>('none');
  const activePanel = propActivePanel !== undefined ? propActivePanel : internalActivePanel;
  const setActivePanel = (panel: ActivePanel) => {
    setInternalActivePanel(panel);
    onActivePanelChange?.(panel);
  };
  const [styleTab, setStyleTab] = useState<StyleTab>('text');
  const [textMainTab, setTextMainTab] = useState<TextMainTab>('styles');
  const [loadingFontFamily, setLoadingFontFamily] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animCategory, setAnimCategory] = useState<'in' | 'out' | 'loop' | 'word'>('in');
  const [activeColorPicker, setActiveColorPicker] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    property: 'primary_color' | 'highlight_color' | 'outline_color' | 'glow_color' | 'shadow_color' | 'background_color';
    color: string;
    enableAlpha?: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const [overlayAnimTab, setOverlayAnimTab] = useState<'enter' | 'exit'>('enter');
  const isTranscriptOpen = activePanel === 'transcript';
  const setIsTranscriptOpen = (open: boolean) => setActivePanel(open ? 'transcript' : 'none');
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [fontCatalog, setFontCatalog] = useState<FontEntry[]>(CURATED_FONTS);
  const [fontSearch, setFontSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedFontCategory, setSelectedFontCategory] = useState<FontCategoryKey>('all');
  const [recentFonts, setRecentFonts] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [favoriteFonts, setFavoriteFonts] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [fontImportError, setFontImportError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isImportingFont, setIsImportingFont] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const fontFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (activePanel === 'templates') setTextMainTab('templates');
    else if (activePanel === 'animation') setTextMainTab('animations');
    else if (activePanel === 'fonts') setTextMainTab('fonts');
    else if (activePanel === 'effects') setTextMainTab('effects');
    else if (activePanel === 'style') setTextMainTab('styles');
  }, [activePanel]);

  // Global Undo / Redo keyboard shortcuts
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (e.target as HTMLElement)?.tagName?.toLowerCase();
      if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || (e.target as HTMLElement)?.isContentEditable) return;
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey) {
        if (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') {
          if (e.shiftKey) {
            if (_canRedo && _onRedo) {
              e.preventDefault();
              _onRedo();
            }
          } else {
            if (_canUndo && _onUndo) {
              e.preventDefault();
              _onUndo();
            }
          }
        } else if (e.key === 'y' || e.key === 'Y') {
          if (_canRedo && _onRedo) {
            e.preventDefault();
            _onRedo();
          }
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [_canUndo, _canRedo, _onUndo, _onRedo]);

  // Active selected group
  const currentGroup = useMemo(() => {
    if (!track || !track.groups || track.groups.length === 0) return null;
    if (selectedGroupId) {
      return track.groups.find((g) => g.id === selectedGroupId) || null;
    }
    return null;
  }, [track, selectedGroupId]);

  // Enforce valid text layer selection: must be an active group of type caption or text
  const isTextLayerSelected = Boolean(
    currentGroup && (!currentGroup.type || currentGroup.type === 'caption' || currentGroup.type === 'text')
  );
  const isCaption = Boolean(currentGroup && (!currentGroup.type || currentGroup.type === 'caption'));
  const isNormalText = Boolean(currentGroup && currentGroup.type === 'text');

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isNormalText && animCategory === 'word') {
      setAnimCategory('in');
    }
  }, [isNormalText, animCategory]);

  // Auto-close styling/font/animation/transform panels if layer was deselected
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTextLayerSelected && [
      'style',
      'fonts',
      'effects',
      'animation',
      'templates',
      'overlay_transform',
      'overlay_animation',
      'layer_opacity',
      'layer_volume',
    ].includes(activePanel)) {
      setActivePanel('none');
    }
  }, [isTextLayerSelected, activePanel]);

  // Active text layer content synchronized draft
  const currentGroupText = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentGroup || !currentGroup.words) return '';
    return currentGroup.words.map((w) => w.text || (w as any).word || '').join(' ');
  }, [currentGroup?.id, currentGroup?.words]);

  const [textInputDraft, setTextInputDraft] = useState('');
  const [isInputFocused, setIsInputFocused] = useState(false);
  const [isKeyboardVisible, setIsKeyboardVisible] = useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.visualViewport) return;
    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    const handleResize = () => {
      const isSmaller = vv.height < window.innerHeight * 0.75;
      setIsKeyboardVisible(isSmaller);
    };
    vv.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => vv.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  const hideTabsForKeyboard = isInputFocused || isKeyboardVisible;

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setTextInputDraft(currentGroupText);
  }, [currentGroup?.id, currentGroupText]);

  const handleTextDraftChange = (newVal: string) => {
    setTextInputDraft(newVal);
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const nextWords = preserveWordTimingsOnEdit(
      currentGroup.words || [],
      newVal,
      currentGroup.start,
      currentGroup.end,
      currentGroup.id
    );
    const updatedGroup = { ...currentGroup, words: nextWords };
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map(g => g.id === currentGroup.id ? updatedGroup : g)
    }, false);
  };

  const handleTextDraftCommit = () => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const nextWords = preserveWordTimingsOnEdit(
      currentGroup.words || [],
      textInputDraft,
      currentGroup.start,
      currentGroup.end,
      currentGroup.id
    );
    const updatedGroup = { ...currentGroup, words: nextWords };
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map(g => g.id === currentGroup.id ? updatedGroup : g)
    }, true);
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setRecentFonts(getRecentFonts());
    setFavoriteFonts(getFavoriteFonts());
    fetchFontCatalog().then((catalog) => {
      if (catalog && catalog.length > 0) {
        setFontCatalog(catalog);
        catalog.forEach((f) => {
          if (f.url) loadFontFace(f.family, f.url).catch(() => {});
        });
      }
    });
  }, []);

  // Derive current effective category:
  // If layer selected, it automatically determines category (overlay / audio / text)
  // If video selected, it's 'edit'
  // Else uses activeCategory
  const effectiveCategory: ToolbarCategory = useMemo(() => {
    if (currentGroup) {
      if (currentGroup.type === 'overlay') return 'overlay';
      if (currentGroup.type === 'audio' || currentGroup.type === 'voiceover') return 'audio';
      return 'text';
    }
    if (isVideoSelected) return 'edit';
    return activeCategory;
  }, [currentGroup, isVideoSelected, activeCategory]);

  const currentStyle = currentGroup?.style || track?.default_style;
  const currentLayout = currentGroup?.layout || track?.default_layout;
  const currentAnimation = currentGroup?.animation || track?.default_animation;

  // Patch function for captions/text: edits affect ONLY the selected group
  // Never fall back to track.groups[0] and never silently mutate default_style
  const patch = (
    stylePatch?: Partial<StyleConfig>,
    layoutPatch?: Partial<LayoutConfig>,
    animationPatch?: Partial<AnimationConfig>,
    commitToHistory: boolean = false
  ) => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup || !isTextLayerSelected) return;

    const nextTrack: CaptionTrack = {
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((grp) => {
        if (grp.id !== currentGroup.id) return grp;
        return {
          ...grp,
          style: stylePatch ? { ...(grp.style || track.default_style || {}), ...stylePatch } : grp.style,
          layout: layoutPatch ? { ...(grp.layout || track.default_layout || {}), ...layoutPatch } : grp.layout,
          animation: animationPatch
            ? { ...(grp.animation || track.default_animation || {}), ...animationPatch }
            : grp.animation,
        };
      }),
    };

    onUpdateTrack(nextTrack, commitToHistory);
  };

  const handleSelectTextMainTab = (tab: TextMainTab) => {
    // Non-template tabs require an active text layer
    if (!isTextLayerSelected && tab !== 'templates') return;
    setTextMainTab(tab);
    if (tab === 'templates') setActivePanel('templates');
    else if (tab === 'animations') setActivePanel('animation');
    else if (tab === 'fonts') setActivePanel('fonts');
    else if (tab === 'effects') setActivePanel('effects');
    else setActivePanel('style');
  };

  // One-time action: Applies ONLY the properties belonging to the specified section to all eligible text/caption elements.
  const handleApplySectionToAll = (section: StyleSection): number => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup || !isTextLayerSelected) return 0;
    const { nextTrack, affectedCount } = applySectionStylesToTrack(
      track,
      currentGroup.id,
      section
    );
    // Explicitly commit to undo/redo history as an intentional user action
    onUpdateTrack(nextTrack, true);
    return affectedCount;
  };

  const handleSelectFont = async (f: FontEntry) => {
    addRecentFont(f.family);
    setRecentFonts(getRecentFonts());
    if (f.url) {
      setLoadingFontFamily(f.family);
      try {
        await loadFontFace(f.family, f.url);
      } catch {
        // ignore
      } finally {
        setLoadingFontFamily(null);
      }
    }
    const nextWeight = getClosestSupportedWeight(f.family, currentStyle?.font_weight, fontCatalog);
    patch({ font_family: f.family, font_weight: nextWeight }, undefined, undefined, true);
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = (e: React.MouseEvent, family: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    toggleFavoriteFont(family);
    setFavoriteFonts(getFavoriteFonts());
  };

  const handleImportFont = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setFontImportError(null);
    setIsImportingFont(true);
    try {
      const newEntry = await importCustomFontFile(file);
      setFontCatalog((prev) => [newEntry, ...prev.filter((f) => f.family !== newEntry.family)]);
      addRecentFont(newEntry.family);
      setRecentFonts(getRecentFonts());
      patch({ font_family: newEntry.family, font_weight: newEntry.weights[0] || '400' }, undefined, undefined, true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setFontImportError(err.message || 'Failed to import font');
    } finally {
      setIsImportingFont(false);
      if (fontFileInputRef.current) {
        fontFileInputRef.current.value = '';
      }
    }
  };

  const filteredFonts = useMemo(() => {
    const list = fontCatalog.filter((f) => {
      if (selectedFontCategory === 'favorites') {
        return favoriteFonts.some((fav) => fav.toLowerCase() === f.family.toLowerCase());
      }
      if (selectedFontCategory === 'custom' && !f.isCustom) return false;
      if (selectedFontCategory !== 'all' && selectedFontCategory !== 'custom' && (selectedFontCategory as string) !== 'favorites' && (f.categoryKey as string) !== (selectedFontCategory as string)) return false;
      if (fontSearch.trim()) {
        const q = fontSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
        return f.family.toLowerCase().includes(q) || f.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }
      return true;
    });

    // Starred fonts automatically appear first in the Fonts grid, followed by unstarred fonts
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
      const aFav = favoriteFonts.some((fav) => fav.toLowerCase() === a.family.toLowerCase());
      const bFav = favoriteFonts.some((fav) => fav.toLowerCase() === b.family.toLowerCase());
      if (aFav && !bFav) return -1;
      if (!aFav && bFav) return 1;
      return 0;
    });
  }, [fontCatalog, selectedFontCategory, fontSearch, favoriteFonts]);

  const selectedFontEntry = useMemo(() => {
    const curFam = currentStyle?.font_family || 'Montserrat';
    return fontCatalog.find((f) => f.family.toLowerCase() === curFam.toLowerCase()) || CURATED_FONTS[0];
  }, [fontCatalog, currentStyle?.font_family]);

  const supportedWeights = useMemo(() => {
    return selectedFontEntry?.weights && selectedFontEntry.weights.length > 0
      ? selectedFontEntry.weights
      : ['400'];
  }, [selectedFontEntry]);

  // Return to primary toolbar: deselects layer/video and restores primary toolbar
  const handleBackToPrimary = () => {
    setActiveCategory('none');
    setActivePanel('none');
    onSelectGroup?.(null);
    onSelectVideo?.(false);
  };

  // Add new text layer
  const handleAddText = () => {
    if (!track) return;
    const newId = `grp_${Date.now()}`;
    const start = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
    const end = Number(Math.min(duration, start + 3.0).toFixed(2));
    const newGroup: CaptionGroup = {
      id: newId,
      start,
      end,
      type: 'text',
      words: [
        { id: `w_${Date.now()}_0`, text: 'New', start, end: start + 1.0 },
        { id: `w_${Date.now()}_1`, text: 'Text', start: start + 1.0, end },
      ],
      layout: { ...(track.default_layout || { position_x: 0.5, position_y: 0.5, alignment: 'center', max_width: 0.88, max_lines: 2 }) },
      style: {
        ...(track.default_style || {
          font_family: 'Montserrat',
          font_size: 44,
          font_weight: '900',
          text_transform: 'none',
          letter_spacing: 0,
          line_height: 1.2,
          primary_color: '#FFFFFF',
          outline_enabled: true,
          outline_color: '#000000',
          outline_width: 2,
          shadow_enabled: false,
          background_enabled: false,
        }),
        highlight_enabled: false,
      },
      animation: {
        type: 'none',
        duration_ms: 150,
        active_scale: 1.0,
        easing: 'ease_out',
        enter: { type: 'none', duration_ms: 150 },
        exit: { type: 'none', duration_ms: 150 },
        loop: { type: 'none', speed_ms: 1000 },
      },
    };

    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: [...track.groups, newGroup],
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(newId);
    setActiveCategory('text');
  };

  // Media Upload helper for durable storage in CLIPS_DIR
  const uploadMediaFile = async (file: File | Blob, filename: string): Promise<string> => {
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file, filename);
      const res = await fetch('/api/media/upload', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.url) return data.url;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Upload to /api/media/upload failed, falling back to blob URL:', e);
    }
    return URL.createObjectURL(file);
  };

  // Native file picker selection for Add Overlay
  const handleOverlayFileSelect = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !track) return;
    const isVideo = file.type.startsWith('video');
    const mediaUrl = await uploadMediaFile(file, file.name);
    const newId = `ovl_${Date.now()}`;
    const start = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
    const end = Number(Math.min(duration, start + (isVideo ? 8.0 : 4.0)).toFixed(2));
    const cleanName = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').slice(0, 16);

    const newOverlay: CaptionGroup = {
      id: newId,
      start,
      end,
      type: 'overlay',
      overlay_type: isVideo ? 'video' : 'image',
      overlay_url: mediaUrl,
      label: cleanName || (isVideo ? 'Video Clip' : 'Image Overlay'),
      opacity: 100,
      volume: isVideo ? 100 : 0,
      is_muted: false,
      layout: {
        position_x: 0.5,
        position_y: 0.5,
        scale: 0.8,
        rotation: 0,
        alignment: 'center',
        max_width: 0.8,
        max_lines: 1,
      },
      words: [], // Honest non-text media layer
    };

    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: [...track.groups, newOverlay],
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(newId);
    setActiveCategory('overlay');
    // Clear value so user can pick same file again if desired
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  // Add BGM audio layer
  const audioFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const handleAudioFileSelect = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !track) return;
    const mediaUrl = await uploadMediaFile(file, file.name);
    const newId = `aud_${Date.now()}`;
    const start = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
    const end = Number(Math.min(duration, start + 15.0).toFixed(2));
    const cleanName = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').slice(0, 20);

    const newAudio: CaptionGroup = {
      id: newId,
      start,
      end,
      type: 'audio',
      audio_url: mediaUrl,
      label: cleanName || 'BGM Track',
      volume: 100,
      is_muted: false,
      words: [], // Honest non-text media layer
    };

    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: [...track.groups, newAudio],
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(newId);
    setActiveCategory('audio');
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleImportAudio = () => {
    if (audioFileInputRef.current) {
      audioFileInputRef.current.click();
    } else if (track) {
      // Direct fallback if file input not mounted
      const newId = `aud_${Date.now()}`;
      const start = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
      const end = Number(Math.min(duration, start + 15.0).toFixed(2));
      const newAudio: CaptionGroup = {
        id: newId,
        start,
        end,
        type: 'audio',
        label: 'Audio Track',
        volume: 100,
        is_muted: false,
        words: [],
      };
      onUpdateTrack({ ...track, groups: [...track.groups, newAudio] }, true);
      onSelectGroup?.(newId);
      setActiveCategory('audio');
    }
  };

  // Add Voiceover audio layer with real microphone recorder
  const [isRecordingVoiceover, setIsRecordingVoiceover] = useState(false);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  const handleRecordVoiceover = async () => {
    if (isRecordingVoiceover) {
      if (mediaRecorderRef.current) {
        mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
        setIsRecordingVoiceover(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      alert('Microphone recording is not supported in this browser.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
        if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) {
          audioChunksRef.current.push(e.data);
        }
      };
      recorder.onstop = async () => {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        const blob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        if (blob.size === 0 || !track) return;
        const filename = `voiceover_${Date.now()}.webm`;
        const mediaUrl = await uploadMediaFile(blob, filename);
        const newId = `voc_${Date.now()}`;
        const start = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
        const end = Number(Math.min(duration, start + Math.max(1, audioChunksRef.current.length * 0.5)).toFixed(2));

        const newVoice: CaptionGroup = {
          id: newId,
          start,
          end,
          type: 'voiceover',
          audio_url: mediaUrl,
          label: 'Voiceover',
          volume: 100,
          is_muted: false,
          words: [], // Honest non-text media layer
        };

        onUpdateTrack({
          ...track,
          groups: [...track.groups, newVoice],
        }, true);
        onSelectGroup?.(newId);
        setActiveCategory('audio');
      };

      recorder.start(500);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;
      setIsRecordingVoiceover(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Microphone permission denied or error:', err);
      alert('Microphone access unavailable or denied.');
    }
  };

  // Split layer at playhead preserving authentic word timestamps
  const handleSplit = () => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    const splitTime = Number(currentTimeRef.current.toFixed(2));
    const splitResult = splitCaptionGroupAtTime(currentGroup, splitTime);
    if (!splitResult) return;

    const [firstGroup, secondGroup] = splitResult;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.flatMap((g) => (g.id === currentGroup.id ? [firstGroup, secondGroup] : [g])),
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(secondGroup.id);
  };

  // Merge selected group with adjacent segment of compatible type
  const handleMergeNext = () => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    const groupType = currentGroup.type || 'caption';
    const sorted = [...track.groups]
      .filter((g) => (g.type || 'caption') === groupType)
      .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
    const currIdx = sorted.findIndex((g) => g.id === currentGroup.id);
    if (currIdx < 0 || currIdx >= sorted.length - 1) return;

    const nextGroup = sorted[currIdx + 1];
    // Adjacency check: within 3 seconds
    if (nextGroup.start > currentGroup.end + 3.0) return;

    const merged = mergeAdjacentCaptionGroups(currentGroup, nextGroup);

    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups
        .filter((g) => g.id !== nextGroup.id)
        .map((g) => (g.id === currentGroup.id ? merged : g)),
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(merged.id);
  };

  // Duplicate layer with time-shifted authentic word timestamps
  const handleDuplicate = () => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    const isOverlay = currentGroup.type === 'overlay';
    const newId = `${isOverlay ? 'ovl' : 'grp'}_${Date.now()}`;
    const nextStart = Number(Math.min(duration - 0.5, currentGroup.start + 0.3).toFixed(2));
    const nextEnd = Number(Math.min(duration, currentGroup.end + 0.3).toFixed(2));
    const timeDelta = nextStart - currentGroup.start;

    const dup: CaptionGroup = {
      ...currentGroup,
      id: newId,
      start: nextStart,
      end: nextEnd,
      words: (currentGroup.words || []).map((w, idx) => ({
        ...w,
        id: `w_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,
        start: Number((w.start + timeDelta).toFixed(3)),
        end: Number((w.end + timeDelta).toFixed(3)),
      })),
    };

    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: [...track.groups, dup],
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(newId);
  };

  // Delete layer
  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.filter((g) => g.id !== currentGroup.id),
    }, true);
    onSelectGroup?.(null);
  };

  // Span layer across entire video duration
  const handleLastingText = () => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
        g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, start: 0, end: Number(duration.toFixed(2)) } : g
      ),
    }, true);
  };

  // Export SRT download
  const handleExportSrt = () => {
    if (track) {
      downloadSrtFile(track, track.clip_id ? `${track.clip_id}.srt` : 'captions.srt');
    }
  };

  // Reorder stacking layers
  const handleMoveLayer = (direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    if (!track || !currentGroup) return;
    const idx = track.groups.findIndex((g) => g.id === currentGroup.id);
    if (idx === -1) return;
    const targetIdx = direction === 'up' ? idx + 1 : idx - 1;
    if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= track.groups.length) return;

    const copy = [...track.groups];
    const [removed] = copy.splice(idx, 1);
    copy.splice(targetIdx, 0, removed);
    onUpdateTrack({ ...track, groups: copy });
  };

  // Overlay Transform Actions
  const handleRotate90 = () => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const curRot = currentGroup.layout?.rotation || 0;
    const nextRot = (curRot + 90) % 360;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
        g.id === currentGroup.id
          ? { ...g, layout: { ...(g.layout || track.default_layout), rotation: nextRot } }
          : g
      ),
    });
  };

  const handleToggleFlipH = () => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const nextFlipH = !currentGroup.flip_h;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) => (g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, flip_h: nextFlipH } : g)),
    });
  };

  const handleToggleFlipV = () => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const nextFlipV = !currentGroup.flip_v;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) => (g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, flip_v: nextFlipV } : g)),
    });
  };

  const handleResetTransform = () => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
        g.id === currentGroup.id
          ? {
              ...g,
              flip_h: false,
              flip_v: false,
              layout: {
                ...(g.layout || track.default_layout),
                scale: 1.0,
                rotation: 0,
                position_x: 0.5,
                position_y: 0.5,
              },
            }
          : g
      ),
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateOverlayAnimation = (patchAnim: Partial<OverlayAnimationConfig>) => {
    if (!currentGroup || !track) return;
    const curAnim = currentGroup.overlay_animation || {};
    onUpdateTrack({
      ...track,
      groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
        g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, overlay_animation: { ...curAnim, ...patchAnim } } : g
      ),
    });
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // EXPANDED WORKSPACE PANELS (Edge-to-Edge, Continuous Dark Surface)
  // =========================================================================

  // 1. OVERLAY TRANSFORM PANEL
  if (activePanel === 'overlay_transform' && currentGroup) {
    const curLayout = currentGroup.layout || track?.default_layout || { scale: 1.0, rotation: 0 };
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#16191E] flex flex-col p-3 space-y-2 select-none overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-150">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-[#232832] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            <span>Tools</span>
          </button>
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-main">Overlay Transform</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95"
            title="Done"
          >
            <Check size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar space-y-2.5 py-1">
          {/* Quick Buttons: Rotate 90, Flip H, Flip V, Reset */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRotate90}
              className="h-9 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 border border-border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-medium text-text-main hover:bg-surface-300 active:scale-95"
            >
              <RotateCw size={13} className="text-primary mb-0.5" />
              <span>Rotate 90°</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleFlipH}
              className={`h-9 rounded-lg border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors active:scale-95 ${
                currentGroup.flip_h ? 'bg-primary/20 border-primary text-white' : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-main'
              }`}
            >
              <FlipHorizontal size={13} className="mb-0.5" />
              <span>Flip H</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleFlipV}
              className={`h-9 rounded-lg border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors active:scale-95 ${
                currentGroup.flip_v ? 'bg-primary/20 border-primary text-white' : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-main'
              }`}
            >
              <FlipVertical size={13} className="mb-0.5" />
              <span>Flip V</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleResetTransform}
              className="h-9 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 border border-border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-medium text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main active:scale-95"
            >
              <RotateCcw size={13} className="mb-0.5" />
              <span>Reset</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <ValueSlider
            label="Scale / Size"
            value={curLayout.scale ?? 1.0}
            min={0.2}
            max={2.5}
            step={0.05}
            unit="x"
            onChange={(val) => {
              if (!track) return;
              onUpdateTrack({
                ...track,
                groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
                  g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, layout: { ...(g.layout || track.default_layout), scale: val } } : g
                ),
              });
            }}
          />

          <ValueSlider
            label="Rotation"
            value={curLayout.rotation ?? 0}
            min={-180}
            max={180}
            step={1}
            unit="°"
            onChange={(val) => {
              if (!track) return;
              onUpdateTrack({
                ...track,
                groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
                  g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, layout: { ...(g.layout || track.default_layout), rotation: val } } : g
                ),
              });
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 2. OVERLAY ANIMATION PANEL
  if (activePanel === 'overlay_animation' && currentGroup) {
    const curAnim = currentGroup.overlay_animation || {};
    const enterChoices = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None' },
      { id: 'fade', label: 'Fade In' },
      { id: 'pop', label: 'Pop / Zoom' },
      { id: 'scale', label: 'Scale Up' },
      { id: 'slide_up', label: 'Slide Up' },
      { id: 'slide_down', label: 'Slide Down' },
      { id: 'slide_left', label: 'Slide Left' },
      { id: 'slide_right', label: 'Slide Right' },
    ];
    const exitChoices = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None' },
      { id: 'fade', label: 'Fade Out' },
      { id: 'scale_down', label: 'Scale Down' },
      { id: 'slide_up', label: 'Slide Up' },
      { id: 'slide_down', label: 'Slide Down' },
      { id: 'slide_left', label: 'Slide Left' },
      { id: 'slide_right', label: 'Slide Right' },
    ];

    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#16191E] flex flex-col p-3 space-y-2 select-none overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-150">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-[#232832] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            <span>Tools</span>
          </button>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOverlayAnimTab('enter')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                overlayAnimTab === 'enter' ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary'
              }`}
            >
              In (Entrance)
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOverlayAnimTab('exit')}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                overlayAnimTab === 'exit' ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'text-text-muted hover:text-text-secondary'
              }`}
            >
              Out (Exit)
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95"
            title="Done"
          >
            <Check size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar space-y-2 py-1">
          {overlayAnimTab === 'enter' ? (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                {enterChoices.map((c) => (
                  <button
                    key={c.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleUpdateOverlayAnimation({ enter: c.id as any })}
                    className={`h-9 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                      (curAnim.enter || 'none') === c.id
                        ? 'bg-primary/20 border-primary text-white font-bold'
                        : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {c.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <ValueSlider
                label="Entrance Duration"
                value={(curAnim.enter_duration_ms || 400) / 1000}
                min={0.1}
                max={2.0}
                step={0.1}
                unit="s"
                onChange={(val) => handleUpdateOverlayAnimation({ enter_duration_ms: Math.round(val * 1000) })}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                {exitChoices.map((c) => (
                  <button
                    key={c.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleUpdateOverlayAnimation({ exit: c.id as any })}
                    className={`h-9 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                      (curAnim.exit || 'none') === c.id
                        ? 'bg-primary/20 border-primary text-white font-bold'
                        : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {c.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <ValueSlider
                label="Exit Duration"
                value={(curAnim.exit_duration_ms || 400) / 1000}
                min={0.1}
                max={2.0}
                step={0.1}
                unit="s"
                onChange={(val) => handleUpdateOverlayAnimation({ exit_duration_ms: Math.round(val * 1000) })}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 3. LAYER OPACITY PANEL
  if (activePanel === 'layer_opacity' && currentGroup) {
    const curOpacity = currentGroup.opacity ?? 100;
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#16191E] flex flex-col p-3 space-y-2 select-none overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-150">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-[#232832] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            <span>Tools</span>
          </button>
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-main">Overlay Opacity</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95"
            title="Done"
          >
            <Check size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col justify-center py-4">
          <ValueSlider
            label="Opacity"
            value={curOpacity}
            min={0}
            max={100}
            step={1}
            unit="%"
            onChange={(val) => {
              if (!track) return;
              onUpdateTrack({
                ...track,
                groups: track.groups.map((g) => (g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, opacity: val } : g)),
              });
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 4. LAYER VOLUME PANEL (For Video Overlay or Audio Layers)
  if (activePanel === 'layer_volume' && currentGroup) {
    const layerVol = currentGroup.volume ?? 100;
    const layerMuted = currentGroup.is_muted ?? false;

    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#16191E] flex flex-col p-3 space-y-2 select-none overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-150">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-[#232832] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            <span>Tools</span>
          </button>
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-main">Layer Audio</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95"
            title="Done"
          >
            <Check size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar space-y-2 py-1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (!track) return;
                onUpdateTrack({
                  ...track,
                  groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
                    g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, is_muted: !layerMuted } : g
                  ),
                });
              }}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                layerMuted ? 'bg-red-500/20 border-red-500 text-red-300' : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-main'
              }`}
            >
              {layerMuted ? <VolumeX size={15} /> : <Volume2 size={15} />}
              <span>{layerMuted ? 'Muted' : 'Unmuted'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <ValueSlider
            label="Layer Volume"
            value={layerVol}
            min={0}
            max={200}
            unit="%"
            onChange={(val) => {
              if (!track) return;
              onUpdateTrack({
                ...track,
                groups: track.groups.map((g) =>
                  g.id === currentGroup.id ? { ...g, volume: val } : g
                ),
              });
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 5. MAIN VIDEO VOLUME PANEL
  if (activePanel === 'main_volume') {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#16191E] flex flex-col p-3 space-y-2 select-none overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-150">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-[#232832] shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main"
          >
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            <span>Tools</span>
          </button>
          <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-text-main">Main Video Audio</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActivePanel('none')}
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95"
            title="Done"
          >
            <Check size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar space-y-2 py-1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onUpdateMainVideoAudio?.(mainVideoVolume, !isMainVideoMuted)}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                isMainVideoMuted ? 'bg-red-500/20 border-red-500 text-red-300' : 'bg-surface-200 border-border text-text-main'
              }`}
            >
              {isMainVideoMuted ? <VolumeX size={15} /> : <Volume2 size={15} />}
              <span>{isMainVideoMuted ? 'Muted' : 'Unmuted'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <ValueSlider
            label="Video Volume"
            value={mainVideoVolume}
            min={0}
            max={200}
            unit="%"
            onChange={(val) => onUpdateMainVideoAudio?.(val, isMainVideoMuted)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 6. UNIFIED TEXT & STYLE DRAWER (Templates | Fonts | Styles | Effects | Animations)
  const isTextDrawerOpen =
    activePanel === 'style' ||
    activePanel === 'fonts' ||
    activePanel === 'effects' ||
    activePanel === 'templates' ||
    activePanel === 'animation';

  if (isTextDrawerOpen) {
    const enterEffects = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None', desc: 'Static' },
      { id: 'fade', label: 'Fade In', desc: 'Smooth opacity ramp' },
      { id: 'pop', label: 'Pop In', desc: 'Spring scale bounce' },
      { id: 'slide_up', label: 'Slide Up', desc: 'Rise from below' },
    ];

    const exitEffects = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None', desc: 'Static' },
      { id: 'fade', label: 'Fade Out', desc: 'Smooth opacity exit' },
      { id: 'scale_down', label: 'Scale Down', desc: 'Shrink away' },
      { id: 'slide_down', label: 'Slide Down', desc: 'Drop down' },
    ];

    const loopEffects = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None', desc: 'Static' },
      { id: 'pulse', label: 'Pulse', desc: 'Rhythmic breathing' },
      { id: 'wiggle', label: 'Wiggle', desc: 'Playful subtle tilt' },
    ];

    const wordEffects = [
      { id: 'none', label: 'None', desc: 'No word pop' },
      { id: 'pop', label: 'Pop Scale', desc: 'Active word punch' },
      { id: 'bounce', label: 'Punch Jump', desc: 'Active word bounce' },
