import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, Word, StyleConfig, LayoutConfig, AnimationConfig } from './types';
import { partitionWordsIntoVisualLines } from './linePartition';

interface DispatchCaptionRendererProps {
  track: CaptionTrack | null;
  currentTime: number;          // Current playback seconds with high precision
  containerWidth?: number;      // Optional width for resolution-independent scaling
  containerHeight?: number;     // Optional height for resolution-independent scaling
  layoutMode?: string;          // 'fit_black', 'fit_blur', 'crop_follow', 'landscape'
  showBoundingBox?: boolean;    // CapCut-style active selection box
}

export function applyColorOpacity(color: string, opacity: number = 1.0): string {
  if (!color) return color;
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, opacity));
  if (clamped >= 0.999 && !color.startsWith('#') && !color.startsWith('rgb')) return color;
  if (color.startsWith('#')) {
    let hex = color.slice(1);
    if (hex.length === 3) hex = hex.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('');
    if (hex.length >= 6) {
      const r = parseInt(hex.substring(0, 2), 16) || 0;
      const g = parseInt(hex.substring(2, 4), 16) || 0;
      const b = parseInt(hex.substring(4, 6), 16) || 0;
      let a = 1.0;
      if (hex.length === 8) a = (parseInt(hex.substring(6, 8), 16) || 255) / 255;
      return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${Number((a * clamped).toFixed(3))})`;
    }
  }
  const rgbaMatch = color.match(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)(?:\s*,\s*([\d.]+))?\s*\)/);
  if (rgbaMatch) {
    const r = rgbaMatch[1];
    const g = rgbaMatch[2];
    const b = rgbaMatch[3];
    const a = rgbaMatch[4] !== undefined ? parseFloat(rgbaMatch[4]) : 1.0;
    return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${Number((a * clamped).toFixed(3))})`;
  }
  return color;
}

export function applyCaseTransform(text: string, mode?: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  if (mode === 'uppercase') return text.toUpperCase();
  if (mode === 'lowercase') return text.toLowerCase();
  if (mode === 'title') {
    return text.split(' ').map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1).toLowerCase()).join(' ');
  }
  return text;
}

interface CaptionGroupItemProps {
  group: CaptionGroup;
  defaultStyle: StyleConfig;
  defaultLayout: LayoutConfig;
  defaultAnimation: AnimationConfig;
  currentTime: number;
  containerWidth?: number;
  layoutMode: string;
  showBoundingBox: boolean;
}

const CaptionGroupItem: React.FC<CaptionGroupItemProps> = React.memo(({
  group,
  defaultStyle,
  defaultLayout,
  defaultAnimation,
  currentTime,
  containerWidth,
  layoutMode,
  showBoundingBox,
}) => {
  const style = group.style || defaultStyle;
  const layout = group.layout || defaultLayout;
  const anim = group.animation || defaultAnimation;

  // Layer type awareness: strictly separate caption from normal text behavior
  const isCaption = (group.type || 'caption') === 'caption';
  const highlightEnabled = isCaption && (style.highlight_enabled !== false);

  // Determine vertical placement percentage based on layout mode
  let posY = layout.position_y ?? 0.78;
  if (isCaption) {
    if (layoutMode === 'fit_black' || layoutMode === 'fit_blur') {
      posY = Math.max(0.74, posY);
    } else if (layoutMode === 'landscape') {
      posY = Math.min(0.86, Math.max(0.70, posY));
    }
  }

  // Entrance, exit, and loop animation calculations
  let enterOpacity = 1.0;
  let enterTransform = '';
  const enterType = anim.enter?.type || (anim as any)?.enter_type || 'none';
  const enterDur = (anim.enter?.duration_ms || (anim as any)?.enter_duration_ms || 200) / 1000;
  const enterElapsed = currentTime - group.start;
  if (enterType !== 'none' && enterElapsed >= 0 && enterElapsed < enterDur) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, enterElapsed / enterDur));
    if (enterType === 'fade') enterOpacity = p;
    else if (enterType === 'pop') {
      enterOpacity = Math.min(1, p * 2);
      enterTransform = `scale(${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI / 2)})`;
    } else if (enterType === 'slide_up') {
      enterOpacity = p;
      enterTransform = `translateY(${(1 - p) * 25}px)`;
    }
  }

  let exitOpacity = 1.0;
  let exitTransform = '';
  const exitType = anim.exit?.type || (anim as any)?.exit_type || 'none';
  const exitDur = (anim.exit?.duration_ms || (anim as any)?.exit_duration_ms || 150) / 1000;
  const exitRemaining = group.end - currentTime;
  if (exitType !== 'none' && exitRemaining >= 0 && exitRemaining < exitDur) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, exitRemaining / exitDur));
    if (exitType === 'fade') exitOpacity = p;
    else if (exitType === 'scale_down') {
      exitOpacity = p;
      exitTransform = `scale(${0.5 + 0.5 * p})`;
    } else if (exitType === 'slide_down') {
      exitOpacity = p;
      exitTransform = `translateY(${(1 - p) * 25}px)`;
    }
  }

  let loopTransform = '';
  const loopType = (anim as any)?.loop?.type || (anim as any)?.loop_type || 'none';
  if (loopType === 'pulse') {
    const speed = ((anim as any)?.loop?.speed_ms || 1000) / 1000;
    const loopTime = (currentTime - group.start) / speed;
    loopTransform = `scale(${1.0 + 0.04 * Math.sin(loopTime * 2 * Math.PI)})`;
  } else if (loopType === 'wiggle') {
    const speed = ((anim as any)?.loop?.speed_ms || 1000) / 1000;
    const loopTime = (currentTime - group.start) / speed;
    loopTransform = `rotate(${2.0 * Math.sin(loopTime * 2 * Math.PI)}deg)`;
  }

  const baseScale = layout.scale ?? 1.0;
  const baseRot = layout.rotation ?? 0;
  const animTransform = [enterTransform, exitTransform, loopTransform].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  const combinedTransform = `translate(-50%, -50%) scale(${baseScale}) rotate(${baseRot}deg) ${animTransform}`.trim();
  const effectiveOpacity = (style.opacity ?? 1) * Math.min(enterOpacity, exitOpacity);

  // Shadow angle and distance calculations
  let shadowX = style.shadow_offset_x || 0;
  let shadowY = style.shadow_offset_y || 2;
  if (style.shadow_distance !== undefined && style.shadow_angle !== undefined) {
    const rad = (style.shadow_angle * Math.PI) / 180;
    shadowX = Math.round(style.shadow_distance * Math.cos(rad) * 10) / 10;
    shadowY = Math.round(style.shadow_distance * Math.sin(rad) * 10) / 10;
  }
  const shadowColor = applyColorOpacity(style.shadow_color || 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)', style.shadow_opacity ?? 1.0);
  const glowColor = applyColorOpacity(style.glow_color || '#00F0FF', style.glow_opacity ?? 1.0);

  // Filters for glow and shadow
  const filters: string[] = [];
  if (style.shadow_enabled) {
    filters.push(`drop-shadow(${shadowX}px ${shadowY}px ${style.shadow_blur || 6}px ${shadowColor})`);
  }
  if (style.glow_enabled) {
    filters.push(`drop-shadow(0px 0px ${style.glow_blur || 12}px ${glowColor})`);
  }
  const filterStr = filters.length > 0 ? filters.join(' ') : undefined;

  // Background styling mode: 'none' | 'line' / 'per_line' | 'block' / 'full_box'
  const bgEnabled = style.background_enabled !== false && style.background_mode !== 'none';
  const rawBgMode = bgEnabled ? (style.background_mode || 'block') : 'none';
  const isBgBlock = rawBgMode === 'block' || (rawBgMode as string) === 'full_box';
  const isBgLine = rawBgMode === 'line' || (rawBgMode as string) === 'per_line';
  const effectiveBgColor = applyColorOpacity(style.background_color || '#000000', style.background_opacity ?? 1.0);

  const bgOffsetX = (isBgBlock || isBgLine) ? (style.background_offset_x || 0) : 0;
  const bgOffsetY = (isBgBlock || isBgLine) ? (style.background_offset_y || 0) : 0;
  const bgOffsetTransform = (bgOffsetX !== 0 || bgOffsetY !== 0) ? `translate(${bgOffsetX}px, ${bgOffsetY}px)` : '';

  const fontFam = style.font_family || 'Montserrat';
  const fontSize = Math.max(10, Math.round((style.font_size || 44) * 0.44));
  const fontWeight = style.font_weight || 'bold';
  const letterSpacing = style.letter_spacing || 0;

  // Derive visual lines deterministically using font metrics and container width
  const visualLines = useMemo(() => {
    const stageWidth = containerWidth || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.min(window.innerWidth, 480) : 360);
    const maxContentWidth = stageWidth * (layout.max_width ?? 0.88);
    return partitionWordsIntoVisualLines(
      group.words || [],
      fontFam,
      fontSize,
      fontWeight,
      letterSpacing,
      maxContentWidth,
      style.text_transform
    );
  }, [group.words, fontFam, fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, layout.max_width, containerWidth, style.text_transform]);

  return (
    <div
      className={`absolute transition-all duration-75 flex flex-col ${
        layout.alignment === 'left' ? 'items-start text-left' : layout.alignment === 'right' ? 'items-end text-right' : 'items-center text-center'
      } ${showBoundingBox ? 'ring-1 ring-white/30 p-1.5 rounded-lg' : ''}`}
      style={{
        left: `${(layout.position_x ?? 0.5) * 100}%`,
        top: `${posY * 100}%`,
        transform: bgOffsetTransform ? `${combinedTransform} ${bgOffsetTransform}` : combinedTransform,
        maxWidth: `${(layout.max_width ?? 0.88) * 100}%`,
        width: 'max-content',
        transformOrigin: 'center center',
        opacity: effectiveOpacity,
        ...(isBgBlock && {
          backgroundColor: effectiveBgColor,
          padding: `${style.background_padding_y ?? 8}px ${style.background_padding_x ?? 14}px`,
          borderRadius: `${style.background_corner_radius ?? 12}px`,
        })
      }}
    >
      {visualLines.map((lineWords, lIdx) => {
        const lineContent = lineWords.map((w, idx) => {
          // Word timing & spoken active-word only applies to captions with word timing enabled
          const hasWordTiming = isCaption && (group as any).has_word_timing !== false && (group as any).timing_mode !== 'phrase' && (w as any).is_exact !== false;
          const isSpoken = hasWordTiming && currentTime >= w.start && currentTime <= w.end;
          const wordText = applyCaseTransform(w.text || (w as any).word || '', style.text_transform);
          const wordOverride = w.style_override;

          // Tactile scale pop calculation (Spring Punch) ONLY when layer is caption
          let scale = 1.0;
          const animType = anim?.active_word?.type || anim?.type || (anim as any)?.active_word_effect;
          if (isCaption && isSpoken && highlightEnabled && animType && animType !== 'none' && (animType === 'pop' || animType === 'bounce')) {
            const durationSec = (anim?.duration_ms || 100) / 1000;
            const elapsed = Math.max(0, currentTime - w.start);
            if (elapsed < durationSec) {
              const progress = elapsed / durationSec;
              const punch = (anim?.active_scale || 1.16) - 1.0;
              scale = 1.0 + punch * Math.cos(progress * (Math.PI / 2));
            }
          }

          // Dynamic colors: Normal text strictly preserves primary_color; Spoken highlight only applies to captions
          let textColor = style.primary_color || (style as any).color || '#FFFF00';
          if (isCaption && isSpoken && highlightEnabled) {
            textColor = wordOverride?.highlight_color || style.highlight_color || '#FFFFFF';
          } else if (wordOverride?.color) {
            textColor = wordOverride.color;
          }

          const strokeWidth = style.outline_enabled ? `${Math.max(1.5, (style.outline_width || 2) * 0.6)}px` : '0px';
          const strokeColorWithOpacity = style.outline_enabled
            ? applyColorOpacity(style.outline_color || '#000000', style.outline_opacity ?? 1.0)
            : undefined;

          return (
            <React.Fragment key={w.id || idx}>
              <span
                style={{
                  fontFamily: fontFam,
                  fontSize: `${fontSize}px`,
                  fontWeight: wordOverride?.font_weight || style.font_weight || 'bold',
                  fontStyle: style.font_style || 'normal',
                  textDecoration: (wordOverride?.underline ?? style.underline) ? 'underline' : undefined,
                  letterSpacing: `${style.letter_spacing || 0}px`,
                  lineHeight: style.line_height || 1.25,
                  color: applyColorOpacity(textColor, style.text_opacity ?? 1.0),
                  WebkitTextStroke: style.outline_enabled ? `${strokeWidth} ${strokeColorWithOpacity}` : undefined,
                  paintOrder: 'stroke fill',
                  filter: filterStr,
                  transform: `scale(${scale})`,
                  display: 'inline-block',
                  transformOrigin: 'center bottom',
                  transition: 'transform 0.04s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.05s ease',
                }}
              >
                {wordText}
              </span>
              {idx < lineWords.length - 1 ? ' ' : null}
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        });

        if (isBgLine) {
          return (
            <div key={lIdx} className="my-0.5 inline-block text-center w-auto">
              <span
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-block',
                  backgroundColor: effectiveBgColor,
                  padding: `${Math.round((style.background_padding_y ?? 6) * 0.45)}px ${Math.round((style.background_padding_x ?? 12) * 0.45)}px`,
                  borderRadius: `${Math.round((style.background_corner_radius ?? 8) * 0.6)}px`,
                }}
              >
                {lineContent}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <div key={lIdx} className="my-0.5 inline-block text-center w-auto">
            {lineContent}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});

export const DispatchCaptionRenderer: React.FC<DispatchCaptionRendererProps> = ({
  track,
  currentTime,
  containerWidth,
  containerHeight,
  layoutMode = 'fit_black',
  showBoundingBox = true
}) => {
  if (!track || !track.groups || track.groups.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // Find all active visible groups for current playback time (audio/voiceover do not render visual text; hidden layers excluded)
  const activeGroups = track.groups.filter(
    grp => grp.type !== 'audio' && grp.type !== 'voiceover' && !grp.is_hidden && currentTime >= grp.start && currentTime <= grp.end
  );

  if (activeGroups.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-20 flex justify-center overflow-hidden select-none"
      style={{
        paddingLeft: '6%',
        paddingRight: '6%'
      }}
    >
      {activeGroups.map((group) => (
        <CaptionGroupItem
          key={group.id}
          group={group}
          defaultStyle={track.default_style}
          defaultLayout={track.default_layout}
          defaultAnimation={track.default_animation}
          currentTime={currentTime}
          containerWidth={containerWidth}
          layoutMode={layoutMode}
          showBoundingBox={showBoundingBox}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

// In-memory cache for dynamically loaded fonts
const loadedFontFaceFamilies = new Set<string>();

/**
 * Ensure a font asset is registered in document.fonts via the Web FontFace API.
 */
export async function loadFontFace(family: string, fontUrl: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (loadedFontFaceFamilies.has(family)) return true;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('FontFace' in window)) return false;

  try {
    const font = new FontFace(family, `url(${fontUrl})`);
    const loaded = await font.load();
    document.fonts.add(loaded);
    loadedFontFaceFamilies.add(family);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[FontLoader] Could not load @font-face for ${family}:`, err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Fetch all available fonts from backend API, merging custom uploaded fonts with curated defaults.
 */
export async function fetchFontCatalog(apiBase: string = ''): Promise<FontEntry[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/fonts`);
    if (!res.ok) return CURATED_FONTS;
    const data = await res.json();
    const serverFonts: any[] = data.fonts || [];

    const customEntries: FontEntry[] = serverFonts
      .filter((sf) => sf.is_custom)
      .map((sf) => ({
        family: sf.family,
        category: 'Custom',
        categoryKey: 'custom',
        weights: Array.isArray(sf.weights) && sf.weights.length > 0 ? sf.weights : ['400'],
        isCustom: true,
        filename: sf.filename,
        url: sf.url ? (sf.url.startsWith('http') ? sf.url : `${apiBase}${sf.url}`) : undefined,
        license: sf.license || 'Custom Imported',
      }));

    // Auto-load all custom fonts into document.fonts
    for (const cf of customEntries) {
      if (cf.url) {
        loadFontFace(cf.family, cf.url).catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    // Merge: Put custom fonts first, then curated
    return [...customEntries, ...CURATED_FONTS];
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[FontCatalog] Failed to fetch server fonts, falling back to curated list:', err);
    return CURATED_FONTS;
  }
}

/**
 * Upload a custom TTF/OTF font to the backend and register it in document.fonts.
 */
export async function importCustomFontFile(file: File, apiBase: string = ''): Promise<FontEntry> {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('file', file);

  const res = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/fonts/import`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: formData,
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({ detail: 'Failed to import font' }));
    throw new Error(errData.detail || 'Failed to import font file');
  }

  const result = await res.json();
  const fontData = result.font;
  const entry: FontEntry = {
    family: fontData.family,
    category: 'Custom',
    categoryKey: 'custom',
    weights: fontData.weights || ['400'],
    isCustom: true,
    filename: fontData.filename,
    url: fontData.url ? (fontData.url.startsWith('http') ? fontData.url : `${apiBase}${fontData.url}`) : undefined,
    license: fontData.license || 'Custom Imported',
  };

  // Register in browser document.fonts immediately
  if (entry.url) {
    await loadFontFace(entry.family, entry.url);
  }

  return entry;
}

/**
 * Get real supported weights for a font family.
 */
export function getSupportedWeights(family: string, catalog: FontEntry[] = CURATED_FONTS): string[] {
  const found = catalog.find((f) => f.family.toLowerCase() === family.toLowerCase());
  return found?.weights && found.weights.length > 0 ? found.weights : ['400', 'bold'];
}

/**
 * Return closest valid weight for a chosen font.
 */
export function getClosestSupportedWeight(family: string, currentWeight: string = 'bold', catalog: FontEntry[] = CURATED_FONTS): string {
  const weights = getSupportedWeights(family, catalog);
  if (weights.includes(currentWeight)) return currentWeight;

  // Map common strings to numbers
  const norm = (w: string): number => {
    if (w === 'bold') return 700;
    if (w === 'black' || w === 'extrabold') return 900;
    if (w === 'semibold') return 600;
    if (w === 'medium') return 500;
    if (w === 'normal' || w === 'regular') return 400;
    const num = parseInt(w, 10);
    return isNaN(num) ? 400 : num;
  };

  const targetNum = norm(currentWeight);
  let best = weights[0];
  let bestDiff = 9999;
  for (const w of weights) {
    const diff = Math.abs(norm(w) - targetNum);
    if (diff < bestDiff) {
      bestDiff = diff;
      best = w;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

const RECENT_KEY = 'dispatch_recent_fonts';
const FAVORITES_KEY = 'dispatch_favorite_fonts';

export function getRecentFonts(): string[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : ['Impact', 'Montserrat', 'Anton'];
  } catch {
    return ['Impact', 'Montserrat', 'Anton'];
  }
}

export function addRecentFont(family: string): void {
  try {
    const recents = getRecentFonts().filter((f) => f.toLowerCase() !== family.toLowerCase());
    recents.unshift(family);
    localStorage.setItem(RECENT_KEY, JSON.stringify(recents.slice(0, 8)));
  } catch {}
}

export function getFavoriteFonts(): string[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(FAVORITES_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function toggleFavoriteFont(family: string): boolean {
  try {
    const favs = getFavoriteFonts();
    const exists = favs.some((f) => f.toLowerCase() === family.toLowerCase());
    let next: string[];
    if (exists) {
      next = favs.filter((f) => f.toLowerCase() !== family.toLowerCase());
    } else {
      next = [...favs, family];
    }
    localStorage.setItem(FAVORITES_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    return !exists;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Move, 
  Maximize2, 
  RotateCw, 
  Edit3, 
  X, 
  Check,
  CheckCheck,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, Word, StyleConfig, LayoutConfig } from './types';
import { preserveWordTimingsOnEdit } from './timingPreservation';
import { partitionWordsIntoVisualLines } from './linePartition';

function applyColorOpacity(color: string, opacity: number = 1.0): string {
  if (opacity >= 1.0) return color;
  if (color.startsWith('#')) {
    const hex = color.slice(1);
    let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0;
    if (hex.length === 3) {
      r = parseInt(hex[0] + hex[0], 16);
      g = parseInt(hex[1] + hex[1], 16);
      b = parseInt(hex[2] + hex[2], 16);
    } else if (hex.length >= 6) {
      r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
      g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
      b = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
    }
    return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${opacity})`;
  }
  return color;
}

interface InteractiveTextCanvasProps {
  track: CaptionTrack | null;
  currentTime: number;
  selectedGroupId: string | null;
  onSelectGroup: (groupId: string | null) => void;
  onOpenTextEditor?: (groupId: string) => void;
  onUpdateGroup: (groupId: string, patch: Partial<CaptionGroup>, commitToHistory?: boolean) => void;
  onApplyLayoutToAll?: (groupId: string) => void;
  layoutMode?: string;
  isInteractive?: boolean;
}

interface CanvasGroupItemProps {
  group: CaptionGroup;
  defaultStyle: StyleConfig;
  defaultLayout: LayoutConfig;
  defaultAnimation: any;
  isSelected: boolean;
  currentTime: number;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  onSelectGroup: (groupId: string | null) => void;
  onOpenTextEditor?: (groupId: string) => void;
  onUpdateGroup: (groupId: string, patch: Partial<CaptionGroup>, commitToHistory?: boolean) => void;
  onApplyLayoutToAll?: (groupId: string) => void;
  layoutMode: string;
  isInteractive: boolean;
}

const CanvasGroupItem: React.FC<CanvasGroupItemProps> = React.memo(({
  group,
  defaultStyle,
  defaultLayout,
  defaultAnimation,
  isSelected,
  currentTime,
  containerRef,
  onSelectGroup,
  onOpenTextEditor,
  onUpdateGroup,
  onApplyLayoutToAll,
  layoutMode,
  isInteractive
}) => {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [isResizing, setIsResizing] = useState(false);

  const style: StyleConfig = group.style || defaultStyle;
  const layout: LayoutConfig = group.layout || defaultLayout;
  const anim = group.animation || defaultAnimation;

  // Layer type awareness
  const isCaption = (group.type || 'caption') === 'caption';
  const highlightEnabled = isCaption && (style.highlight_enabled !== false);

  let posX = layout.position_x ?? 0.5;
  let posY = layout.position_y ?? 0.78;
  const scale = layout.scale ?? 1.0;

  if (isCaption && layoutMode === 'landscape') {
    posY = Math.max(0.78, posY);
  }

  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ 
    x: number; 
    y: number; 
    initialX: number; 
    initialY: number; 
    containerWidth: number; 
    containerHeight: number; 
  }>({ x: 0, y: 0, initialX: 0.5, initialY: 0.78, containerWidth: 1, containerHeight: 1 });

  const resizeStartRef = useRef<{ 
    x: number; 
    initialScale: number; 
    containerWidth: number; 
  }>({ x: 0, initialScale: 1.0, containerWidth: 1 });

  const latestPatchRef = useRef<{ groupId: string; patch: Partial<CaptionGroup> } | null>(null);

  const fontFam = style.font_family || 'Montserrat';
  const fontSize = Math.max(10, Math.round((style.font_size || 44) * 0.44));
  const fontWeight = style.font_weight || 'bold';
  const letterSpacing = style.letter_spacing || 0;

  const visualLines = useMemo(() => {
    return partitionWordsIntoVisualLines(
      group.words || [],
      fontFam,
      fontSize,
      fontWeight,
      letterSpacing,
      360 * (layout.max_width || 0.88),
      style.text_transform
    );
  }, [group.words, fontFam, fontSize, fontWeight, letterSpacing, layout.max_width, style.text_transform]);

  const handlePointerDownDrag = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isInteractive) return;
    e.stopPropagation();
    onSelectGroup(group.id);

    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() || { width: 393, height: 700 };
    dragStartRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      initialX: posX,
      initialY: posY,
      containerWidth: Math.max(1, rect.width),
      containerHeight: Math.max(1, rect.height),
    };
    latestPatchRef.current = null;
    setIsDragging(true);
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (isDragging) {
      const deltaX = (e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x) / dragStartRef.current.containerWidth;
      const deltaY = (e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y) / dragStartRef.current.containerHeight;

      const newX = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, dragStartRef.current.initialX + deltaX));
      const newY = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.95, dragStartRef.current.initialY + deltaY));

      const patch: Partial<CaptionGroup> = {
        layout: {
          ...layout,
          position_x: Number(newX.toFixed(3)),
          position_y: Number(newY.toFixed(3))
        }
      };

      latestPatchRef.current = { groupId: group.id, patch };
      onUpdateGroup(group.id, patch, false);
    } else if (isResizing) {
      const deltaX = (e.clientX - resizeStartRef.current.x) / (resizeStartRef.current.containerWidth * 0.4);
      const newScale = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(2.4, resizeStartRef.current.initialScale + deltaX));

      const patch: Partial<CaptionGroup> = {
        layout: {
          ...layout,
          scale: Number(newScale.toFixed(2))
        }
      };

      latestPatchRef.current = { groupId: group.id, patch };
      onUpdateGroup(group.id, patch, false);
    }
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (latestPatchRef.current) {
      onUpdateGroup(latestPatchRef.current.groupId, latestPatchRef.current.patch, true);
      latestPatchRef.current = null;
    }
    if (isDragging) setIsDragging(false);
    if (isResizing) setIsResizing(false);
    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}
  };

  const handleResizePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect() || { width: 393, height: 700 };
    resizeStartRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX,
      initialScale: scale,
      containerWidth: Math.max(1, rect.width),
    };
    latestPatchRef.current = null;
    setIsResizing(true);
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  };

  // Deterministic 3-layer animation evaluation (Enter / Exit / Loop)
  const timeSinceStart = Math.max(0, currentTime - group.start);
  const timeUntilEnd = Math.max(0, group.end - currentTime);
  
  let enterOpacity = 1.0;
  let enterTransform = '';
  const enterType = anim.enter?.type || (anim as any)?.enter_type || 'none';
  const enterDur = (anim.enter?.duration_ms || (anim as any)?.enter_duration_ms || 200) / 1000;
  if (enterType !== 'none' && timeSinceStart < enterDur) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeSinceStart / enterDur));
    if (enterType === 'fade') enterOpacity = p;
    else if (enterType === 'pop') {
      enterOpacity = Math.min(1, p * 2);
      enterTransform = `scale(${0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI / 2)})`;
    } else if (enterType === 'slide_up') {
      enterOpacity = p;
      enterTransform = `translateY(${(1 - p) * 20}px)`;
    }
  }

  let exitOpacity = 1.0;
  let exitTransform = '';
  const exitType = anim.exit?.type || (anim as any)?.exit_type || 'none';
  const exitDur = (anim.exit?.duration_ms || (anim as any)?.exit_duration_ms || 150) / 1000;
  if (exitType !== 'none' && timeUntilEnd < exitDur) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, timeUntilEnd / exitDur));
    if (exitType === 'fade') exitOpacity = p;
    else if (exitType === 'scale_down') {
      exitOpacity = p;
      exitTransform = `scale(${0.5 + 0.5 * p})`;
    } else if (exitType === 'slide_down') {
      exitOpacity = p;
      exitTransform = `translateY(${(1 - p) * 20}px)`;
    }
  }

  let loopTransform = '';
  const loopType = anim.loop?.type || (anim as any)?.loop_type || 'none';
  if (loopType === 'pulse') {
    const speed = (anim.loop?.speed_ms || (anim as any)?.loop_speed_ms || 1000) / 1000;
    const loopTime = timeSinceStart / speed;
    loopTransform = `scale(${1.0 + 0.04 * Math.sin(loopTime * 2 * Math.PI)})`;
  } else if (loopType === 'wiggle') {
    const speed = (anim.loop?.speed_ms || (anim as any)?.loop_speed_ms || 1000) / 1000;
    const loopTime = timeSinceStart / speed;
    loopTransform = `rotate(${2.0 * Math.sin(loopTime * 2 * Math.PI)}deg)`;
  }

  const computedOpacity = (style.opacity ?? 1.0) * enterOpacity * exitOpacity;
  const extraAnimTransform = [enterTransform, exitTransform, loopTransform].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  const bgEnabled = style.background_enabled !== false && style.background_mode !== 'none';
  const rawBgMode = bgEnabled ? (style.background_mode || 'block') : 'none';
  const isBgBlock = rawBgMode === 'block' || (rawBgMode as string) === 'full_box';
  const isBgLine = rawBgMode === 'line' || (rawBgMode as string) === 'per_line';
  const effectiveBgColor = applyColorOpacity(style.background_color || '#000000', style.background_opacity ?? 1.0);
  const bgOffsetX = (isBgBlock || isBgLine) ? (style.background_offset_x || 0) : 0;
  const bgOffsetY = (isBgBlock || isBgLine) ? (style.background_offset_y || 0) : 0;
  const bgOffsetTransform = (bgOffsetX !== 0 || bgOffsetY !== 0) ? `translate(${bgOffsetX}px, ${bgOffsetY}px)` : '';

  const rotation = layout.rotation ?? 0;

  return (
    <div
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
      onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
      style={{
        position: 'absolute',
        left: `${posX * 100}%`,
        top: `${posY * 100}%`,
        transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(${rotation}deg) scale(${scale}) ${extraAnimTransform}`.trim(),
        width: 'max-content',
        maxWidth: containerRef.current?.clientWidth
          ? `${Math.round(containerRef.current.clientWidth * (layout.max_width ?? 0.88))}px`
          : `${(layout.max_width ?? 0.88) * 100}%`,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        opacity: computedOpacity,
        cursor: isInteractive ? (isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab') : 'default',
        touchAction: 'none'
      }}
      onPointerDown={handlePointerDownDrag}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (!isInteractive) return;
        e.stopPropagation();
        onSelectGroup(group.id);
      }}
      onDoubleClick={(e) => {
        if (!isInteractive) return;
        e.stopPropagation();
        onOpenTextEditor?.(group.id);
      }}
      className={`relative transition-shadow group ${
        isSelected && isInteractive ? 'ring-2 ring-primary/80 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.35)]' : ''
      }`}
    >
      {/* CAPCUT SELECTION OVERLAY & TRANSFORM HANDLES */}
      {isSelected && isInteractive && (
        <div className="absolute -inset-2.5 border border-dashed border-primary rounded-lg pointer-events-none z-30">
          {/* Top-Left: Close / Deselect handle */}
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onSelectGroup(null); }}
            className="absolute -top-5 -left-5 w-11 h-11 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-auto cursor-pointer"
            title="Deselect"
          >
            <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-surface-200 border border-border flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500 transition-colors shadow-md">
              <X size={10} className="text-white" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Bottom-Right: Scale / Resize handle */}
          <div 
            onPointerDown={handleResizePointerDown}
            className="absolute -bottom-5 -right-5 w-11 h-11 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-auto cursor-nwse-resize"
            title="Drag to resize text scale"
          >
            <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary border border-white flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-md">
              <Maximize2 size={10} className="text-white" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Bottom-Center: Move Anchor handle */}
          <div 
            className="absolute -bottom-2.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-surface-200 border border-primary flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none"
          >
            <Move size={8} className="text-primary" />
          </div>

          {/* Quick Apply to All Captions Action Pill (Captions only) */}
          {onApplyLayoutToAll && isCaption && (
            <div className="absolute -bottom-10 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 pointer-events-auto z-40">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  onApplyLayoutToAll(group.id);
                }}
                className="h-6 px-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#1C1F26]/95 border border-[#2E3239] hover:border-primary text-text-secondary hover:text-white text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all whitespace-nowrap"
                title="Apply this caption's position & size to all spoken captions"
              >
                <CheckCheck size={11} className="text-primary" />
                <span>Apply to All Captions</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* RENDERED TEXT AND WORD-LEVEL POP ANIMATION */}
      <div
        className={`w-full flex flex-col ${
          layout.alignment === 'left' ? 'items-start text-left' : layout.alignment === 'right' ? 'items-end text-right' : 'items-center text-center'
        } p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all`}
        style={{
          transform: bgOffsetTransform || undefined,
          ...(isBgBlock && {
            backgroundColor: effectiveBgColor,
            padding: `${style.background_padding_y || 8}px ${style.background_padding_x || 14}px`,
            borderRadius: `${style.background_corner_radius || 12}px`,
          })
        }}
      >
        {visualLines.map((lineWords, lIdx) => {
          const lineContent = lineWords.map((w, idx) => {
            const hasWordTiming = isCaption && (group as any).has_word_timing !== false && (group as any).timing_mode !== 'phrase' && w.is_exact !== false;
            const isSpoken = hasWordTiming && currentTime >= w.start && currentTime <= w.end;
            const wordOverride = w.style_override;

            // Tactile scale pop calculation (Spring Punch) ONLY when layer is caption
            let wordScale = 1.0;
            const activeAnimType = anim.active_word?.type || anim.type;
            const punchScale = anim.active_word?.active_scale || anim.active_scale || 1.16;
            const animDurationMs = anim.active_word?.duration_ms || anim.duration_ms || 100;

            if (isCaption && isSpoken && highlightEnabled && activeAnimType && activeAnimType !== 'none' && (activeAnimType === 'pop' || activeAnimType === 'bounce')) {
              const durationSec = animDurationMs / 1000;
              const elapsed = Math.max(0, currentTime - w.start);
              if (elapsed < durationSec) {
                const progress = elapsed / durationSec;
                const punch = punchScale - 1.0;
                wordScale = 1.0 + punch * Math.cos(progress * (Math.PI / 2));
              }
            }

            // Color resolution: Normal text strictly preserves primary_color; Spoken highlight only applies to captions
            let textColor = style.primary_color;
            if (isCaption && isSpoken && highlightEnabled) {
              textColor = wordOverride?.highlight_color || style.highlight_color;
            } else if (wordOverride?.color) {
              textColor = wordOverride.color;
            }

            const strokeWidth = style.outline_enabled ? `${Math.max(1.5, (style.outline_width || 4.5) * 0.6)}px` : '0px';

            const filters: string[] = [];
            if (style.shadow_enabled) {
              filters.push(`drop-shadow(${style.shadow_offset_x || 0}px ${style.shadow_offset_y || 2}px ${style.shadow_blur || 4}px ${style.shadow_color || 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)'})`);
            }
            if (style.glow_enabled) {
              filters.push(`drop-shadow(0px 0px ${style.glow_blur || 14}px ${style.glow_color || '#00F0FF'})`);
            }

            return (
              <React.Fragment key={w.id || idx}>
                <span
                  style={{
                    fontFamily: fontFam,
                    fontSize: `${fontSize}px`,
                    fontWeight: w.style_override?.font_weight || style.font_weight || 'bold',
                    textTransform: (style.text_transform as any) || 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: `${style.letter_spacing || 0}px`,
                    color: textColor,
                    WebkitTextStroke: style.outline_enabled ? `${strokeWidth} ${style.outline_color}` : undefined,
                    paintOrder: 'stroke fill',
                    filter: filters.length > 0 ? filters.join(' ') : undefined,
                    transform: `scale(${wordScale})`,
                    display: 'inline-block',
                    transformOrigin: 'center bottom',
                    transition: 'transform 0.04s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.05s ease'
                  }}
                >
                  {w.text}
                </span>
                {idx < lineWords.length - 1 ? ' ' : null}
              </React.Fragment>
            );
          });

          if (isBgLine) {
            return (
              <div key={lIdx} className="my-0.5 inline-block text-center w-auto">
                <span
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-block',
                    backgroundColor: effectiveBgColor,
                    padding: `${Math.round((style.background_padding_y || 6) * 0.45)}px ${Math.round((style.background_padding_x || 12) * 0.45)}px`,
                    borderRadius: `${Math.round((style.background_corner_radius || 8) * 0.6)}px`,
                  }}
                >
                  {lineContent}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <div key={lIdx} className="my-0.5 inline-block text-center w-auto">
              {lineContent}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export const InteractiveTextCanvas: React.FC<InteractiveTextCanvasProps> = ({
  track,
  currentTime,
  selectedGroupId,
  onSelectGroup,
  onOpenTextEditor,
  onUpdateGroup,
  onApplyLayoutToAll,
  layoutMode = 'fit_black',
  isInteractive = true
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!track || !track.groups || track.groups.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // Find all active visible groups for current playback time (timeline-aware visibility)
  const activeGroups = track.groups.filter(
    grp => grp.type !== 'audio' && grp.type !== 'voiceover' && !grp.is_hidden && currentTime >= grp.start && currentTime <= grp.end
  );

  if (activeGroups.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className="absolute inset-0 z-20 overflow-hidden select-none"
      style={{
        paddingLeft: '4%',
        paddingRight: '4%',
      }}
    >
      {activeGroups.map((grp) => (
        <CanvasGroupItem
          key={grp.id}
          group={grp}
          defaultStyle={track.default_style}
          defaultLayout={track.default_layout}
          defaultAnimation={track.default_animation}
          isSelected={selectedGroupId === grp.id}
          currentTime={currentTime}
          containerRef={containerRef}
          onSelectGroup={onSelectGroup}
          onOpenTextEditor={onOpenTextEditor}
          onUpdateGroup={onUpdateGroup}
          onApplyLayoutToAll={onApplyLayoutToAll}
          layoutMode={layoutMode}
          isInteractive={isInteractive}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * linePartition.ts
 * Deterministic text and caption line layout engine.
 * Calculates visual line boundaries based on font family, font size, font weight,
 * letter spacing, and available container width using an offscreen canvas context.
 */

export interface WordLike {
  id?: string;
  text?: string;
  word?: string;
  start?: number;
  end?: number;
  style_override?: any;
  [key: string]: any;
}

let cachedCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null = null;
let cachedCtx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | null = null;

function getSharedMeasureContext(): CanvasRenderingContext2D | null {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  if (!cachedCanvas) {
    try {
      cachedCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      cachedCtx = cachedCanvas.getContext('2d');
    } catch {
      cachedCtx = null;
    }
  }
  return cachedCtx;
}

/**
 * Deterministically partitions an array of words into visual lines matching
 * actual rendered layout constraints.
 */
export function partitionWordsIntoVisualLines<T extends WordLike>(
  words: T[],
  fontFamily: string,
  fontSize: number,
  fontWeight: string | number,
  letterSpacing: number,
  maxWidthPx: number,
  textTransform?: string
): T[][] {
  if (!words || words.length === 0) return [];

  const ctx = getSharedMeasureContext();
  if (ctx) {
    ctx.font = `${fontWeight || 'bold'} ${Math.round(fontSize)}px "${fontFamily || 'Montserrat'}", sans-serif`;
  }

  const spaceWidth = ctx ? ctx.measureText(' ').width : fontSize * 0.3;
  const lines: T[][] = [];
  let currentLine: T[] = [];
  let currentLineWidth = 0;

  for (const word of words) {
    let rawText = (word.text || word.word || '').trim();
    if (textTransform === 'uppercase') rawText = rawText.toUpperCase();
    else if (textTransform === 'lowercase') rawText = rawText.toLowerCase();

    // Support explicit newlines inside caption text
    if (rawText.includes('\n')) {
      const parts = rawText.split('\n');
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        const partText = parts[i].trim();
        if (i > 0 && currentLine.length > 0) {
          lines.push(currentLine);
          currentLine = [];
          currentLineWidth = 0;
        }
        if (partText) {
          const wWidth = ctx
            ? ctx.measureText(partText).width + (letterSpacing || 0) * partText.length
            : partText.length * fontSize * 0.55;
          currentLine.push({ ...word, text: partText });
          currentLineWidth += wWidth + spaceWidth;
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    const wordWidth = ctx
      ? ctx.measureText(rawText).width + (letterSpacing || 0) * rawText.length
      : rawText.length * fontSize * 0.55;

    // Wrap to a new line when the word exceeds maximum content width
    if (currentLine.length > 0 && currentLineWidth + wordWidth > maxWidthPx) {
      lines.push(currentLine);
      currentLine = [word];
      currentLineWidth = wordWidth + spaceWidth;
    } else {
      currentLine.push(word);
      currentLineWidth += wordWidth + spaceWidth;
    }
  }

  if (currentLine.length > 0) {
    lines.push(currentLine);
  }

  return lines;
}

import { AnimationConfig, CaptionGroup, CaptionTrack, LayerType, LayoutConfig, StyleConfig, Word } from './types';

export function normalizeCaptionTrack(raw: unknown, clipId: string, duration: number): CaptionTrack {
  const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw as Record<string, any> : {};
  const rawStyle = source.default_style || {};
  const rawLayout = source.default_layout || {};
  const rawAnimation = source.default_animation || {};

  const default_style: StyleConfig = {
    font_family: rawStyle.font_family || 'Montserrat',
    font_size: rawStyle.font_size || 44,
    font_weight: rawStyle.font_weight || '900',
    text_transform: rawStyle.text_transform || 'none',
    letter_spacing: rawStyle.letter_spacing || 0,
    line_height: rawStyle.line_height || 1.25,
    primary_color: rawStyle.primary_color || rawStyle.color || '#FFFF00',
    highlight_color: rawStyle.highlight_color || '#FFFFFF',
    outline_enabled: rawStyle.outline_enabled ?? Boolean(rawStyle.stroke_width),
    outline_color: rawStyle.outline_color || rawStyle.stroke_color || '#000000',
    outline_width: rawStyle.outline_width || rawStyle.stroke_width || 3,
    shadow_enabled: rawStyle.shadow_enabled ?? rawStyle.has_shadow ?? true,
    shadow_color: rawStyle.shadow_color || '#000000',
    shadow_offset_x: rawStyle.shadow_offset_x || 0,
    shadow_offset_y: rawStyle.shadow_offset_y || 2,
    shadow_blur: rawStyle.shadow_blur || 6,
    background_enabled: rawStyle.background_enabled ?? rawStyle.has_background ?? false,
    background_color: rawStyle.background_color || '#000000',
    background_padding_x: rawStyle.background_padding_x || 12,
    background_padding_y: rawStyle.background_padding_y || 6,
    background_corner_radius: rawStyle.background_corner_radius || 8,
  };

  const default_layout: LayoutConfig = {
    position_x: rawLayout.position_x ?? 0.5,
    position_y: rawLayout.position_y ?? 0.78,
    scale: rawLayout.scale ?? 1.0,
    rotation: rawLayout.rotation ?? 0,
    alignment: rawLayout.alignment || 'center',
    max_width: rawLayout.max_width ?? 0.88,
    max_lines: rawLayout.max_lines ?? 2,
  };

  const default_animation: AnimationConfig = {
    type: rawAnimation.type || 'pop',
    duration_ms: rawAnimation.duration_ms || 120,
    active_scale: rawAnimation.active_scale || 1.15,
    easing: rawAnimation.easing || 'ease_out',
    enter: {
      type: rawAnimation.entrance_animation || rawAnimation.enter?.type === 'scale_up' ? 'pop' : (rawAnimation.enter?.type || 'pop'),
      duration_ms: 200,
    },
    active_word: {
      type: rawAnimation.active_word_effect || rawAnimation.active_word?.type || 'pop',
      active_scale: 1.15,
      duration_ms: 120,
    },
    exit: {
      type: rawAnimation.exit_animation || rawAnimation.exit?.type || 'none',
      duration_ms: 150,
    },
  };

  const rawGroups = Array.isArray(source.groups) ? source.groups : [];
  const groups: CaptionGroup[] = rawGroups.map((item: any, gIdx: number) => {
    const g = item && typeof item === 'object' ? item : {};
    const rawWords = Array.isArray(g.words) ? g.words : [];
    const words: Word[] = rawWords.map((itemWord: any, wIdx: number) => {
      const w = itemWord && typeof itemWord === 'object' ? itemWord : {};
      return {
        id: w.id || `w_${gIdx}_${wIdx}`,
        text: w.text || w.word || '',
        start: typeof w.start === 'number' ? w.start : g.start,
        end: typeof w.end === 'number' ? w.end : g.end,
        confidence: w.confidence ?? 0.95,
        style_override: w.style_override,
      };
    });

    const rawGroupLayout = g.layout && typeof g.layout === 'object' ? g.layout : {};
    const rawGroupStyle = g.style && typeof g.style === 'object' ? g.style : {};
    const rawPosY = rawGroupLayout.position_y ?? default_layout.position_y;
    const rawPosX = rawGroupLayout.position_x ?? default_layout.position_x;

    return {
      id: g.id || `grp_${gIdx}`,
      start: typeof g.start === 'number' ? g.start : 0,
      end: typeof g.end === 'number' ? g.end : duration,
      words: words.length > 0 ? words : [{
        id: `w_${gIdx}_0`, text: g.text || '', start: g.start || 0, end: g.end || duration,
      }],
      layout: {
        ...default_layout,
        ...rawGroupLayout,
        position_x: rawPosX > 1 ? rawPosX / 100 : rawPosX,
        position_y: rawPosY > 1 ? rawPosY / 100 : rawPosY,
      },
      style: {
        ...default_style,
        ...rawGroupStyle,
        primary_color: rawGroupStyle.primary_color || rawGroupStyle.color || default_style.primary_color,
        highlight_color: rawGroupStyle.highlight_color || default_style.highlight_color,
        highlight_enabled: rawGroupStyle.highlight_enabled !== false,
        outline_color: rawGroupStyle.outline_color || rawGroupStyle.stroke_color || default_style.outline_color,
        outline_width: rawGroupStyle.outline_width || rawGroupStyle.stroke_width || default_style.outline_width,
      },
      animation: { ...default_animation, ...(g.animation || {}) },
      type: (g.type as LayerType) || 'caption',
      trackIndex: typeof g.trackIndex === 'number' && g.trackIndex >= 0 ? g.trackIndex : undefined,
      volume: typeof g.volume === 'number' ? (g.volume <= 2.0 ? Math.round(g.volume * 100) : g.volume) : 100,
      is_muted: Boolean(g.is_muted),
      is_hidden: Boolean(g.is_hidden),
      audio_url: g.audio_url,
      overlay_url: g.overlay_url,
      overlay_type: g.overlay_type,
      opacity: typeof g.opacity === 'number' ? g.opacity : 100,
      label: g.label,
      flip_h: Boolean(g.flip_h),
      flip_v: Boolean(g.flip_v),
      overlay_animation: g.overlay_animation,
      has_word_timing: g.has_word_timing,
      timing_mode: g.timing_mode,
    };
  });

  return {
    id: source.id || `track_${clipId}`,
    clip_id: clipId,
    language: source.language || 'en',
    default_style,
    default_layout,
    default_animation,
    groups,
    range_revision: typeof source.range_revision === 'number' ? source.range_revision : undefined,
    timing_warning: typeof source.timing_warning === 'string' ? source.timing_warning : null,
  };
}

export function resolveStudioClip<T extends { id: string }>(clips: T[], selectedClipId: string | null): T | null {
  return clips.find((clip) => clip.id === selectedClipId) || clips[0] || null;
}

export function trackForClip(clipId: string | null, loadedClipId: string | null, track: CaptionTrack | null): CaptionTrack | null {
  return clipId && clipId === loadedClipId ? track : null;
}

import { CaptionTrack } from './types';

/**
 * Format seconds into SubRip (SRT) timestamp: HH:MM:SS,mmm
 */
function formatSrtTimestamp(seconds: number): string {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(seconds) ? seconds : 0);
  const hrs = Math.floor(safe / 3600);
  const mins = Math.floor((safe % 3600) / 60);
  const secs = Math.floor(safe % 60);
  const millis = Math.floor((safe % 1) * 1000);

  const hh = hrs.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const mm = mins.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const ss = secs.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  const mmm = millis.toString().padStart(3, '0');

  return `${hh}:${mm}:${ss},${mmm}`;
}

/**
 * Generate standard SubRip (.srt) subtitle content from authentic caption track.
 */
export function generateSrtFromTrack(track: CaptionTrack | null): string {
  if (!track || !track.groups || track.groups.length === 0) {
    return '';
  }

  // Filter only spoken caption or text groups, sort by start time
  const validGroups = track.groups
    .filter((g) => (!g.type || g.type === 'caption' || g.type === 'text') && g.words && g.words.length > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);

  if (validGroups.length === 0) {
    return '';
  }

  const srtBlocks: string[] = [];

  validGroups.forEach((grp, idx) => {
    const startStr = formatSrtTimestamp(grp.start);
    const endStr = formatSrtTimestamp(grp.end);
    const text = (grp.words || []).map((w) => w.text).join(' ');

    if (!text.trim()) return;

    srtBlocks.push(`${idx + 1}\n${startStr} --> ${endStr}\n${text.trim()}`);
  });

  return srtBlocks.join('\n\n') + '\n';
}

/**
 * Trigger client-side file download of .srt subtitles
 */
export function downloadSrtFile(track: CaptionTrack | null, clipTitle: string = 'captions') {
  const content = generateSrtFromTrack(track);
  if (!content) {
    alert('No caption text available to export.');
    return;
  }

  const cleanFilename = (clipTitle || 'dispatch_captions')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, '_')
    .slice(0, 32);

  const blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement('a');
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = `${cleanFilename}.srt`;
  document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  anchor.click();
  document.body.removeChild(anchor);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export const MAX_CLIP_SELECTION_SECONDS = 180;
export const MIN_CLIP_SELECTION_SECONDS = 5;
export const RANGE_CONTROL_STEP_SECONDS = 0.5;

export interface SourceRange {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

export interface TrimPointerState {
  side: 'start' | 'end';
  pointerId: number;
  startX: number;
  initialRange: SourceRange;
}

export function clipTimeToSourceTime(clipTime: number, clipStart: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, clipStart + (Number.isFinite(clipTime) ? clipTime : 0));
}

export function sourceTimeToClipTime(sourceTime: number, clipStart: number, clipDuration: number): number {
  const local = (Number.isFinite(sourceTime) ? sourceTime : clipStart) - clipStart;
  return Math.min(Math.max(0, clipDuration), Math.max(0, local));
}

export function captionTimeIsActive(time: number, start: number, end: number): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(time) && time >= start && time <= end;
}

export function extendSourceRange(
  range: SourceRange,
  side: 'start' | 'end',
  deltaSeconds: number,
  sourceDuration: number,
): SourceRange {
  if (!Number.isFinite(sourceDuration) || sourceDuration <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(deltaSeconds)) return range;
  return moveTrimPointer(
    { side, pointerId: 0, startX: 0, initialRange: range },
    0,
    deltaSeconds,
    1,
    sourceDuration,
  );
}

export function sourceContextRange(
  range: SourceRange,
  side: 'before' | 'after',
  sourceDuration: number,
  seconds = 4,
): SourceRange | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(sourceDuration) || sourceDuration <= 0 || seconds <= 0) return null;
  const context = side === 'before'
    ? { start: Math.max(0, range.start - seconds), end: range.start }
    : { start: range.end, end: Math.min(sourceDuration, range.end + seconds) };
  return context.end > context.start ? context : null;
}

export function shouldStopSourcePlayback(currentTime: number, selectedEnd: number): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(currentTime) && Number.isFinite(selectedEnd) && currentTime >= selectedEnd;
}

export function beginTrimPointer(
  side: 'start' | 'end',
  pointerId: number,
  clientX: number,
  range: SourceRange,
): TrimPointerState {
  return { side, pointerId, startX: clientX, initialRange: { ...range } };
}

/** Apply a real pointer delta to the active source-time selection. */
export function moveTrimPointer(
  pointer: TrimPointerState,
  pointerId: number,
  clientX: number,
  pixelsPerSecond: number,
  sourceDuration: number,
): SourceRange {
  if (pointer.pointerId !== pointerId || pixelsPerSecond <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(clientX)) {
    return pointer.initialRange;
  }
  const sourceEnd = Number.isFinite(sourceDuration) && sourceDuration > 0 ? sourceDuration : 0;
  const delta = (clientX - pointer.startX) / pixelsPerSecond;
  const { start, end } = pointer.initialRange;
  const minLength = Math.min(MIN_CLIP_SELECTION_SECONDS, sourceEnd);
  const maxLength = Math.min(MAX_CLIP_SELECTION_SECONDS, sourceEnd);

  if (pointer.side === 'start') {
    const minStart = Math.max(0, end - maxLength);
    const maxStart = Math.max(minStart, end - minLength);
    return { start: clamp(start + delta, minStart, maxStart), end };
  }

  const minEnd = Math.min(sourceEnd, start + minLength);
  const maxEnd = Math.min(sourceEnd, start + maxLength);
  return { start, end: clamp(end + delta, minEnd, maxEnd) };
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

FILE: frontend\src\captions\timingPreservation.ts
============================================================
import { CaptionGroup, Word } from './types';

/**
 * Intelligent word-timing preservation engine.
 * 
 * Invariants:
 * 1. Single word edits strictly preserve every other word's ID, start/end timestamps, and style overrides.
 * 2. Multi-word edits find unchanged anchor words via alignment and only interpolate timing for the modified span.
 * 3. Never silently distribute words evenly across a segment when authentic Whisper timing exists.
 */

export function preserveWordTimingsOnEdit(
  originalWords: Word[] = [],
  newText: string,
  groupStart: number,
  groupEnd: number,
  groupId: string = 'grp'
): Word[] {
  const trimmed = newText.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return [];
  }

  const rawTokens = trimmed.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (rawTokens.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, groupEnd - groupStart);

  // Case 0: No prior words existed — construct baseline with estimated flags
  if (!originalWords || originalWords.length === 0) {
    const step = totalDuration / rawTokens.length;
    return rawTokens.map((text, idx) => ({
      id: `${groupId}-w${idx}-${Date.now()}`,
      text,
      start: Number((groupStart + idx * step).toFixed(2)),
      end: Number((groupStart + (idx + 1) * step).toFixed(2)),
      confidence: 0.8,
    }));
  }

  // Case 1: Word count is identical — 1:1 mapping preserving all unmodified words and timestamps
  if (originalWords.length === rawTokens.length) {
    return rawTokens.map((token, idx) => {
      const orig = originalWords[idx];
      return {
        ...orig,
        text: token,
        // Preserve original id and timings exactly
        id: orig.id || `${groupId}-w${idx}`,
        start: orig.start,
        end: orig.end,
        style_override: orig.style_override,
      };
    });
  }

  // Case 2: Multi-word insertion or deletion — find prefix and suffix matches (anchor points)
  let prefixCount = 0;
  while (
    prefixCount < originalWords.length &&
    prefixCount < rawTokens.length &&
    originalWords[prefixCount].text.toLowerCase() === rawTokens[prefixCount].toLowerCase()
  ) {
    prefixCount++;
  }

  let suffixCount = 0;
  while (
    suffixCount < (originalWords.length - prefixCount) &&
    suffixCount < (rawTokens.length - prefixCount) &&
    originalWords[originalWords.length - 1 - suffixCount].text.toLowerCase() ===
      rawTokens[rawTokens.length - 1 - suffixCount].toLowerCase()
  ) {
    suffixCount++;
  }

  const result: Word[] = [];

  // 1. Add matched prefix words with untouched timestamps and IDs
  for (let i = 0; i < prefixCount; i++) {
    result.push({
      ...originalWords[i],
      text: rawTokens[i], // Keep casing of new text
    });
  }

  // 2. Identify the middle span to retime
  const changedTokens = rawTokens.slice(prefixCount, rawTokens.length - suffixCount);
  
  if (changedTokens.length > 0) {
    const spanStart = prefixCount > 0 ? originalWords[prefixCount - 1].end : groupStart;
    const spanEnd = suffixCount > 0 
      ? originalWords[originalWords.length - suffixCount].start 
      : groupEnd;
    
    const spanDuration = Math.max(0.1, spanEnd - spanStart);
    const step = spanDuration / changedTokens.length;

    changedTokens.forEach((token, idx) => {
      result.push({
        id: `${groupId}-mod-${prefixCount + idx}-${Date.now()}`,
        text: token,
        start: Number((spanStart + idx * step).toFixed(2)),
        end: Number((spanStart + (idx + 1) * step).toFixed(2)),
        confidence: 0.8,
      });
    });
  }

  // 3. Add matched suffix words with untouched timestamps and IDs
  const origSuffixStartIndex = originalWords.length - suffixCount;
  const newSuffixStartIndex = rawTokens.length - suffixCount;

  for (let i = 0; i < suffixCount; i++) {
    const origWord = originalWords[origSuffixStartIndex + i];
    result.push({
      ...origWord,
      text: rawTokens[newSuffixStartIndex + i],
    });
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Split a caption group at splitTime while preserving authentic word timestamps.
 */
export function splitCaptionGroupAtTime(
  group: CaptionGroup,
  splitTime: number
): [CaptionGroup, CaptionGroup] | null {
  if (splitTime <= group.start + 0.1 || splitTime >= group.end - 0.1) {
    return null;
  }

  const words = group.words || [];
  const leftWords: Word[] = [];
  const rightWords: Word[] = [];

  words.forEach((w) => {
    const mid = (w.start + w.end) / 2;
    if (mid <= splitTime) {
      leftWords.push({
        ...w,
        end: Math.min(w.end, splitTime),
      });
    } else {
      rightWords.push({
        ...w,
        start: Math.max(w.start, splitTime),
      });
    }
  });

  const leftGroup: CaptionGroup = {
    ...group,
    id: group.id,
    start: group.start,
    end: splitTime,
    words: leftWords,
  };

  const rightGroup: CaptionGroup = {
    ...group,
    id: `grp_${Date.now()}_split`,
    start: splitTime,
    end: group.end,
    words: rightWords,
  };

  return [leftGroup, rightGroup];
}

/**
 * Merge two adjacent caption groups into one, preserving all authentic word timestamps.
 */
export function mergeAdjacentCaptionGroups(
  groupA: CaptionGroup,
  groupB: CaptionGroup
): CaptionGroup {
  const first = groupA.start <= groupB.start ? groupA : groupB;
  const second = groupA.start <= groupB.start ? groupB : groupA;

  const combinedWords = [...(first.words || []), ...(second.words || [])].sort(
    (a, b) => a.start - b.start
  );

  return {
    ...first,
    id: first.id,
    start: Math.min(first.start, second.start),
    end: Math.max(first.end, second.end),
    words: combinedWords,
  };
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  Replace,
  X,
  Check,
  Clock,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronRight,
  Edit2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, Word } from './types';
import { preserveWordTimingsOnEdit } from './timingPreservation';
import { downloadSrtFile } from './srtExport';

function escapeRegex(str: string): string {
  return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

interface TranscriptEditorProps {
  track: CaptionTrack | null;
  currentTime: number;
  selectedGroupId: string | null;
  onSeek: (seconds: number) => void;
  onSelectGroup: (groupId: string | null) => void;
  onUpdateGroup: (groupId: string, patch: Partial<CaptionGroup>, commitToHistory?: boolean) => void;
  onUpdateTrack?: (track: CaptionTrack, commitToHistory?: boolean) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const TranscriptEditor: React.FC<TranscriptEditorProps> = ({
  track,
  currentTime,
  selectedGroupId,
  onSeek,
  onSelectGroup,
  onUpdateGroup,
  onUpdateTrack,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [replaceQuery, setReplaceQuery] = useState('');
  const [editingGroupId, setEditingGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editDraftText, setEditDraftText] = useState('');
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const captionGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!track || !track.groups) return [];
    return track.groups
      .filter((g) => !g.type || g.type === 'caption' || g.type === 'text')
      .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
  }, [track]);

  // Search matches calculation with safe literal regex matching
  const searchMatches = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return [];
    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matches: { groupId: string; wordIdx: number; text: string }[] = [];

    captionGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      (grp.words || []).forEach((w, wIdx) => {
        if (w.text.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
          matches.push({ groupId: grp.id, wordIdx: wIdx, text: w.text });
        }
      });
    });

    return matches;
  }, [captionGroups, searchQuery]);

  const handleStartEdit = (grp: CaptionGroup) => {
    setEditingGroupId(grp.id);
    const fullText = (grp.words || []).map((w) => w.text).join(' ');
    setEditDraftText(fullText);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = (grp: CaptionGroup) => {
    const updatedWords = preserveWordTimingsOnEdit(
      grp.words || [],
      editDraftText,
      grp.start,
      grp.end,
      grp.id
    );

    onUpdateGroup(grp.id, { words: updatedWords }, true);
    setEditingGroupId(null);
    setFeedback('Segment updated with authentic word timestamps preserved.');
    setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleBatchReplace = () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim() || !track) return;
    const findStr = searchQuery.trim();
    const repStr = replaceQuery.trim();

    // Literal text matching: escape all regex characters so '.', '(', etc. match literally
    const escaped = escapeRegex(findStr);
    const regex = new RegExp(escaped, 'gi');

    let totalReplacements = 0;
    const affectedGroupIds = new Set<string>();

    const updatedGroups = track.groups.map((grp) => {
      if (grp.type && grp.type !== 'caption' && grp.type !== 'text') {
        return grp;
      }
      const origText = (grp.words || []).map((w) => w.text).join(' ');
      if (regex.test(origText)) {
        regex.lastIndex = 0;
        const nextText = origText.replace(regex, repStr);
        const updatedWords = preserveWordTimingsOnEdit(
          grp.words || [],
          nextText,
          grp.start,
          grp.end,
          grp.id
        );
        totalReplacements++;
        affectedGroupIds.add(grp.id);
        return {
          ...grp,
          words: updatedWords,
        };
      }
      return grp;
    });

    if (totalReplacements === 0) {
      setFeedback('No occurrences found to replace.');
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 2500);
      return;
    }

    // Atomic history commit: single undo step for the entire batch replace operation
    if (onUpdateTrack) {
      onUpdateTrack({ ...track, groups: updatedGroups }, true);
    } else {
      // Fallback: update groups without flooding history, committing on the final group
      const affectedList = Array.from(affectedGroupIds);
      affectedList.forEach((gid, idx) => {
        const grp = updatedGroups.find((g) => g.id === gid);
        if (grp) {
          const isLast = idx === affectedList.length - 1;
          onUpdateGroup(gid, { words: grp.words }, isLast);
        }
      });
    }

    setFeedback(`Replaced ${searchMatches.length} occurrences across ${totalReplacements} segments.`);
    setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col justify-end sm:justify-center items-center p-0 sm:p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-xl h-[88vh] sm:h-[80vh] bg-surface-100 border border-border rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-2xl flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <header className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-border flex items-center justify-between bg-surface-200/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles size={16} className="text-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text-main">Transcript Editor</h2>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-text-muted">
              ({captionGroups.length} segments)
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-text-muted hover:text-text-main hover:bg-surface-200 active:scale-95 transition-all"
          >
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </header>

        {/* Search & Replace Toolbar */}
        <section className="p-3 border-b border-border bg-surface-200/30 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1 relative flex items-center">
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 text-text-muted pointer-events-none" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Find word or phrase (Hinglish/English)…"
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 border border-border text-xs text-text-main focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
              />
              {searchMatches.length > 0 && (
                <span className="absolute right-2.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-primary font-bold">
                  {searchMatches.length} matches
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {searchQuery && (
              <div className="flex-1 relative flex items-center">
                <Replace size={14} className="absolute left-2.5 text-text-muted pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={replaceQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setReplaceQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Replace with…"
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 border border-border text-xs text-text-main focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleBatchReplace}
                className="h-[34px] px-3 rounded-lg bg-primary hover:bg-primary-hover text-white text-xs font-semibold shrink-0 active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                Replace All
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {feedback && (
            <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-primary animate-fade-in">{feedback}</p>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* Transcript Segments List */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-2.5 divide-y divide-border/30">
          {captionGroups.map((grp) => {
            const isSelected = selectedGroupId === grp.id;
            const isPlayingNow = currentTime >= grp.start && currentTime <= grp.end;
            const isEditing = editingGroupId === grp.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={grp.id}
                className={`pt-2.5 first:pt-0 rounded-xl p-2.5 transition-all ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-primary/10 border border-primary/40'
                    : isPlayingNow
                    ? 'bg-surface-200/60 border border-border'
                    : 'hover:bg-surface-200/30'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Segment Meta */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSeek(grp.start);
                      onSelectGroup(grp.id);
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-text-muted hover:text-primary transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Play size={10} className={isPlayingNow ? 'text-primary fill-primary' : ''} />
                    <span>
                      {grp.start.toFixed(2)}s &ndash; {grp.end.toFixed(2)}s
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">
                      ({(grp.end - grp.start).toFixed(1)}s)
                    </span>
                  </button>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {!isEditing ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleStartEdit(grp)}
                        className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] text-text-secondary hover:text-text-main hover:bg-surface-200 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Edit2 size={11} />
                        <span>Edit</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(grp)}
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-primary text-white text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm active:scale-95"
                        >
                          <Check size={11} />
                          <span>Done</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setEditingGroupId(null)}
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-200 text-text-muted hover:text-text-main text-[11px]"
                        >
                          Cancel
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Content */}
                {isEditing ? (
                  <textarea
                    rows={2}
                    value={editDraftText}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditDraftText(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 border border-primary text-xs text-text-main font-sans focus:outline-none resize-none"
                    placeholder="Edit caption words…"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <p
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSeek(grp.start);
                      onSelectGroup(grp.id);
                    }}
                    className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-text-main cursor-pointer select-text"
                  >
                    {(grp.words || []).map((w, idx) => {
                      const isWordActive = currentTime >= w.start && currentTime <= w.end;
                      const isSearchMatch =
                        searchQuery && w.text.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

                      return (
                        <span
                          key={w.id || idx}
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onSeek(w.start);
                            onSelectGroup(grp.id);
                          }}
                          className={`inline-block mr-1.5 px-1 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                            isWordActive
                              ? 'bg-primary text-white font-bold'
                              : isSearchMatch
                              ? 'bg-yellow-400/30 text-yellow-300 font-semibold underline'
                              : 'hover:bg-surface-300 text-text-main'
                          }`}
                          title={`Word: "${w.text}" (${w.start.toFixed(2)}s - ${w.end.toFixed(2)}s)`}
                        >
                          {w.text}
                        </span>
                      );
                    })}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <footer className="p-3 border-t border-border bg-surface-200/50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>Tap any word to jump playhead to its start time</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-200 hover:bg-surface-300 text-text-main text-xs font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-all"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { CaptionTrack } from './types';

/**
 * High-performance undo/redo history hook for caption tracks.
 * 
 * Supports:
 * - Transient updates during active gestures (drag, resize, trim) with zero cloning overhead.
 * - Single immutable commit boundary on gesture completion (`pointerup`).
 * - Reactive canUndo and canRedo state tracking.
 * - History isolation bounded strictly to 50 snapshots.
 */
export function useCaptionHistory(initialTrack: CaptionTrack | null) {
  const [track, setInternalTrack] = useState<CaptionTrack | null>(initialTrack);
  const historyRef = useRef<CaptionTrack[]>(initialTrack ? [JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(initialTrack))] : []);
  const indexRef = useRef<number>(0);

  const [canUndo, setCanUndo] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [canRedo, setCanRedo] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const syncFlags = useCallback(() => {
    setCanUndo(indexRef.current > 0);
    setCanRedo(indexRef.current < historyRef.current.length - 1);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Set caption track.
   * @param newTrack The updated caption track.
   * @param commitToHistory If false, updates track for fluid preview without appending a history snapshot.
   */
  const setTrack = useCallback((newTrack: CaptionTrack, commitToHistory: boolean = true) => {
    if (!commitToHistory) {
      // Fluid preview update: update state directly without JSON cloning or history mutation
      setInternalTrack(newTrack);
      return;
    }

    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(newTrack));
    const newHistory = historyRef.current.slice(0, indexRef.current + 1);
    newHistory.push(cloned);
    if (newHistory.length > 50) {
      newHistory.shift();
    }
    historyRef.current = newHistory;
    indexRef.current = newHistory.length - 1;
    setInternalTrack(cloned);
    syncFlags();
  }, [syncFlags]);

  /**
   * Explicit commit at gesture end.
   */
  const commitTrack = useCallback((finalTrack: CaptionTrack) => {
    setTrack(finalTrack, true);
  }, [setTrack]);

  /**
   * Explicit transient preview during active gesture.
   */
  const setTransientTrack = useCallback((previewTrack: CaptionTrack) => {
    setTrack(previewTrack, false);
  }, [setTrack]);

  const undo = useCallback((): CaptionTrack | null => {
    if (indexRef.current > 0) {
      indexRef.current -= 1;
      const prev = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(historyRef.current[indexRef.current]));
      setInternalTrack(prev);
      syncFlags();
      return prev;
    }
    return null;
  }, [syncFlags]);

  const redo = useCallback((): CaptionTrack | null => {
    if (indexRef.current < historyRef.current.length - 1) {
      indexRef.current += 1;
      const next = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(historyRef.current[indexRef.current]));
      setInternalTrack(next);
      syncFlags();
      return next;
    }
    return null;
  }, [syncFlags]);

  const resetHistory = useCallback((freshTrack: CaptionTrack) => {
    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(freshTrack));
    historyRef.current = [cloned];
    indexRef.current = 0;
    setInternalTrack(cloned);
    setCanUndo(false);
    setCanRedo(false);
  }, []);

  return {
    track,
    setTrack,
    commitTrack,
    setTransientTrack,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo,
    canRedo,
    resetHistory,
  };
}
