"""Test suite for Dispatch Font Library, Font Rendering & Custom Font Imports.
Verifies font catalog, ASS export font parity, fontsdir reframer integration, and font APIs.
"""
import io
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dispatch.captions.model import CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, Word, StyleConfig, LayoutConfig, AnimationConfig, WordStyleOverride
from dispatch.captions.exporter import export_to_ass, get_ass_weight_tag
from dispatch.video_engine.reframer import build_filter_complex
from dispatch.config import FONTS_DIR


class TestFontLibraryAndRendering(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.temp_path = Path(self.temp_dir.name)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_font_manifest_exists_and_contains_curated_library(self):
        """Verify the curated 20-25 creator fonts are cataloged with licenses and real weights."""
        manifest_path = FONTS_DIR / "fonts_manifest.json"
        self.assertTrue(manifest_path.exists(), "fonts_manifest.json must exist in FONTS_DIR")
        
        with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            manifest = json.load(f)
            
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(manifest), 20, "Should contain at least 20 curated creator fonts")
        
        families = {f["family"] for f in manifest}
        required_families = [
            "Anton", "Archivo Black", "Bebas Neue", "Montserrat", "Oswald",
            "Barlow Condensed", "League Spartan", "Poppins", "Inter", "Roboto",
            "Open Sans", "Noto Sans", "Space Grotesk", "Bangers", "Luckiest Guy",
            "Russo One", "Titan One", "Bungee", "Permanent Marker", "Noto Sans Devanagari"
        ]
        for req in required_families:
            self.assertIn(req, families, f"Required font '{req}' missing from font manifest")

        # Verify real weights specification
        anton = next(f for f in manifest if f["family"] == "Anton")
        self.assertEqual(anton["weights"], ["400"], "Anton must only declare its real available weight (400)")

    def test_ass_export_includes_inline_font_family_size_and_weight(self):
        """ASS dialogue events must include explicit \\fn, \\fs, \\b, \\fsp tags for exact render parity."""
        track = CaptionTrack(
            default_style=StyleConfig(
                font_family="Montserrat",
                font_size=54,
                font_weight="bold",
                letter_spacing=1.5,
                primary_color="#FFFFFF"
            ),
            groups=[
                CaptionGroup(
                    id="g1",
                    start=0.0,
                    end=2.0,
                    style=StyleConfig(
                        font_family="Anton",
                        font_size=60,
                        font_weight="900",
                        letter_spacing=2.0,
                        primary_color="#FFE600",
                        glow_enabled=True,
                        glow_color="#00F0FF"
                    ),
                    words=[
                        Word(id="w1", text="SUPER", start=0.0, end=1.0),
                        Word(id="w2", text="CREATOR", start=1.0, end=2.0),
                    ]
                )
            ]
        )
        ass_path = self.temp_path / "test_font.ass"
        export_to_ass(track, ass_path)

        with open(ass_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()

        # Check inline tags in dialogue events
        self.assertIn(r"\fnAnton", content, "Dialogue event must contain \\fnAnton inline override")
        self.assertIn(r"\fs60", content, "Dialogue event must contain \\fs60 font size override")
        self.assertIn(r"\b900", content, "Dialogue event must contain \\b900 font weight override")
        self.assertIn(r"\fsp2.0", content, "Dialogue event must contain \\fsp2.0 letter spacing override")

        # Check glow layer also contains matching font tags
        dialogue_lines = [line for line in content.splitlines() if line.startswith("Dialogue:")]
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(dialogue_lines), 2)
        glow_line = dialogue_lines[0]
        self.assertIn(r"\fnAnton", glow_line, "Glow layer must have matching \\fnAnton tag")
        self.assertIn(r"\b900", glow_line, "Glow layer must have matching \\b900 weight tag")

    def test_ass_export_word_level_style_overrides(self):
        """Word-level style overrides (color, weight, scale) must be preserved in ASS output."""
        track = CaptionTrack(
            default_style=StyleConfig(font_family="Inter", font_size=48, font_weight="400"),
            groups=[
                CaptionGroup(
                    id="g1",
                    start=0.0,
                    end=2.0,
                    words=[
                        Word(id="w1", text="NORMAL", start=0.0, end=1.0),
                        Word(
                            id="w2",
                            text="EMPHASIS",
                            start=1.0,
                            end=2.0,
                            style_override=WordStyleOverride(
                                color="#FF0000",
                                font_weight="900",
                                scale=1.25
                            )
                        ),
                    ]
                )
            ]
        )
        ass_path = self.temp_path / "test_word_override.ass"
        export_to_ass(track, ass_path)

        with open(ass_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()

        # Should contain weight override \b900 for the word
        self.assertIn(r"\b900", content)

    def test_reframer_includes_fontsdir_in_subtitles_filter(self):
        """build_filter_complex must pass :fontsdir to FFmpeg subtitles filter when FONTS_DIR exists."""
        fake_sub = self.temp_path / "subs.ass"
        fake_sub.write_text("[Script Info]\n", encoding="utf-8")

        filter_str, out_label = build_filter_complex(
            aspect_ratio="9:16",
            layout_mode="native_916",
            ass_subtitle_path=fake_sub
        )
        self.assertIn("subtitles=", filter_str)
        self.assertIn(":fontsdir=", filter_str, "Subtitles filter must specify :fontsdir for libass font discovery")

    def test_api_get_fonts(self):
        """FastAPI endpoint /api/fonts returns 200 and catalog of fonts."""
        from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
        from dispatch.web.app import app

        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.get("/api/fonts")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = response.json()
        self.assertIn("fonts", data)
        self.assertIsInstance(data["fonts"], list)
        self.assertGreater(len(data["fonts"]), 0)

    def test_api_import_invalid_font_extension(self):
        """Uploading non-ttf/otf files must return 400 with helpful error."""
        from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
        from dispatch.web.app import app

        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.post(
            "/api/fonts/import",
            files={"file": ("virus.exe", b"not a font file", "application/octet-stream")}
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn("Only .ttf and .otf", response.json()["detail"])

    def test_api_import_corrupt_font_file(self):
        """Uploading corrupt font file must return 400 with validation failure message."""
        from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
        from dispatch.web.app import app

        client = TestClient(app)
        response = client.post(
            "/api/fonts/import",
            files={"file": ("fake_font.ttf", b"corrupt" * 200, "font/ttf")}
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
        self.assertIn("Corrupt or invalid font format", response.json()["detail"])

    def test_api_import_valid_ttf(self):
        """Uploading genuine TTF must succeed, parse family, and return font entry."""
        from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
        from dispatch.web.app import app
        from dispatch.config import BUNDLED_FONTS_DIR

        # Use Anton from bundled fonts as test upload
        sample_font = BUNDLED_FONTS_DIR / "Anton-Regular.ttf"
        if not sample_font.exists():
            return

        client = TestClient(app)
        with open(sample_font, "rb") as f:
            content = f.read()

        response = client.post(
            "/api/fonts/import",
            files={"file": ("CustomTestFont.ttf", content, "font/ttf")}
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = response.json()
        self.assertTrue(data.get("success"))
        font = data.get("font")
        self.assertIsNotNone(font)
        self.assertTrue(font.get("is_custom"))
        self.assertEqual(font.get("filename"), "CustomTestFont.ttf")

    def test_capcut_style_export_parity(self):
        """Verify export parity for case transforms, italic/underline, shadow distance/angle, and alpha."""
        my_style = StyleConfig(
            font_family="Montserrat",
            font_size=48,
            font_weight="bold",
            font_style="italic",
            underline=True,
            text_transform="title",
            text_opacity=0.8,
            outline_enabled=True,
            outline_color="#000000",
            outline_width=4.0,
            outline_opacity=0.6,
            shadow_enabled=True,
            shadow_color="#111111",
            shadow_distance=5.0,
            shadow_angle=90.0,
            shadow_opacity=0.5,
            background_enabled=True,
            background_mode="line",
            background_color="#222222",
            background_opacity=0.9
        )
        track = CaptionTrack(
            default_style=my_style,
            groups=[
                CaptionGroup(
                    id="g1",
                    start=0.0,
                    end=2.0,
                    style=my_style,
                    words=[
                        Word(id="w1", text="super", start=0.0, end=1.0),
                        Word(id="w2", text="creator", start=1.0, end=2.0, style_override=WordStyleOverride(underline=False)),
                    ]
                )
            ]
        )
        ass_path = self.temp_path / "test_capcut.ass"
        export_to_ass(track, ass_path)

        with open(ass_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()

        # 1. Boxed style in V4+ Styles
        self.assertIn("Style: Boxed", content)

        # 2. Italic & Underline tags
        self.assertIn(r"\i1", content)
        self.assertIn(r"\u1", content)

        # 3. Directional shadow: angle 90 deg -> x=0, y=5.0
        self.assertIn(r"\xshad0.0\yshad5.0", content)

        # 4. Title case transform in dialogue
        self.assertIn("Super", content)
        self.assertIn("Creator", content)

        # 5. Word override underline negation
        self.assertIn(r"\u0", content)

        # 6. Dialogue uses Boxed style
        self.assertIn(",Boxed,", content)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Unit tests for Gemini Two-Stage Transcription Engine."""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace

from dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine import (
    _parse_offset_to_seconds,
    check_and_increment_daily_transcribe_quota,
    transcribe_stage1_flash_lite,
    transcribe_stage2_precision_words,
    _parse_stage1_time,
    _deduplicate_overlapping_segments,
    drain_queued_transcriptions,
)
from dispatch import db
from dispatch.transcription.audio import _probe_audio_duration, split_audio_for_transcription


def fake_genai_module():
    module = ModuleType("google.genai")
    module.types = SimpleNamespace(
        GenerateContentConfig=lambda **kwargs: kwargs,
        AudioTranscriptionConfig=lambda **kwargs: kwargs,
    )
    return module


class TestGeminiTwoStage(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_parse_offset_to_seconds(self):
        self.assertEqual(_parse_offset_to_seconds("0.100s"), 0.1)
        self.assertEqual(_parse_offset_to_seconds("2.450s"), 2.45)
        self.assertEqual(_parse_offset_to_seconds("15s"), 15.0)
        self.assertEqual(_parse_offset_to_seconds(3.5), 3.5)
        self.assertEqual(_parse_offset_to_seconds(None), 0.0)

    def test_daily_transcribe_quota_tracking(self):
        # Reset test state
        db.set_setting("transcribe_quota_date", "2026-01-01")
        db.set_setting("transcribe_quota_count", "0")

        # First 5 calls pass with limit=5
        for i in range(1, 6):
            self.assertTrue(check_and_increment_daily_transcribe_quota(max_daily_requests=5))

        # 6th call exceeds limit
        self.assertFalse(check_and_increment_daily_transcribe_quota(max_daily_requests=5))

    @patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.get_gemini_client")
    def test_transcribe_stage1_flash_lite(self, mock_get_client):
        mock_client = MagicMock()
        mock_get_client.return_value = mock_client

        mock_file = MagicMock()
        mock_file.name = "files/test1234"
        mock_client.files.upload.return_value = mock_file

        mock_resp = MagicMock()
        mock_resp.text = '[{"start": "00:01.00", "end": "00:04.50", "text": "Testing hook", "speaker": "Speaker 1"}]'
        mock_client.models.generate_content.return_value = mock_resp

        # Create dummy audio file
        test_file = Path("storage/test_dummy.mp3")
        test_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        test_file.write_bytes(b"dummy")

        with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"google.genai": fake_genai_module()}), \
             patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.split_audio_for_transcription", return_value=[(test_file, 0.0)]):
            segments = transcribe_stage1_flash_lite(test_file)
        try:
            self.assertEqual(len(segments), 1)
            self.assertEqual(segments[0]["start"], 1.0)
            self.assertEqual(segments[0]["end"], 4.5)
            self.assertEqual(segments[0]["text"], "Testing hook")
        finally:
            if test_file.exists():
                test_file.unlink()

    @patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.get_gemini_client")
    def test_transcribe_stage2_precision_words(self, mock_get_client):
        mock_client = MagicMock()
        mock_get_client.return_value = mock_client

        mock_file = MagicMock()
        mock_file.name = "files/test5678"
        mock_client.files.upload.return_value = mock_file

        # Mock WordInfo
        w1 = MagicMock()
        w1.word = "Hello"
        w1.start_offset = "0.200s"
        w1.end_offset = "0.500s"

        w2 = MagicMock()
        w2.word = "world"
        w2.start_offset = "0.600s"
        w2.end_offset = "1.100s"

        part = MagicMock()
        trans = MagicMock()
        trans.speaker_label = "spk:0"
        trans.words = [w1, w2]
        part.audio_transcription = trans

        cand = MagicMock()
        cand.content.parts = [part]

        mock_resp = MagicMock()
        mock_resp.text = "Hello world"
        mock_resp.candidates = [cand]
        mock_client.models.generate_content.return_value = mock_resp

        test_file = Path("storage/test_dummy_clip.mp3")
        test_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        test_file.write_bytes(b"dummy")

        with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"google.genai": fake_genai_module()}), \
             patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine._probe_audio_duration", return_value=3.0):

            self.assertEqual(len(result["words"]), 2)

            self.assertEqual(result["speech_end"], 1.1)
        finally:
            if test_file.exists():
                test_file.unlink()

    def test_stage1_combines_part_transcripts_on_original_timeline(self):
        client = MagicMock()
        client.files.upload.side_effect = [SimpleNamespace(name="part-one"), SimpleNamespace(name="part-two")]
        client.models.generate_content.side_effect = [
            SimpleNamespace(text='[{"start":"00:09.00","end":"00:10.00","text":"first"}]'),
            SimpleNamespace(text='[{"start":"00:01.00","end":"00:02.00","text":"second"}]'),
        ]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = Path(tmp) / "long.mp3"
            first = Path(tmp) / "first.mp3"
            second = Path(tmp) / "second.mp3"
            source.write_bytes(b"source")
            first.write_bytes(b"part 1")
            second.write_bytes(b"part 2")
            with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"google.genai": fake_genai_module()}), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.get_gemini_client", return_value=client), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.split_audio_for_transcription",
                       return_value=[(first, 0.0), (second, 595.0)]) as split_audio:
                segments = transcribe_stage1_flash_lite(source)

        split_audio.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(split_audio.call_args.kwargs["overlap_seconds"], 5.0)
        self.assertEqual([item["start"] for item in segments], [9.0, 596.0])
        self.assertEqual([item["text"] for item in segments], ["first", "second"])
        self.assertEqual(client.files.delete.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(_parse_stage1_time("01:02:03.5"), 3723.5)

    def test_stage1_deduplicates_only_adjacent_window_boundary_phrases(self):
        segments = [
            {"start": 597.5, "end": 599.5, "text": "same phrase", "speaker": "one", "_source_part_index": 0},
            {"start": 598.1, "end": 600.2, "text": "Same phrase.", "speaker": "one", "_source_part_index": 1},
            {"start": 601.0, "end": 602.0, "text": "same phrase", "speaker": "one", "_source_part_index": 1},
        ]
        merged = _deduplicate_overlapping_segments(segments, overlap_seconds=5.0)
        self.assertEqual(len(merged), 2)
        self.assertEqual(merged[0]["start"], 597.5)
        self.assertEqual(merged[0]["end"], 600.2)
        self.assertNotIn("_source_part_index", merged[0])

    def test_stage2_rejects_full_source_audio_before_upload(self):
        client = MagicMock()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = Path(tmp) / "multi_hour.mp3"
            source.write_bytes(b"fixture")
            with patch.dict(sys.modules, {"google.genai": fake_genai_module()}), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.get_gemini_client", return_value=client), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine._probe_audio_duration", return_value=7200.0):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Full-source transcription is disabled"):
                    transcribe_stage2_precision_words(source)
        client.files.upload.assert_not_called()

    @unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which("ffmpeg") and shutil.which("ffprobe"), "FFmpeg tools are required")
    def test_long_audio_split_keeps_order_offsets_and_short_final_part(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = Path(tmp) / "source.mp3"
            parts_dir = Path(tmp) / "parts"
            subprocess.run(
                ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                 "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "sine=frequency=440:duration=2.2", "-c:a", "libmp3lame",
                 "-b:a", "32k", str(source)],
                check=True,
            )
            parts = split_audio_for_transcription(source, parts_dir, chunk_seconds=1)
            offsets = [offset for _, offset in parts]
            self.assertEqual(offsets[0], 0.0)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(offsets[1], 0.9, delta=0.01)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(offsets[2], 1.8, delta=0.01)
            self.assertTrue(all(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size > 0 for path, _ in parts))
            self.assertLess(_probe_audio_duration(parts[-1][0]), 1.0, "the final segment is a valid shorter remainder")

    def test_stage2_slice_failure_retries_and_never_transcribes_source(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = Path(tmp) / "long_source.mp4"
            source.write_bytes(b"source fixture")
            process_dir = Path(tmp) / "processing"
            clip = {
                "id": "clip-stage2-slice-failure", "chunk_id": "chunk-stage2-slice-failure",
                "start_time": 100.0, "end_time": 120.0,
                "padded_start": 96.0, "padded_end": 124.0,
            }
            failed_ffmpeg = SimpleNamespace(returncode=1, stderr="synthetic extraction error")
            with patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.db.get_queued_transcription_clips", return_value=[clip]), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.db.get_chunk_by_id", return_value={"filepath": str(source)}), \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.check_and_increment_daily_transcribe_quota", return_value=True), \
                 patch("subprocess.run", return_value=failed_ffmpeg) as run_ffmpeg, \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.transcribe_stage2_precision_words") as transcribe, \
                 patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.PROCESSING_DIR", process_dir):
                drained = drain_queued_transcriptions(max_batch=1)
            self.assertEqual(drained, 0)
            self.assertEqual(run_ffmpeg.call_count, 2, "bounded extraction gets one safe retry")
            transcribe.assert_not_called()

    def test_transcription_queue_stats_and_backlog(self):
        # Insert a queued_transcription clip directly into SQLite
        clip_id = "test_queued_clip_999"
        with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
            conn.cursor().execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE id = ?", (clip_id,))
            conn.cursor().execute("""
                INSERT INTO clips (id, start_time, end_time, padded_start, padded_end, duration, title, hook, virality_score, status)
                VALUES (?, 10.0, 40.0, 6.0, 44.0, 30.0, 'Test Clip', 'Test Hook', 85, 'queued_transcription')
            """, (clip_id,))
            conn.commit()

        try:
            queued = db.get_queued_transcription_clips(limit=10)
            self.assertTrue(any(c["id"] == clip_id for c in queued))

            stats = db.get_transcription_queue_stats()
            self.assertGreaterEqual(stats["queued_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(stats["daily_quota_max"], 25)
        finally:
            with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
                conn.cursor().execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE id = ?", (clip_id,))
                conn.commit()

    @patch("dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine.check_and_increment_daily_transcribe_quota")
    def test_drain_queued_transcriptions_respects_quota(self, mock_quota):
        # When quota is exhausted, drain stops immediately
        mock_quota.return_value = False
        from dispatch.transcription.gemini_engine import drain_queued_transcriptions
        drained = drain_queued_transcriptions(max_batch=5)
        self.assertEqual(drained, 0)

"""Unit test for Phase 4: Resource Governor & Laptop Performance Manager."""
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from dispatch.governor.resource_governor import ResourceGovernor, GovernorPolicy


class TestResourceGovernor(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_live_metrics_retrieval(self):
        governor = ResourceGovernor()
        metrics = governor.get_system_metrics()
        self.assertIn("free_disk_gb", metrics)
        self.assertIn("on_ac_power", metrics)
        self.assertIn("cpu_percent", metrics)
        self.assertIn("idle_seconds", metrics)
        self.assertGreater(metrics["total_disk_gb"], 0)

    def test_optimal_worker_threads(self):
        policy = GovernorPolicy(reserved_cpu_cores=2)
        governor = ResourceGovernor(policy=policy)
        threads = governor.get_optimal_worker_threads()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(threads, 1)

    def test_low_process_priority(self):
        governor = ResourceGovernor()
        # Should succeed or gracefully handle without throwing exceptions
        success = governor.set_low_process_priority()
        self.assertIsInstance(success, bool)

    def test_disk_space_policy_enforcement(self):
        # Policy requiring 500 GB free disk space (which test machine doesn't have)
        policy = GovernorPolicy(min_free_disk_gb=500.0)
        governor = ResourceGovernor(policy=policy)
        can_run, reason = governor.can_process_heavy_task()
        self.assertFalse(can_run)
        self.assertIn("Disk space low", reason)

    def test_battery_policy_enforcement(self):
        # Mock battery status: on battery, 20%
        mock_battery = MagicMock()
        mock_battery.power_plugged = False
        mock_battery.percent = 20.0

        with patch("psutil.sensors_battery", return_value=mock_battery), \
             patch("psutil.cpu_percent", return_value=10.0):
            # Case 1: allow_on_battery = False -> Should disallow
            policy1 = GovernorPolicy(allow_on_battery=False, min_free_disk_gb=1.0)
            gov1 = ResourceGovernor(policy1)
            can_run1, reason1 = gov1.can_process_heavy_task()
            self.assertFalse(can_run1)
            self.assertIn("battery", reason1.lower())

            # Case 2: allow_on_battery = True, but min_battery_percent = 30% -> Should disallow
            policy2 = GovernorPolicy(allow_on_battery=True, min_battery_percent=30.0, min_free_disk_gb=1.0)
            gov2 = ResourceGovernor(policy2)
            can_run2, reason2 = gov2.can_process_heavy_task()
            self.assertFalse(can_run2)
            self.assertIn("too low", reason2.lower())

            # Case 3: allow_on_battery = True, min_battery_percent = 15% -> Should allow
            policy3 = GovernorPolicy(allow_on_battery=True, min_battery_percent=15.0, min_free_disk_gb=1.0)
            gov3 = ResourceGovernor(policy3)
            with patch.object(gov3, "get_user_idle_seconds", return_value=200.0):
                can_run3, reason3 = gov3.can_process_heavy_task()
                self.assertTrue(can_run3)

    def test_user_activity_policy_enforcement(self):
        policy = GovernorPolicy(pause_when_user_active=True, idle_threshold_seconds=60.0, min_free_disk_gb=1.0)
        governor = ResourceGovernor(policy=policy)

        # Mock user actively typing (idle 5 seconds)
        with patch.object(governor, "get_user_idle_seconds", return_value=5.0):
            mock_battery = MagicMock()
            mock_battery.power_plugged = True
            mock_battery.percent = 100.0
            with patch("psutil.sensors_battery", return_value=mock_battery):
                can_run, reason = governor.can_process_heavy_task()
                self.assertFalse(can_run)
                self.assertIn("actively using", reason)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

FILE: tests\test_ingest_privacy_gate.py
============================================================
"""Privacy gate regressions: private and unverifiable sources are rejected before
any download; only public/unlisted may proceed (Friends-ready Alpha contract)."""

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from dispatch import db
from dispatch.youtube_inbox.catcher import YouTubeInboxCatcher


class TestIngestPrivacyGate(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="privacy_gate_")
        from dispatch.config import STORAGE_DIR
        self._orig_storage = STORAGE_DIR
        import dispatch.config as cfg
        cfg.STORAGE_DIR = Path(self.tmp.name)
        cfg.DATABASE_DIR = Path(self.tmp.name) / "database"
        cfg.DATABASE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        db.init_db()

    def tearDown(self):
        import dispatch.config as cfg
        cfg.STORAGE_DIR = self._orig_storage
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def _ingest(self, verdict):
        downloads = []
        with patch("dispatch.youtube_inbox.oauth.get_youtube_processing_status",
                   side_effect=lambda ids: {i: {"privacy_status": verdict} for i in ids}), \
             patch("dispatch.ingestion.validator.probe_video",
                   lambda f: (True, {"duration": 10.0, "width": 720, "height": 1280}, None)), \
             patch.object(YouTubeInboxCatcher, "fetch_video_info",
                          lambda self, vid: {"id": vid, "title": "t", "duration": 10}), \
             patch.object(YouTubeInboxCatcher, "download_video", self._fake_download(downloads)):
            return YouTubeInboxCatcher().ingest_video("priv_gate_1"), downloads

    def _fake_download(self, downloads):
        tmp = Path(self.tmp.name)
        def fake(self_, vid):
            f = tmp / f"{vid}.mp4"
            f.write_bytes(b"x")
            downloads.append(vid)
            return f
        return fake

    def test_private_source_rejected_before_download(self):
        result, downloads = self._ingest("private")
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "FAILED")
        self.assertIn("Private", result["error"])
        self.assertEqual(downloads, [])  # never touched yt-dlp

    def test_unverifiable_source_rejected(self):
        result, downloads = self._ingest("")
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "FAILED")
        self.assertIn("could not be verified", result["error"])
        self.assertEqual(downloads, [])

    def test_public_and_unlisted_pass_gate(self):
        for verdict in ("public", "unlisted"):
            result, _ = self._ingest(verdict)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.get("status"), "FAILED", msg=verdict)


    def test_configured_cookies_cannot_bypass_private_rejection(self):
        """B1 #7: even with authenticated yt-dlp cookies configured, a PRIVATE verdict
        is rejected before download - yt-dlp access is never treated as visibility."""
        import os
        os.environ["DISPATCH_YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE"] = "cookies.txt"
        try:
            result, downloads = self._ingest("private")
            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "FAILED")
            self.assertEqual(downloads, [])
        finally:
            del os.environ["DISPATCH_YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Test suite for Dispatch ingestion and validation."""
import unittest
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from dispatch.config import INCOMING_DIR, PROCESSING_DIR
from dispatch.ingestion.validator import probe_video, calculate_file_hash
from dispatch.ingestion.watcher import process_incoming_file
from dispatch.db import init_db, get_db_connection


class TestIngestion(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        init_db()

    def test_ingestion(self):
        test_video = INCOMING_DIR / "unit_test_video.mp4"
        
        # Generate 2-second 1080p landscape test video with sine audio
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc=size=1920x1080:rate=30",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "sine=frequency=1000",
            "-t", "2",
            "-c:v", "libx264",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            str(test_video)
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)
        
        # 1. Test probe
        is_valid, meta, err = probe_video(test_video)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid, f"Validation failed: {err}")
        self.assertEqual(meta["aspect_ratio"], "16:9", f"Expected 16:9, got {meta['aspect_ratio']}")
        self.assertTrue(meta["has_audio"], "Audio track missing")
        self.assertGreater(meta["duration"], 1.8, f"Duration unexpected: {meta['duration']}")
        
        # 2. Test hash
        f_hash = calculate_file_hash(test_video)
        self.assertEqual(len(f_hash), 32, f"Invalid hash: {f_hash}")
        
        # 3. Test staging via watcher
        result = process_incoming_file(test_video)
        self.assertIsNotNone(result, "Failed to process incoming file")
        self.assertTrue(result["filepath"].exists(), "Staged file not found in processing")
        self.assertEqual(result["filepath"].parent, PROCESSING_DIR, "File was not moved to processing")
        self.assertFalse(test_video.exists(), "Original file should have been moved")
        
        # Clean up test artifact
        result["filepath"].unlink()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

FILE: tests\test_job_queue.py

"""Unit test for Phase 3: Persistent job queue, leases, checkpoints, and crash recovery."""
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from dispatch.db import init_db, register_chunk, get_db_connection
from dispatch.orchestrator.state_machine import PipelineStage, JobStatus
from dispatch.orchestrator.job_queue import (
    init_job_queue_schema,
    enqueue_job,
    claim_job,
    renew_heartbeat,
    complete_stage_checkpoint,
    fail_stage_job
)
from dispatch.orchestrator.recovery import recover_laptop_orchestrator


class TestJobQueue(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        init_db()
        init_job_queue_schema()

    def test_job_queue_and_recovery(self):
        # 1. Register a test chunk
        chunk_id = register_chunk(
            session_id="test_sess_p3",
            filename="test_chunk_p3.mp4",
            filepath="storage/processing/test_chunk_p3.mp4",
            file_hash="dummy_hash_p3"
        )

        # 2. Enqueue job
        job_id = enqueue_job(chunk_id=chunk_id, session_id="test_sess_p3")
        self.assertIsNotNone(job_id)

        # 3. Worker 1 claims job
        claimed = claim_job(worker_id="worker_alpha", lease_duration_seconds=30)
        self.assertIsNotNone(claimed)
        self.assertEqual(claimed["job_id"], job_id)
        self.assertEqual(claimed["current_stage"], "VERIFY")
        self.assertEqual(claimed["status"], "PROCESSING")

        # 4. Advance checkpoint: VERIFY -> TRANSCRIBE
        next_stg = complete_stage_checkpoint(job_id, PipelineStage.VERIFY)
        self.assertEqual(next_stg, PipelineStage.TRANSCRIBE)

        # Worker claims job at TRANSCRIBE stage
        claimed2 = claim_job(worker_id="worker_alpha", lease_duration_seconds=30)
        self.assertEqual(claimed2["job_id"], job_id)
        self.assertEqual(claimed2["current_stage"], "TRANSCRIBE")

        # 5. SIMULATE POWER LOSS / WORKER CRASH:
        # Expire the lease in the past
        past_time = (datetime.now() - timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat()
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE pipeline_jobs SET lease_expires_at = ? WHERE job_id = ?", (past_time, job_id))

        # Run boot recovery
        recovery = recover_laptop_orchestrator()
        self.assertIn(job_id, recovery["reclaimed_jobs"])

        # Verify job is RETRY_PENDING and retained stage TRANSCRIBE (checkpoint preserved!)
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT status, current_stage, worker_id FROM pipeline_jobs WHERE job_id = ?", (job_id,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(row["status"], "RETRY_PENDING")
            self.assertEqual(row["current_stage"], "TRANSCRIBE", "Job should have resumed from TRANSCRIBE checkpoint!")
            self.assertIsNone(row["worker_id"])

        # 6. Worker 2 claims and finishes through all stages
        claimed3 = claim_job(worker_id="worker_beta", lease_duration_seconds=30)
        self.assertEqual(claimed3["job_id"], job_id)
        self.assertEqual(claimed3["current_stage"], "TRANSCRIBE")

        # Advance TRANSCRIBE -> ANALYZE
        complete_stage_checkpoint(job_id, PipelineStage.TRANSCRIBE)
        claimed4 = claim_job(worker_id="worker_beta")
        self.assertEqual(claimed4["current_stage"], "ANALYZE")

        # Advance ANALYZE -> RENDER
        complete_stage_checkpoint(job_id, PipelineStage.ANALYZE)
        claimed5 = claim_job(worker_id="worker_beta")
        self.assertEqual(claimed5["current_stage"], "RENDER")

        # Advance RENDER -> FINALIZE
        complete_stage_checkpoint(job_id, PipelineStage.RENDER)
        claimed6 = claim_job(worker_id="worker_beta")
        self.assertEqual(claimed6["current_stage"], "FINALIZE")

        # Advance FINALIZE -> COMPLETED
        final_stg = complete_stage_checkpoint(job_id, PipelineStage.FINALIZE)
        self.assertEqual(final_stg, PipelineStage.COMPLETED)

        # Verify final status in DB
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT status, current_stage FROM pipeline_jobs WHERE job_id = ?", (job_id,))
            final_row = cursor.fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(final_row["status"], "COMPLETED")
            self.assertEqual(final_row["current_stage"], "COMPLETED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Unit and integration tests for the Layout Framing Architecture.
Tests source media resolution, streaming, stale render detection, and automatic
re-rendering across dynamic framing modes for BOTH Portrait (9:16) and Landscape (16:9) inputs.
"""
import unittest
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from dispatch.config import PROCESSING_DIR, CLIPS_DIR
from dispatch import db
from dispatch.video_engine.renderer import render_clip
from dispatch.ingestion.validator import inspect_video_orientation
from dispatch.web.app import app


class TestLayoutFramingArchitecture(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        db.init_db()
        cls.client = TestClient(app)
        
        # 1. Create a 3-second 16:9 landscape test video (1280x720) with audio
        cls.source_video = PROCESSING_DIR / "test_framing_source_16x9.mp4"
        cmd_land = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc=size=1280x720:rate=25",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "sine=frequency=440",
            "-t", "6",
            "-c:v", "libx264",
            "-preset", "ultrafast",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            str(cls.source_video)
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd_land, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)

        # 2. Create a 6-second 9:16 portrait test video (720x1280) with audio
        cls.source_video_portrait = PROCESSING_DIR / "test_framing_source_9x16.mp4"
        cmd_port = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc=size=720x1280:rate=25",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "sine=frequency=520",
            "-t", "6",
            "-c:v", "libx264",
            "-preset", "ultrafast",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            str(cls.source_video_portrait)
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd_port, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        if cls.source_video.exists():
            cls.source_video.unlink()
        if cls.source_video_portrait.exists():
            cls.source_video_portrait.unlink()

    def setUp(self):
        self.session_id = f"sess_test_frame_{Path(self.source_video).stem}"
        self.chunk_id = f"chk_test_frame_{Path(self.source_video).stem}"
        self.clip_id = f"clip_test_frame_{Path(self.source_video).stem}"

        self.chunk_id_port = f"chk_test_port_{Path(self.source_video_portrait).stem}"
        self.clip_id_port = f"clip_test_port_{Path(self.source_video_portrait).stem}"
        
        with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sessions (id, status)
                VALUES (?, 'completed')
            """, (self.session_id,))

            # 1. Register Landscape Chunk & Clip
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO chunks (id, session_id, filename, filepath, file_hash, status, duration, width, height, aspect_ratio)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'hash_test_frame', 'processed', 6.0, 1280, 720, '16:9')
            """, (self.chunk_id, self.session_id, self.source_video.name, str(self.source_video)))
            
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO clips (
                    id, session_id, chunk_id, start_time, end_time, duration,
                    title, hook, description, hashtags, virality_score,
                    layout_mode, rendered_layout_mode, status, publish_mode, platform_targets
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0.5, 5.5, 5.0,
                    'Testing Layout Architecture', 'Hook text', 'Desc', '#test', 90,
                    'fit_blur', NULL, 'ready_review', 'private', 'youtube,instagram'
                )
            """, (self.clip_id, self.session_id, self.chunk_id))

            # 2. Register Portrait Chunk & Clip
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO chunks (id, session_id, filename, filepath, file_hash, status, duration, width, height, aspect_ratio)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'hash_test_port', 'processed', 6.0, 720, 1280, '9:16')
            """, (self.chunk_id_port, self.session_id, self.source_video_portrait.name, str(self.source_video_portrait)))

            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO clips (
                    id, session_id, chunk_id, start_time, end_time, duration,
                    title, hook, description, hashtags, virality_score,
                    layout_mode, rendered_layout_mode, status, publish_mode, platform_targets
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0.5, 5.5, 5.0,
                    'Testing Portrait Layout Architecture', 'Hook text port', 'Desc', '#port', 88,
                    'native_916', NULL, 'ready_review', 'private', 'youtube,instagram'
                )
            """, (self.clip_id_port, self.session_id, self.chunk_id_port))
            conn.commit()

    def tearDown(self):
        with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM clips WHERE id IN (?, ?)", (self.clip_id, self.clip_id_port))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE id IN (?, ?)", (self.chunk_id, self.chunk_id_port))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?", (self.session_id,))
            conn.commit()
        for f in CLIPS_DIR.glob(f"{self.clip_id}*"):
            try:
                f.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass
        for f in CLIPS_DIR.glob(f"{self.clip_id_port}*"):
            try:
                f.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def test_01_source_media_endpoint_streams_raw_chunk(self):
        """GET /api/clips/{id}/source streams the raw source media with clip headers."""
        res = self.client.get(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}/source")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(res.headers.get("content-type"), "video/mp4")
        self.assertEqual(res.headers.get("x-clip-start"), "0.5")
        self.assertEqual(res.headers.get("x-clip-end"), "5.5")
        self.assertEqual(res.headers.get("x-clip-duration"), "5.0")
        self.assertGreater(len(res.content), 1000)

    def test_02_layout_change_persists_and_marks_stale(self):
        """POST /api/clips/{id}/layout updates layout_mode and flags is_render_stale."""
        # 1. Initial render with fit_blur
        render_clip(
            source_video=self.source_video,
            clip_id=self.clip_id,
            start_time=0.5,
            end_time=5.5,
            aspect_ratio="16:9",
            layout_mode="fit_blur"
        )
        clip = db.get_clip_by_id(self.clip_id)
        self.assertEqual(clip["rendered_layout_mode"], "fit_blur")
        self.assertEqual(clip["layout_mode"], "fit_blur")

        # 2. Check detail endpoint
        res = self.client.get(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200)
        data = res.json()
        self.assertFalse(data["is_render_stale"])

        # 3. User switches to fit_black
        res = self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}/layout", json={"layout_mode": "fit_black"})
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200)
        data = res.json()
        self.assertEqual(data["layout_mode"], "fit_black")
        self.assertEqual(data["rendered_layout_mode"], "fit_blur")
        self.assertTrue(data["is_render_stale"])

        # 4. Detail endpoint reflects stale state
        res = self.client.get(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}")
        data = res.json()
        self.assertTrue(data["is_render_stale"])
        self.assertEqual(data["layout_mode"], "fit_black")

    def test_03_approve_detects_stale_and_rerenders_from_source(self):
        """Approve automatically re-renders from source when rendered_layout_mode != layout_mode."""
        # Initial render as fit_blur
        render_clip(
            source_video=self.source_video,
            clip_id=self.clip_id,
            start_time=0.5,
            end_time=5.5,
            aspect_ratio="16:9",
            layout_mode="fit_blur"
        )
        
        # User changes framing to fit_black
        self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}/layout", json={"layout_mode": "fit_black"})
        
        # User approves clip
        res = self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}/approve", json={
            "title": "Approved Title",
            "layout_mode": "fit_black"
        })
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200)

        # Verify DB updated and rendered_layout_mode is now fit_black
        clip = db.get_clip_by_id(self.clip_id)
        self.assertEqual(clip["status"], "approved")
        self.assertEqual(clip["layout_mode"], "fit_black")
        self.assertEqual(clip["rendered_layout_mode"], "fit_black")
        self.assertTrue(Path(clip["video_path"]).exists())
        self.assertGreater(Path(clip["video_path"]).stat().st_size, 1000)

    def test_04_explicit_render_all_four_landscape_modes(self):
        """POST /api/clips/{id}/render re-renders successfully for all 4 landscape modes."""
        modes = ["crop_916", "fit_blur", "fit_black", "native_169"]
        for mode in modes:
            res = self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id}/render", json={"layout_mode": mode})
            self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200, f"Render failed for {mode}")
            data = res.json()
            self.assertEqual(data["layout_mode"], mode)
            self.assertEqual(data["rendered_layout_mode"], mode)
            self.assertFalse(data["is_render_stale"])

            clip = db.get_clip_by_id(self.clip_id)
            self.assertEqual(clip["rendered_layout_mode"], mode)
            out_path = Path(clip["video_path"])
            self.assertTrue(out_path.exists())
            self.assertGreater(out_path.stat().st_size, 1000)

            # Probe geometry
            info = inspect_video_orientation(out_path)
            self.assertTrue(info["valid"])
            if mode == "native_169":
                self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1920)
                self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1080)
            else:
                self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1080)
                self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1920)

    def test_05_portrait_input_validates_dynamic_three_options(self):
        """Portrait 9:16 source yields EXACTLY 3 valid options and rejects crop options."""
        res = self.client.get(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id_port}")
        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200)
        data = res.json()
        self.assertEqual(data["source_orientation"], "portrait")
        modes = data["available_layout_modes"]
        self.assertEqual(len(modes), 3)
        mode_ids = [m["id"] for m in modes]
        self.assertEqual(mode_ids, ["fit_black", "fit_blur", "native_916"])
        
        # Verify target aspect ratios
        aspect_by_id = {m["id"]: m["target_aspect"] for m in modes}
        self.assertEqual(aspect_by_id["fit_black"], "16:9")
        self.assertEqual(aspect_by_id["fit_blur"], "16:9")
        self.assertEqual(aspect_by_id["native_916"], "9:16")

    def test_06_portrait_input_rejects_invalid_modes(self):
        """Portrait 9:16 source rejects crop_916 and landscape modes."""
        for invalid_mode in ("crop_916", "crop_follow", "landscape", "native_169"):
            res = self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id_port}/layout", json={"layout_mode": invalid_mode})
            self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 400, f"Mode {invalid_mode} should have been rejected for portrait source")

    def test_07_portrait_input_renders_all_three_modes_with_exact_geometry(self):
        """Portrait 9:16 source renders fit_black (16:9), fit_blur (16:9), and native_916 (9:16)."""
        for mode in ("fit_black", "fit_blur", "native_916"):
            res = self.client.post(f"/api/clips/{self.clip_id_port}/render", json={"layout_mode": mode})
            self.assertEqual(res.status_code, 200, f"Render failed for portrait {mode}")
            clip = db.get_clip_by_id(self.clip_id_port)
            out_path = Path(clip["video_path"])
            self.assertTrue(out_path.exists())
            
            info = inspect_video_orientation(out_path)
            self.assertTrue(info["valid"])
            if mode in ("fit_black", "fit_blur"):
                # Output must be 16:9 widescreen (1920x1080)
                self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1920, f"{mode} width should be 1920")
                self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1080, f"{mode} height should be 1080")
                self.assertEqual(info["orientation"], "landscape")
            else:
                # Output must be 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)
                self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1080, f"{mode} width should be 1080")
                self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1920, f"{mode} height should be 1920")
                self.assertEqual(info["orientation"], "portrait")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()


============================================================
FILE: tests\test_migration_grant_hygiene.py
============================================================
"""Migration hygiene guard (audit 2026-10-24): every table created in the public
schema must be accompanied by explicit REVOKEs for anon/authenticated (or an
explicit grant-only-select), because Postgres grants ALL to PUBLIC by default on
new tables and TRUNCATE bypasses RLS. Catches the 0004/0006/0007 defect class at
authoring time instead of in a live audit."""

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

MIGRATIONS = sorted(Path("supabase/migrations").glob("*.sql"))


class TestMigrationGrantHygiene(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_migrations_exist(self):
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(MIGRATIONS), 8)

    def test_every_created_table_has_anonymous_revokes(self):
        problems = []
        for path in MIGRATIONS:
            sql = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            created = re.findall(
                r"create\s+table\s+(?:if\s+not\s+exists\s+)?public\.(\w+)", sql, re.I)
            for table in created:
                # each table must appear in a revoke targeting anon/authenticated
                # somewhere in the migration set (this or any later file)
                later = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in MIGRATIONS)
                per_table = re.compile(
                    r"revoke\s+all\s+on\s+public\." + re.escape(table) +
                    r"\s+from\s+[^;]*anon", re.I)
                schema_wide = re.compile(
                    r"revoke\s+all\s+on\s+all\s+tables\s+in\s+schema\s+public\s+from\s+[^;]*anon", re.I)
                if not (per_table.search(later) or schema_wide.search(later)):
                    problems.append(f"{path.name}: public.{table} has no REVOKE ... from anon")
        self.assertEqual(problems, [], "Tables missing explicit client revokes: " + "; ".join(problems))

    def test_no_table_grants_writes_to_anon_or_authenticated(self):
        for path in MIGRATIONS:
            sql = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for m in re.finditer(
                r"grant\s+([\w,\s]+?)\s+on\s+(?:table\s+)?public\.(\w+)\s+to\s+([^;]+)", sql, re.I):
                privs, table, roles = m.groups()
                roles_l = roles.lower()
                if ("anon" in roles_l or "authenticated" in roles_l) and "select" != privs.strip().lower():
                    self.fail(f"{path.name}: grants '{privs.strip()}' on public.{table} to {roles.strip()}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Unit test for Phase 1: Mobile recording, segmentation, crash recovery, and retention."""
import unittest
import tempfile
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from dispatch_mobile.db import init_mobile_db, get_mobile_db, calculate_sha256
from dispatch_mobile.segmenter import RecordingSessionManager
from dispatch_mobile.recovery import recover_mobile_state
from dispatch_mobile.retention import cleanup_verified_segments


class TestMobileEngine(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        init_mobile_db()

    def test_mobile_engine(self):
        test_storage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dispatch_mob_test_"))
        manager = RecordingSessionManager(storage_dir=test_storage)

        try:
            # 2. Start session and record segment 1
            sess_id = manager.start_session(notes="Test work session")
            self.assertEqual(manager.current_session_id, sess_id)

            # Write simulated bytes to segment 1 .tmp
            seg1_tmp = manager.current_tmp_path
            with open(seg1_tmp, "wb") as f:
                f.write(b"SIMULATED_VIDEO_DATA_SEGMENT_1_AABBCCDD")

            # 3. Roll to segment 2 (atomically finalizes segment 1)
            seg2_info = manager.start_next_segment()
            seg1_final = test_storage / f"{sess_id}_seg_0001.mp4"

            self.assertTrue(seg1_final.exists(), "Segment 1 was not finalized to .mp4")
            self.assertFalse(seg1_tmp.exists(), "Segment 1 .tmp should have been renamed")
            self.assertGreater(seg1_final.stat().st_size, 0)

            # Check DB state for segment 1
            with get_mobile_db() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute("SELECT status, sha256_hash FROM mobile_segments WHERE segment_id = ?",
                               (f"{sess_id}_seg_0001",))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                self.assertEqual(row["status"], "QUEUED_FOR_UPLOAD")
                self.assertIsNotNone(row["sha256_hash"])

            # Write simulated bytes to segment 2 .tmp
            seg2_tmp = manager.current_tmp_path
            with open(seg2_tmp, "wb") as f:
                f.write(b"SIMULATED_VIDEO_DATA_SEGMENT_2_EEFFGGHH")

            # 4. SIMULATE PHONE BATTERY DEATH / CRASH:
            # Instead of calling manager.stop_session(), simulate the process dying mid-recording of segment 2!
            del manager

            # 5. TEST CRASH RECOVERY ON BOOT
            recovery_report = recover_mobile_state(storage_dir=test_storage)
            self.assertIn(f"{sess_id}_seg_0002", recovery_report["recovered_segments"])
            self.assertIn(sess_id, recovery_report["sealed_sessions"])

            seg2_final = test_storage / f"{sess_id}_seg_0002.mp4"
            self.assertTrue(seg2_final.exists(), "Interrupted segment 2 was not recovered on boot")
            self.assertFalse(seg2_tmp.exists(), "Interrupted segment 2 .tmp should be finalized to .mp4")

            # Check outbox has both segments
            with get_mobile_db() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute("SELECT segment_id FROM mobile_outbox WHERE session_id = ?", (sess_id,))
                outbox_segs = [r["segment_id"] for r in cursor.fetchall()]
                self.assertIn(f"{sess_id}_seg_0001", outbox_segs)
                self.assertIn(f"{sess_id}_seg_0002", outbox_segs)

            # 6. TEST RETENTION CLEANUP
            # Segment 1 is not verified yet -> must NOT be deleted
            deleted = cleanup_verified_segments()
            self.assertEqual(deleted, 0)
            self.assertTrue(seg1_final.exists(), "Unverified segment was prematurely deleted!")

            # Mark Segment 1 as VERIFIED_BY_LAPTOP
            with get_mobile_db() as conn:
                conn.execute("""
                    UPDATE mobile_segments 
                    SET status = 'VERIFIED_BY_LAPTOP' 
                    WHERE segment_id = ?
                """, (f"{sess_id}_seg_0001",))

            # Now cleanup should safely delete only Segment 1
            deleted = cleanup_verified_segments()
            self.assertEqual(deleted, 1)
            self.assertFalse(seg1_final.exists(), "Verified segment was not cleaned up")
            self.assertTrue(seg2_final.exists(), "Unverified segment 2 must still exist!")

        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(test_storage, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Unit tests for automatic video orientation normalization and structured logging."""
import unittest
import subprocess
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from dispatch.config import PROCESSING_DIR
from dispatch.ingestion.validator import inspect_video_orientation, normalize_video_orientation, probe_video


class TestOrientationNormalization(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        PROCESSING_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.test_upright = PROCESSING_DIR / "test_upright.mp4"
        self.test_rotated = PROCESSING_DIR / "test_rotated_90.mp4"

        # 1. Generate 1.0s 1920x1080 video with rotate=0
        cmd_upright = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc=size=1920x1080:rate=30",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "sine=frequency=1000",
            "-t", "1.0",
            "-c:v", "libx264",
            "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac",
            str(self.test_upright)
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd_upright, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)

        # 2. Generate 1.0s video with display matrix rotation=90 (simulating phone recording)
        cmd_rotated = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-display_rotation", "90",
            "-i", str(self.test_upright),
            "-c", "copy",
            str(self.test_rotated)
        ]
        subprocess.run(cmd_rotated, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)

    def tearDown(self):
        if self.test_upright.exists():
            self.test_upright.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        if self.test_rotated.exists():
            self.test_rotated.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    def test_inspect_upright_video(self):
        info = inspect_video_orientation(self.test_upright)
        self.assertTrue(info["valid"])
        self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1920)
        self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1080)
        self.assertEqual(info["norm_rotation"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(info["orientation"], "landscape")

    def test_inspect_rotated_video(self):
        info = inspect_video_orientation(self.test_rotated)
        self.assertTrue(info["valid"])
        self.assertEqual(info["width"], 1920)
        self.assertEqual(info["height"], 1080)
        self.assertEqual(info["norm_rotation"], 90)
        # In a 90-degree rotated video, effective width/height are swapped -> portrait
        self.assertEqual(info["effective_width"], 1080)
        self.assertEqual(info["effective_height"], 1920)
        self.assertEqual(info["orientation"], "portrait")

    def test_normalize_rotated_video_transforms_to_physically_upright(self):
        with self.assertLogs("dispatch.ingestion.validator", level=logging.INFO) as log_ctx:
            success, norm_path, info = normalize_video_orientation(self.test_rotated, chunk_id="chk_orient_test")
            self.assertTrue(success)
            self.assertTrue(norm_path.exists())

            # Check that structured logs were emitted
            log_output = "\n".join(log_ctx.output)
            self.assertIn("MEDIA_ORIENTATION_DETECTED", log_output)
            self.assertIn("MEDIA_ORIENTATION_NORMALIZED", log_output)
            self.assertIn("chk_orient_test", log_output)

            # Check that resulting video is physically 1080x1920 with 0 rotation
            final_info = inspect_video_orientation(norm_path)
            self.assertEqual(final_info["width"], 1080)
            self.assertEqual(final_info["height"], 1920)
            self.assertEqual(final_info["norm_rotation"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(final_info["orientation"], "portrait")

    def test_probe_video_auto_normalizes(self):
        is_valid, meta, err = probe_video(self.test_rotated, auto_normalize=True, chunk_id="chk_probe_test")
        self.assertTrue(is_valid, f"Probe error: {err}")
        self.assertEqual(meta["width"], 1080)
        self.assertEqual(meta["height"], 1920)
        self.assertEqual(meta["aspect_ratio"], "9:16")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Regression test suite for Phase 1 Security Lockdown and Sanitization."""
import os
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from dispatch.web.app import app
from dispatch.config import WEB_HOST, ROOT_DIR, CLIPS_DIR
from dispatch import db


class TestPhase1Security(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        db.init_db()
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def test_default_web_host_is_localhost(self):
        """Assert WEB_HOST defaults to 127.0.0.1, not 0.0.0.0."""
        self.assertEqual(WEB_HOST, "127.0.0.1")

    def test_clips_path_traversal_blocked(self):
        """Assert path traversal in /clips/{filename} returns 403 or 404, never serving arbitrary files."""
        # Relative traversal attempt
        resp = self.client.get("/clips/../../dispatch/config.py")
        self.assertIn(resp.status_code, (403, 404))

        resp = self.client.get("/clips/..%2F..%2Fdispatch%2Fconfig.py")
        self.assertIn(resp.status_code, (403, 404))

    def test_reject_nonexistent_clip_returns_404(self):
        """Assert POST /api/clips/{id}/reject returns 404 for nonexistent clips instead of poisoning rejections."""
        resp = self.client.post("/api/clips/nonexistent_clip_999999/reject", json={"reason": "test"})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 404)

    def test_gemini_key_injection_prevention(self):
        """Assert POST /api/integrations/gemini rejects newline injection, null bytes, and invalid formats."""
        # Newline injection attempt
        resp = self.client.post("/api/integrations/gemini", json={"api_key": "AIzaSyFakeKey\nMALICIOUS_ENV=1"})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 400)

        # Invalid prefix / format
        resp = self.client.post("/api/integrations/gemini", json={"api_key": "not_a_valid_gemini_key"})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 400)

        # Valid format
        valid_key = "AIzaSyDas-UU7agAjyQeHDag1yOMU6qyXuxIWBE"
        resp = self.client.post("/api/integrations/gemini", json={"api_key": valid_key})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)

    def test_dns_rebinding_untrusted_host_blocked(self):
        """Assert requests with untrusted Host header are rejected with 403."""
        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/settings",
            json={"publish_mode": "private"},
            headers={"host": "attacker-controlled-site.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

    def test_untrusted_origin_blocked(self):
        """Assert requests with untrusted Origin header are rejected with 403."""
        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/settings",
            json={"publish_mode": "private"},
            headers={"origin": "http://evil-site.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

    def test_hostile_prefix_origin_rejected(self):
        """Assert requests with origins like http://localhost.evil.com or http://localhost:9999 are rejected."""
        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/settings",
            json={"publish_mode": "private"},
            headers={"origin": "http://localhost.evil.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/settings",
            json={"publish_mode": "private"},
            headers={"origin": "http://localhost:9999"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

    def test_pairing_code_requires_trusted_host_and_origin(self):
        """Assert pairing-code endpoint rejects untrusted Host header even from loopback client."""
        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/integrations/youtube/pairing-code",
            json={"understands_http_risk": True},
            headers={"host": "attacker-rebinding.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

    def test_credentials_post_rejects_untrusted_host_and_origin(self):
        """Assert POST /api/youtube/credentials rejects untrusted Host and Origin headers."""
        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/youtube/credentials",
            json={"pairing_code": "123456"},
            headers={"host": "attacker-rebinding.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

        resp = self.client.post(
            "/api/youtube/credentials",
            json={"pairing_code": "123456"},
            headers={"origin": "http://evil-attacker.com"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 403)

    def test_studio_endpoint_serves_html_and_assets(self):
        """Assert GET /studio redirects to /studio/ and GET /studio/ serves 200 HTML with valid assets."""
        resp = self.client.get("/studio", follow_redirects=False)
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 307)
        self.assertEqual(resp.headers.get("location"), "/studio/")

        resp = self.client.get("/studio/", follow_redirects=True)
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn("text/html", resp.headers.get("content-type", ""))

        # Check that assets referenced by index.html actually return HTTP 200
        import re
        css_matches = re.findall(r'href="(?:\./)?assets/([^"]+\.css)"', resp.text)
        js_matches = re.findall(r'src="(?:\./)?assets/([^"]+\.js)"', resp.text)
        if css_matches:
            css_resp = self.client.get(f"/studio/assets/{css_matches[0]}")
            self.assertEqual(css_resp.status_code, 200)
        if js_matches:
            js_resp = self.client.get(f"/studio/assets/{js_matches[0]}")
            self.assertEqual(js_resp.status_code, 200)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Tests for Phase 2: YouTube Inbox, OAuth, VTT Parser & Poller Hardening."""
import os
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from dispatch.config import ROOT_DIR, YOUTUBE_TOKEN_PATH
from dispatch.youtube_inbox.poller import parse_iso_datetime
from dispatch.youtube_inbox.vtt_parser import parse_vtt_content
from dispatch.youtube_inbox.catcher import YouTubeInboxCatcher, _apply_auth_opts


class TestPhase2YouTube(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_parse_iso_datetime_variants(self):
        """Verify parse_iso_datetime parses fractional seconds, Z, and offsets correctly."""
        # Standard with Z
        dt1 = parse_iso_datetime("2026-10-14T12:30:00Z")
        self.assertIsNotNone(dt1)
        self.assertEqual(dt1.tzinfo, timezone.utc)
        self.assertEqual(dt1.hour, 12)

        # Fractional seconds with Z
        dt2 = parse_iso_datetime("2026-10-14T12:30:00.123456Z")
        self.assertIsNotNone(dt2)
        self.assertEqual(dt2.microsecond, 123456)

        # Explicit offset
        dt3 = parse_iso_datetime("2026-10-14T12:30:00.500+00:00")
        self.assertIsNotNone(dt3)
        self.assertEqual(dt3.microsecond, 500000)

        # Space separated legacy format
        dt4 = parse_iso_datetime("2026-10-14 12:30:00")
        self.assertIsNotNone(dt4)
        self.assertEqual(dt4.minute, 30)

        # None / empty
        self.assertIsNone(parse_iso_datetime(None))
        self.assertIsNone(parse_iso_datetime(""))

    def test_vtt_rolling_caption_prefix_slicing(self):
        """Verify rolling caption inline words are properly sliced rather than matching repeated tokens."""
        vtt_data = """WEBVTT
Kind: captions
Language: en

00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:03.000
<00:00:01.000><c> We</c><00:00:01.500><c> are</c><00:00:02.000><c> launching</c>

00:00:02.000 --> 00:00:05.000
<00:00:02.000><c> We</c><00:00:02.300><c> are</c><00:00:02.600><c> launching</c><00:00:03.200><c> the</c><00:00:04.000><c> rocket</c>
"""
        segments = parse_vtt_content(vtt_data)
        self.assertTrue(len(segments) >= 1)
        # The full merged text should contain "We are launching the rocket" without "We are launching" duplicated
        full_text = " ".join(s["text"] for s in segments)
        self.assertEqual(full_text.strip(), "We are launching the rocket")

    def test_apply_auth_opts(self):
        """Verify _apply_auth_opts sets cookiefile or cookiesfrombrowser correctly."""
        ydl_opts = {}
        with patch.dict(os.environ, {"DISPATCH_YTDLP_COOKIES_BROWSER": "chrome"}, clear=False):
            _apply_auth_opts(ydl_opts)
            self.assertEqual(ydl_opts.get("cookiesfrombrowser"), ("chrome",))

    def test_canonical_token_path(self):
        """Verify canonical token path points to root directory youtube_token.json."""
        self.assertEqual(YOUTUBE_TOKEN_PATH, ROOT_DIR / "youtube_token.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Tests for Phase 3: AI Highlights, Subtitle Engine Unification & FFmpeg Renderer."""
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from dispatch.ai_clips.highlight_finder import (
    phonetic_devanagari_to_roman,
    transliterate_tokens_to_hinglish,
    has_devanagari
)
from dispatch.captions.model import CaptionTrack, CaptionGroup, Word, StyleConfig
from dispatch.captions.exporter import export_to_ass


class TestPhase3HighlightsAndCaptions(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_phonetic_devanagari_to_roman(self):
        """Verify phonetic transliteration fallback for common Hindi words."""
        self.assertTrue(has_devanagari("नमस्ते"))
        res_namaste = phonetic_devanagari_to_roman("नमस्ते")
        self.assertIn("namaste", res_namaste.lower())

        self.assertTrue(has_devanagari("आप"))
        res_aap = phonetic_devanagari_to_roman("आप")
        self.assertEqual(res_aap.lower(), "aap")

        self.assertTrue(has_devanagari("कैसे"))
        res_kaise = phonetic_devanagari_to_roman("कैसे")
        self.assertEqual(res_kaise.lower(), "kaise")

        self.assertTrue(has_devanagari("हैं"))
        res_hain = phonetic_devanagari_to_roman("हैं")
        self.assertIn("hai", res_hain.lower())

    def test_transliterate_tokens_fallback_1to1(self):
        """Verify transliterate_tokens_to_hinglish preserves exact 1:1 list length and strips Devanagari."""
        tokens = ["नमस्ते", "dosto", "आप", "सब", "कैसे", "हैं"]
        # Mock Gemini to raise exception (offline mode)
        with patch("dispatch.ai_clips.highlight_finder.call_gemini_generate_content", side_effect=RuntimeError("Offline")):
            res = transliterate_tokens_to_hinglish(tokens)
            self.assertEqual(len(res), len(tokens))
            self.assertEqual(res[1], "dosto")  # English untouched
            # All Devanagari should be converted to ASCII/Roman
            for token in res:
                self.assertFalse(has_devanagari(token), f"Token {token} still contains Devanagari!")

    def test_caption_track_export_to_ass(self):
        """Verify CaptionTrack correctly exports to ASS format with dialog events."""
        track = CaptionTrack(
            clip_id="test_clip_1",
            default_style=StyleConfig(font_family="Impact", font_size=54),
            groups=[
                CaptionGroup(
                    start=1.0,
                    end=3.0,
                    words=[
                        Word(text="Hello", start=1.0, end=1.5),
                        Word(text="World", start=1.5, end=2.5)
                    ]
                )
            ]
        )
        test_ass = Path("storage/processing/test_track.ass")
        test_ass.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            out_path = export_to_ass(track, test_ass)
            self.assertTrue(out_path.exists())
            content = out_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn("[Script Info]", content)
            self.assertIn("Impact", content)
            self.assertIn("Dialogue:", content)
            self.assertIn("HELLO", content)
            self.assertIn("WORLD", content)
        finally:
            if test_ass.exists():
                test_ass.unlink()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Tests for Phase 4: Publishing Outbox, FastAPI Unblocking & Studio UI."""
import unittest
import os
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

from dispatch import db
from dispatch.config import STORAGE_DIR
from dispatch.main import acquire_single_instance_lock, release_single_instance_lock, LOCK_FILE


class TestPhase4Publishing(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        db.init_db()

    def test_single_instance_lock_lifecycle(self):
        """Verify lock file creation and release."""
        release_single_instance_lock()
        self.assertFalse(LOCK_FILE.exists())

        acquired = acquire_single_instance_lock()
        self.assertTrue(acquired)
        self.assertTrue(LOCK_FILE.exists())
        self.assertEqual(LOCK_FILE.read_text().strip(), str(os.getpid()))

        release_single_instance_lock()
        self.assertFalse(LOCK_FILE.exists())

    def test_unsupported_platform_marks_failed(self):
        """Verify unsupported platforms transition to 'failed' rather than remaining in 'uploading'."""
        clip_id = "test_clip_unsupported_plat"

            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO clips (id, title, start_time, end_time, duration, status, video_path)

            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO publishing_outbox 
                (id, clip_id, platform, status, idempotency_key)

        # Mock probe_video to pass

    def test_ambiguous_error_transitions_to_reconciliation_required(self):
        """Verify that ambiguous timeouts even on the FIRST attempt transition to reconciliation_required."""
        clip_id = "test_clip_timeout_recon"
        with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO clips (id, title, start_time, end_time, duration, status, video_path)
                VALUES (?, 'Timeout Clip', 0.0, 15.0, 15.0, 'ready_review', 'tests/fixtures/sample.mp4')
            """, (clip_id,))
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO publishing_outbox 
                (id, clip_id, platform, status, idempotency_key, attempt_count)
                VALUES ('job_timeout_recon', ?, 'youtube', 'queued', 'idem_timeout_recon', 0)
            """, (clip_id,))
            conn.commit()

        with patch("dispatch.publisher.outbox.probe_video", return_value=(True, {"duration": 15.0}, None)):
            with patch("pathlib.Path.exists", return_value=True):
                with patch("dispatch.publisher.outbox.upload_youtube_short", side_effect=TimeoutError("Connection timed out waiting for remote response")):
                    from dispatch.publisher.outbox import process_outbox_queue
                    process_outbox_queue()

        with db.get_db_connection() as conn:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT status, last_error FROM publishing_outbox WHERE id = 'job_timeout_recon'").fetchone()
            self.assertEqual(row["status"], "reconciliation_required")
